notes.title: Patch 3.9
notes.content:
[b]SUMMARY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Tweaked the Friends List, especially with the Steam friends list that could cause many minor issues. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some changes to the Slicer zombie.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a lot of bugs related to zombies. 	[/*]	[*]		Make some tweaks on weapons to balance them out better. 	[/*]	[*]		Players will no longer respawn inside "events".	[/*]	[*]		Made some adjustments to the zombie optimization systems.	[/*]	[*]		Made some changes to the secret rooms so they can't be abused and you can't risk finding empty crates.	[/*]	[*]		Made some tweaks to the contracts in Survival.	[/*]	[*]		Adjusted spawns around Clearview and added cover.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

	[u][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added more options for server owners on the Private Server panel.	[/*]	[*]		Added a warning to the Flea Market in offers where weapons or ammo are not full. 	[/*]	[*]		Tweaked the Friend system to avoid lags from huge friends lists. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a UI bug in the Arcade Leaderboards that could cause a game crash.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that causes the crafting screen to incorrectly show that the recipe required a workbench.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused item descriptions to not show properly. 	[/*]	[*]		Added an option to toggle Steam friends on/off.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		The icon for the Airdrop will disappear after the Airdrop is looted.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where the reviver time would go to 0 (visually) when you purchased something in the shop. 	[/*]	[*]		The Slicer Zombie will no longer chase vehicles.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused zombies not to be able to attack targets that were slightly higher than the zombies.	[/*]	[*]		Players will no longer respawn inside Radiation areas. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a kick that was caused due to sliding downhills. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused skinned items to not be counted as a crafting item resource. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some changes to how the Secret Rooms work. From now on, you use the cards to open the crates rather than the door.	[/*]	[*]		Heli Crashes [u][b]will not[/b] [/u]instantly spawn zombies upon appearing on the map. 	[/*]	[*]		You cannot use a gauze accidentally if you are not bleeding. 	[/*]	[*]		Lowered interaction time on Lockers.	[/*]	[*]		Adjusted the sounds of Zombie Dogs to make it easier to detect their direction.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused the Slicer Zombie to respawn too quickly. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where other players' weapons would show incorrectly when aiming down.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused zombies to glitch when dying and reappearing "frozen" in place. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug on the server where they would lag for a second every 5 minutes and zombies would teleport around. 	[/*]	[*]		Reworked zombie optimizations: 		[list]			[*]				To improve general performance a while back, we made some changes to the animation and their AI when they were far. We have fixed a few bugs related to this which will make them feel much smoother.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		M4:		[list]			[*]				Spread has been slightly increased			[/*]			[*]				Recoil has been slightly increased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		AKM:		[list]			[*]				Spread has been slightly increased			[/*]			[*]				Recoil has been slightly increased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		FN Scar CQC:		[list]			[*]				Speed has been slightly decreased			[/*]			[*]				Fire rate has been slightly decreased			[/*]			[*]				Spread has been slightly decreased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		FN Scar Nightstalker:		[list]			[*]				Fire rate has been slightly increased			[/*]			[*]				Spread has been slightly decreased			[/*]			[*]				Recoil has been slightly increased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		AK-47:		[list]			[*]				Speed has been slightly increased			[/*]			[*]				Spread has been slightly decreased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		AN94:		[list]			[*]				Spread has been slightly increased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]ITEM CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]MODELS[/b][u][b]:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Made some changes to the ladder models. This will prevent you from getting stuck on top.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a material issue on the Zombie Spike.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[b]SKINS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]Fixes[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed the Light Sword Yellow. It was previously showing the wrong color. 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]SURVIVAL[/b][/u]

	[b]FIXES & CHANGES[/b]
[list]	[*]		You will grant temporary immunity to the virus after using a Vaccine.	[/*][/list]
	[b]CRAFTING:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Camping Backpack Recipe changes:		[list]			[*]				2x Hunter Backpacks are required now			[/*]			[*]				Removed Nails			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Added Gasoline Recipe:		[list]			[*]				3x Oil			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	[b]CONTRACTS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Zombie Slayer II Contract		[list]			[*]				Decreased XP to 3500 (from 5000)			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Zombie Slayer III Contract		[list]			[*]				Increased XP to 12000 (from 10000)			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Alien Specialist Contract		[list]			[*]				Increased XP to 3500 (from 1500)			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Helping Hand: C04 Vaccine Contract		[list]			[*]				Increased XP to 1000 (from 200)			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	[b]MAPS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]OREGON[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed some small map-related bugs			[/*]			[*]				Added the missing resource spawns everywhere			[/*]			[*]				Fixed a model issue at the Airport tower			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]COLORADO V1[/b]		[list]			[*]				Clearview changes:				[list]					[*]						Moved and added player spawns around the city					[/*]					[*]						Added more objects on roads to create more protection					[/*]					[*]						Fixed an Alien Super Zombie spawn that didn't give any loot					[/*]					[*]						Fixed some small map-related bugs					[/*]				[/list]			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	 

	[b]Estimated patch size: 80MB[/b]

notes.title: Infestation: Survivor Stories is LIVE!
notes.content:
Infestation: Survivor Stories is LIVE!

Back to the origins!

Due to popular demand we have decided to bring back Infestation to its original state and how it was designed to be played, hardcore survival!

Fight for your loot with your civilian guns, run to the safezones to bank your items and survive through the apocalypse.
The idea is to bring back the old feeling of early I:SS with all the fixes, upgrades and improvements we've made in the past 5 years. 

 - Rare loot
 - Ultra rare snipers
 - Need to run to safezones to be able to store items
 - Original map and lighting
 - LOTS of new features & content

So join back for the feeling you've all yearned for and try and survive! To play, simply launch "Survival" from The New Z menu. Join in now, the playerbase is growing rapidly!

notes.title: Patch 3.7
notes.content:
[b]SUMMARY:[/b]
[olist]	[*]		New Season Pass and reworked Experience gain.	[/*]	[*]		Added a "Find Party" function in all game modes. 	[/*]	[*]		New Battle Royale Skins are coming very soon. They will be called Battle Royale XX.	[/*]	[*]		Made changes to AR statistics. This will be unnoticeable for players that use them properly, don't worry. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some small tweaks to a couple of snipers to avoid abuse. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some changes to the Event Map.	[/*]	[*]		Improved the Wood Shield Barricade Model.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked Backpacks in Survival and added a new one.	[/*][/olist]
	 

	[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

	[u][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a Group Find function for any game modes. It works like the Battle Royale version. When selected, you can queue up and be group with other players looking for a party. 	[/*]	[*]		Added a "Party" chat into the ingame Chat window. You can talk to your party even if you're not in the same server.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some issues on the UI that could cause small crashes.	[/*]	[*]		Made small tweaks to some UI Pop-Ups	[/*]	[*]		We have moved the "My Offers" button in the Flea Market to its main page. It was very confusing for some players unfamiliar with it. Now you can easily navigate there to reclaim items not sold. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue that would cause some private servers from not running when they were first rented.	[/*]	[*]		[b]Adjusted the Account/Season Pass Experience gained. More information on that below.[/b]	[/*]	[*]		Updated the description of the vehicle spawners to make it clear where and how you can use it.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a bug where clan territory perks would not work when the territory was "vulnerable". 	[/*]	[*]		Limited the Firerate on Assault Rifles, Submachine Guns and Machine Guns when set to single-fire mode. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some tweaks to balance out better all Assault Rifles.	[/*]	[*]		Changed some things on the behavior of the spread on Assault Rifles to prevent abuse.	[/*]	[*]		Made some small adjustments to some Sniper Rifles. They were way too unbalanced as they were and especially in Arcade where they're fairly common, they were hard to fight against. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue that made it nearly impossible to hit vehicles in high speed.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug caused by having a backpack inside your backpack on a loadout. 	[/*]	[*]		Improved the SSAO option on both High and Ultra graphics settings.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some spelling mistakes in some localizations.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the description of the vehicle spawners to make it clear where and how you can use it.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]ITEM CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[u][b]MODELS:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Wood Shield Barricades: We have made an update on the Wood Shield Model as to have it with no holes that players can shoot from/into. 
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/ecbc713c9d76327e38a9c32b7662e92cf9fc5b27.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		We had the idea of opening up all the windows in the "Red Houses" and after getting feedback from the community, we are going to try it. We have it backed up so if it doesn't feel good or right, please let us know. All feedback is welcome.
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/c46be78fb8254a67f4d2390e06d6fd1463427f86.png[/img][/*]	[*]		Made a few changes to the "Office Building". There are extra steps to go up the stairs to avoid getting stuck. We have also removed some windows that were placed in front of the stairs.
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/6bf73997d9310145b090a99d354e01fd7f1856ce.png[/img]	[/*][/list]

[list]	[*]		[b]Fixes[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed the glowing texture on the M4 Semi Pink Graffiti			[/*]			[*]				Updated the link to BananaJoe's Riot Shield			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the name on the Desert Eagle Purple			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the models of the M9 Helmets. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/0df804e9fb4185b31633da4bf4a077095dc3dc4a.jpg[/img]
	[b]SUMMARY:[/b]
[olist]	[*]		New community Marketplace is available. It will only be available in GD items. 	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the character screens to have a more dynamic one. 	[/*]	[*]		"Open World" has been renamed to ARCADE. Open World was a very vast term and Survival is also technically an Open World game mode. 	[/*]	[*]		Some minor changes were made to the UI to make them look cleaner and better.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the competitive store. 	[/*]	[*]		We have made a major change to vehicles that should fix the flying car issue that some of you would experience. 	[/*]	[*]		Added High Precision Servers. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/0de2d627a718e42f1726c89b4887b69b1dfb1094.jpg[/img]

	[b]SUMMARY:[/b]
[olist]	[*]		Fixed skins that didn't match the set.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed abusable bugs related to vehicled and secret cave.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some minor UI issues and cleaned it up.	[/*]	[*]		Added skins for the Medieval Event.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed objects around the maps.	[/*]	[*]		We are tweaking the loot from Helicopter Crashes, Slicers and Secret Rooms live from now on. Any feedback is welcome.	[/*]	[*]		We made a small change to the gun switching system. It now prevents abuse from it.	[/*]	[*]		Added new contracts/missions with Slicer body parts.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to multiple zombies. This issue most likely is the main cause of the ping spikes on areas with many zombies.	[/*]	[*]		Improved loot in some areas in both Open World and Survival.	[/*]	[*]		Changed the way loot spawns in Secret Locked Rooms.	[/*][/olist]
	 

	[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

	[u][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Made some small UI changes to have a cleaner look.	[/*]	[*]		Whenever you pick up gear and attachments from the vault, it will no longer auto equip if its a superior one than you had on.	[/*]	[*]		Oceania Servers have been removed from the Server List.	[/*]	[*]		Added a protection on changing weapons that was easily abused. 	[/*]	[*]		Reverted back a change that would cause your mouse to "escape" the Window when you had other menus open.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where players were able to open the ingame store while dead.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where you could use your "Taunt" command while typing in search bars in the GI or store.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the Tutorial Windows in English, German and Portuguese.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a few issues in the French translation.	[/*][/list]

	[b]GENERAL FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue with zombies that caused gathering too many of them at the same time. This SHOULD fix the ping spikes, but we will need broader testing. 	[/*]	[*]		Made a few changes to physics on cars versus players that allowed players to abuse and enter areas they shouldn't.	[/*]	[*]		You can open the "player list" (Tab Menu) while climbing up and down stairs.	[/*]	[*]		When you pick up gear and attachments from the vault, it will no longer auto equip if it's a better one than you had on.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue that caused an error when gifting a friend character clothes on the marketplace. 	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]ITEM CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]VEHICLES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a visual bug that would show the wrong durability on vehicles.	[/*]	[*]		You are no longer able to repair vehicles when they're at 100%, so you won't waste repair kits. 	[/*]	[*]		You are no longer able to refuel vehicles when they're at 100%, so you won't waste fuel.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to Player vs Vehicles physics that allowed players to glitch and abuse those glitches.	[/*]	[*]		Normal Repair Kits will no longer repair vehicles with less than 25% durability left. For such cases a Premium Repair Kit will be required.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ZOMBIES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved textures and materials for the Slicer. This gives the Slicer a better appearance with more detail, especially on higher resolutions.	[/*]	[*]		Added two new unique items to the Slicer: Slicer Head and Slicer Blades. They can be acquired from Slicers and are needed for the Razer Blade contracts. 	[/*][/list]
	[img]https://i.imgur.com/TTm8fg5.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Rb6FtgM.png[/img]

	[b]LOOT:[/b]

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/o3tMajq.png[/img]
[list]	[*]		Items in secret rooms will now spawn in boxes. This will prevent these items from glitching through walls and always be visble. It will also avoid abusing items through walls. 	[/*]	[*]		Added an extra protection against players camping inside secret rooms to wait for the loot to respawn.	[/*][/list]

	[b]SKINS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]Fixes[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed some K. Style NVG textures that didn't properly match the rest of their sets. Those include: Pulse, Black Night, Helix, Modern Black, Battle Royale, Crimson, Camo and Digital Red. 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed some other Pulse skins. Their Glow Maps were not properly set and they now all have the same level of glow. 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the M107 Recipe icon. It was missing.			[/*]			[*]				Renamed all the Sig Sauer 556 skins. They are now called Sig Sauer 556 "NAME". 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the Iron Sights on multiple Sig Sauer 556 skins. They were still using the unskinned version Iron Sight.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the AWP Tech glow map. Its glow was not properly set and it now matches the rest of the set. 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the coloring of the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Gold. It now matches the rest.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the colors and wings on the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Desion.			[/*]			[*]				Improved the Blue Night skins set. The colors have been readjusted to its intended colors. It's now less "purple" than it previously was. 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the description of the Sig Sauer 556 Skins.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed an issue with the sound on the Valentine Heart Katana Skin.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the texture on the M9 NVG Valentine.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the model on the Heavy Armor Helix where the lower part of the armor would split from the rest when crouched. 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	
[*]		[b]Additions[/b]		[list]			[*]				Added a new skin set for the Medieval Event. You will see more details on them when the event starts.			[/*]			[*]				Added skins to be rewarded to Battle Royale 2019 Leaderboard Winners. These are 3 different skins. Rank 1 will receive a unique one, then ranks 2 to 10 will receive a different one and 11 to 50 will receive another one. These skins are unique and will be automatically applied on the accounts so therefore nobody else can get them.			[/*]			[*]				Added two new Toxic Skins, the K. Style NVG and Moto Helmet. They will be added to the Revolution Skinbox.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]OPEN WORLD[/b][/u]

	[b]LOOT & ITEM CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Items from Helicopter Crashes will continue to be tweaked over time.	[/*]	[*]		Items from secret rooms will continue to be tweaked over time. 	[/*]	[*]		Items from the Slicer and Toxic zombies will continue to be tweaked over time.	[/*]	[*]		[b]New Contracts Added[/b]. They can be found around the world but they will also be in the Open World Contract Box.		[list]			[*]				Razor Blade I			[/*]			[*]				Razor Blade II			[/*]			[*]				Razor Blade III			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Items in secret rooms will now spawn in boxes. This will prevent these items from glitching through walls and always be visble. It will also avoid abusing items through walls. 	[/*]	[*]		Added an extra protection against players camping inside secret rooms to wait for the loot to respawn.	[/*][/list]
	[b]MAPS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]COLORADO V1[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed a player spawn that had the player spawn inside a tree.			[/*]			[*]				Moved some objects that were blocking the entrance of a few buildings.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed some terrain issues at Blue Ridge Safe Zone.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]COLORADO[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed a Helicopter Crash at the Airport that contained the wrong loot pool. The loot from it now matches other Helicopters.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]OREGON[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed a airdrop spawn where the airdrop was going through a building while landing.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]SURVIVAL[/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue where your backpack would change when you picked up a smaller backpack. It now only changes if you pick up a larger one.	[/*][/list]

	[b]LOOT & ITEM CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Items from Helicopter Crashes will continue to be tweaked over time. notes.title: Patch 3.4
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dKnBTGD.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/9023-patch-34/)

	As planned we are releasing patch 3.4 including fixes and improvements and the new Season Pass 04. Next to that we are also releasing the new Pulse skin collection. We are working hard on the next upcoming event although it's not just ready yet. Expect more information about that soon.

	 

	Now, without further ado, let's jump in to the patch notes:

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Various new assets have been added to the game related to a future medieval themed event. More information about the Medieval 2020 event will follow soon.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to the recently added prefab spawn system. This is the system that for example controls the random appearing helicopter crashes on the maps. There was an issue that could cause the site not to spawn on private servers.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused players not being able to pick up particular items in secrets rooms.	[/*][/list]
	[b]VEHICLES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved / Updated textures for the racer vehicle.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing cars to de-sync with clients.	[/*]	[*]		You can no longer exit a vehicle while trying to glitch inside a locked area. People were using cars to glitch inside these rooms / areas. We'd like to remind all of you here that we have systems in place to ban players attempting this. Don't do it.	[/*][/list]
	[b]3D MODELS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Upscaled textures for the airfield control tower.	[/*][/list]
	[b]SPAWN SYSTEM:[/b]
[list]	[*]		We are working hard on the current spawn system in the game. We have heared your feedback and made according improvements: players will no longer always spawn in the exact location of the player spawn, but instead  spawn in a close area around that particular spawn. This will always be random. We hope aim to improve the current situation.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Medieval 2020 Event:[/u][/b][/u]

	The Medieval 2020 event will not start just yet, so hold on! With this update we are already teasing some of the content for you guys.
[list]	[*]		The vault NPC textures have been updated to fit the Medieval 2020 event style.	[/*]	[*]		The trading lounge has been updated to the Medieval 2020 variant.	[/*][/list]
	We hope you are all as excited for this event as we are. Stay tuned for more soon!

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/zkiJwJt.png[/img]

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/7ixzRAB.png[/img]

	(More pictures here: [url=https://imgur.com/a/w49ITgz]https://imgur.com/a/w49ITgz[/url])

	 

	[u][b][u]Season Pass 04:[/u][/b][/u]

	In this update we are releasing Season Pass 04. The pass will directly be available after the update in the in-game marketplace for 2000 GC. A lot of new, unique content has been created and added to the game for this Season Pass and overall we are very happy with the result.
	
	[img]https://i.imgur.com/RtfgG8i.jpg[/img]

	Based on your feedback we have created Season Pass 04 and there is a couple of things that we'd like to address and explain:
[olist]	[*]		This Season Pass will be available and over a period of time that is over 2 months. It will end on July 31, at 12:00 PM (CET) 2020. The reason for this length is so that everyone has enough time to potentially finish it and claim all the rewards from all the levels.
		 	[/*]	[*]		The levels and XP needed per level hasn't changed compared to previous passes. We are overall pretty satisfied with the current level and XP amounts so there is not really a reason (yet) to change anything around this subject.
		 	[/*]	[*]		New exclusive content has been added for the Season Pass 04. This goes from unique sprays and taunts all the way to skins. A lot of next-level looking skins have been added and will only be available through the season pass. (Screenshot below of the new "SVD Hell" skin that you'll only be able to get through Season Pass 04:)
	
		And no, this is not the ONLY unique skin / content for the Season Pass 04. [b]There is a lot more![/b]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/2mesrh7.png[/img]
		
		 	[/*]	[*]		There is also a dedicated key item (both for Survival and Open World) available in Season Pass 04. In this case, players can get the Season Pass 04 Key 7x for each Survival and Open World through the rewards.
		
		Players can use these keys to enter an exclusive Season Pass 04 zone that can only be entered by players with this particular key. In these areas players have a chance to find even more exclusive Season 04 Pass-only content. And yes, even have a chance on getting ANOTHER SVD Hell skin recipe.
		
		Risky? Yes. You'll have to venture through Colorado V2 and open the door, although since this is map based, you can also just go on your private server.
		Remember, you'll only receive 7 keys in total for both Survival and Open World each. You'll only have 7 tries as they key disappears from your inventory once the door is opens.
		
		Where are these "areas"? Well, they are caves actually. They are only on the Colorado V2 map for both Survival and Open World and there is only 1 on each map. You'll have to find the location yourself. Good luck!
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/4AFnvSy.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/SDRRMig.png[/img]	[/*][/olist]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for NVG Goggles Civilian.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a new skinbox: Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/LrVBokZ.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Custom Guerilla: Custom Guerilla Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/06Gf9et.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Heavy Armor: Heavy Armor Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/z4mcCGY.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the IBA: IBA Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZasN8P3.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the IMI Tar-21: IMI Tar-21 Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/OnwoYZ6.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the K. Style NVG: K. Style NVG Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/vXlpwrg.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Night Vision Goggles Civilian: Night Vision Goggles Civilian Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/uGCzzhO.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Moto Helmet: Moto Helmet Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.

		[img]https://i.imgur.com/KJlz1p1.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the SVD: SVD Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.

notes.title: Patch 3.3
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XCzfKJG.jpg[/img]

	 

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8984-patch-33/)

	A lot of exciting stuff has happened in the previous two development weeks. We have worked on a lot, and have finished a lot of awesome new content and features. Main new features this patch offers is the random helicopter crash system, which will be available in both Open World and Survival. Next to that we are finally releasing the new 'slicer' creature which is a new type of super / boss zombie. Also this creature will be available in Open World and Survival. On top of all this a locked room / door system has been implemented into the game. This allows us to block off rooms with doors that need keys, or other items to be opened. These locked rooms are also available in both the Open World and Survival game-mode.

	But that's not all, next to everything mentioned above this patch has a lot more to offer. We have recently worked out and finished numerous ideas and this is just the tip of the ice berg. This patch is rolled out purely to not overflow the amount of work and changes we have made to the game. This means you can all expect another patch very soon again.

	We have a medieval event planned to be released very soon. A lot of awesome new, and amazing looking content has been implemented in to the game and with this event we plan to step up the game and make it an even more awesome event than any of the events we have done before.

	 

	Anyways, for now, let's jump into the patch notes:

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Various new assets have been added to the game related to a future medieval themed event.	[/*]	[*]		You can no longer create characters or clans with a name that contains more than 1 consecutive space between the letters.	[/*]	[*]		Added a 'prefab spawn system'. A system like this allows us to create prefabs that we can randomly spawn either manually (event-based) or by the server. The first type we have developed for this is a random helicopter crash site. These can spawn in random areas on a server. Only one can be up at a time and the area is indicated on the minimap. The helicopter crash sites, their loot and spawn location varies per game-mode and map so we will be listing that under the separate game-mode section of these patch notes.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/PBR5Tq5.jpg[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		Updated German localization.	[/*]	[*]		Account experience rewards have been updated. Here is the list of account XP:		[list]			[*]				Complete any mission: 10 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Contest a clan point: 18 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Call in an airdrop: 25 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Open an airdrop in Battle Royale: 5 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Kill a Slicer: 25 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Kill an Alien Super Zombie: 15 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Kill a Toxic Super Zombie: 12 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Kill a Super Zombie: 8 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Learn any skin: 1 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Play a Competitive game: 25 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Every Battle Royale minute played: 5 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Kill a player: 5 XP.			[/*]			[*]				Kill a zombie: 1 XP.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		You can now see way points that are placed by other group members. They all automatically have it's own matching color assigned.	[/*]	[*]		Removed the blur from radiation zones when wearing a gas mask. This so it's easier to generally see when being inside radiation zones and having a gas mask equipped.	[/*]	[*]		Clan points now reward with SD or GD (depending on the game-mode) when being captured.	[/*]	[*]		New type of player spawns have been added to all maps. These new type of spawns are so called 'beginner spawns' and are dedicated for beginning players / accounts. This way we can concentrate beginning players to only spawn in specific / more beginner friendly areas.	[/*]	[*]		The cooldown on medical and consumable items has been reworked. Cool downs are now properly adjusted to the medical / consumable type where for example a bandage now has less cooldown than an antibiotic. (Antibiotics heal a lot more than a bandage and should therefor have a higher cooldown, but before this patch that was not the case.)	[/*][/list]
	[b]UI:[/b]
[list]	[*]		The 'play game' screen has been reworked. Not only is the screen adjusted to the new style, but by reworking we have also made space for the 'quick play' button.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/6PAvh9W.png[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		The mouse will no longer be 'locked' in to the game when in any of the game menus.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed several UI bugs in the servers list selection screen.	[/*]	[*]		Attachments are now rendered on the skin preview screen. (Ammo, sights, etc.)	[/*][/list]
	[b]MODELS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Created LODs for all the zombie "lay" models. (the dead zombies you see laying around in pretty much all maps.)	[/*][/list]
	[b]SECRET ROOMS:[/b]
	A new 'feature' has been added. We are now able to use doors in our maps. We are also able to lock them, where a certain item is needed for that door to be opened. There is some important features related to this system you should know:
[list]	[*]		When a door is locked, you can still press "e" on it and it will indicate what it needs to be opened.	[/*]	[*]		When opening a door, that needs any type of key, it will consume the key aka the key will dissapear from your inventory. The key is a one-time use item to open the locked door once.	[/*]	[*]		Any door can always be opened from the inside of the room. There is a red button that you have to press from the inside to open it. No you can not log out in these rooms, if you do, your spawn will reset.	[/*]	[*]		There is also normal doors, that are not locked and can be interacted with normally.	[/*][/list]
	This resulted in us implementing the door system the following way: (The following goes for both the Survival and Open World game-mode)

	There is two types of rooms:
[olist]	[*]		Common Locked Room. Need "Common Key" to open. These "Common Rooms" contain rare loot.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/poujEYZ.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Rare Locked Room. Need "Rare Key" to open. These "Rare Rooms" contain super rare loot.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Nh1mP4.png[/img]	[/*][/olist]
	The idea with this new system is to create more alternative and interactive ways for players to loot and explore areas. This is just the start of something we plan on playing a prominent role in New Z. Keys are progression based, so the highest chance to obtain a rare key, is by finding it inside a locked room that needs a common key.

	As for now. Common keys have a chance to be dropped from a Slicer. Rare keys have a chance to be spawning inside a common room.

	[b]VEHICLES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue when zombies would spawn in front of a car when driving at high speeds, causing it to crash	[/*][/list]
	[b]ZOMBIES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		The new "Slicer" (Similar to a Super Zombie) has been finished. This means that after this patch this creature will be spawning in the worlds. Where and how it will spawn, depends on the map and the game-mode so we will be listing that under the separate game-mode section of these patch notes.
		
		The Slicer is a big creature that has a lot of health and is hard to kill. It can be compared to the Super Zombie although it is a lot stronger. The slicer is unique in a lot of ways. It's not only an entire new type of creature with it's own mesh, animations, sounds and AI. The slicer has 15.000 health and rewards 25 account XP per kill. You also gain character XP upon killing one,  for Survival you gain 700 XP, and for Open World 7000 XP.
		
		The AI part is as following:
		 		[list]			[*]				The Slicer will always return to it's original spawn location when not aggro'd by any player. When it reaches it's original spawn location it will start regenerating it's health.
				Note: The idea here is to keep it at all times aggro'd on you or another player. The zombie is smart, if you are on top of something where it can't hit or aggro on you, it will start moving towards it's original spawn location again. This is why it's recommended to do this with at least one more other player.			[/*]			[*]				The slicer has a shield. The shield is active when the Slicer is idle on it's spawn area and not aggro'd on anything. To disable the shield you need to aggro it and draw it away from it's spawn area. The shield will get disabled you will be able to damage it.			[/*]			[*]				A Slicer spawn is indicated on the minimap. Only one spawn can be up at a time. If no player is near the Slicer (within 100 meters) it will despawn. The slicer has a cooldown timer, so it will take some time before a new slicer spawns.
				
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/DNJxkRW.jpg[/img]
				 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Improved performance drops caused by zombies when they die. (raggdoll)	[/*]	[*]		Zombies will no longer 'stop' upon detecting sounds from an unreachable player that's for example firing a weapon.	[/*]	[*]		Zombies inside a radiation zone are now slightly easier to kill.	[/*]	[*]		The toxic super zombie now drops 5 items instead of 3. This goes for all game-modes.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Updated the QBZ-95 Tech skin material settings: adjusted the glow level to match the other Tech skins. This skin was glowing a bit too much.	[/*][/list]
	[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a major issue related to particular skins having too much specular power causing multiple visual glitches especially for player playing on higher settings. One of the effects of this was where you'd have a skin that would annoyingly bright and blink all the time. (here is an example of one of the visual issues: [url=https://gyazo.com/f89caa5e3b9c730df1b0cbfdd59a0694]https://gyazo.com/f89caa5e3b9c730df1b0cbfdd59a0694[/url])	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the muzzle texture of the MP5/10 SD Tech where it had a skinned muzzle attached on default.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the recipe icon of the QBZ-95 Tech skin.	[/*][/list]
	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Crossbow & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the AWM & it's skinned variants.	[/*][/list]

[list]	[*]		We have disabled the exchange missions for now since we are going to enable the in-game Survival Currency marketplace.	[/*]	[*]		The Survival Marketplace is now enabled. Players can now buy items for Survival Dollars. The marketplace can only be accessed in safe zones through marketplace NPC's.	[/*]	[*]		Added a wallet (Cash) system. This means that from now on Survival Dollars gathered will now drop on the ground and are an actual item that's in your inventory. To add this 'money' to your account you have to use the new ATM system. There is several things you should know about the new cash system:
		 		[list]			[*]				When you die, all cash you had on you will be dropped on the ground. This means that other players can kill you, and take the cash you collected that run. 			[/*]			[*]				ATM's are in every Survival map. They are located in all safe zones and in all towns and cities that have a bank or post office. 			[/*]			[*]				The safest way to transfer your collected cash to your account is by doing it in a safe zone, as you could be killed doing it in a normal town or city.			[/*]			[*]				In an ATM you can also withdraw money out of your account. This means you can take out money and put it on your character.			[/*]			[*]				ATM's that are located in a safe zone won't take a fee for any type of transaction. ATM's that are located outside of a safe zone will take a fee for any type of transaction. notes.title: Easter 2020
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oIBm9rf.png[/img]

	 

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8955-easter-2020/)

	Are you ready for Easter 2020? We are very excited to announce this event. We know a lot of you are currently at home because of the COVID-19 virus and therefor we have decided the event a little bit earlier than planned. 

	 

	Before we jump into any event details let's make it clear over what period of time this event is taking place:

	 

	[u][b]Start: April 8, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b][/u]

	[u][b]End: April 20, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b][/u]

	 

	Now, let's jump into the details of the event:

		[u][b][u]All the new content:[/u][/b][/u]

notes.title: Patch 3.2
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qeNP9ER.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8930-patch-32/)

	It's time for another update and this time a lot more aimed towards beginning players where we have added tutorial screens, more translations and more language support over all. Next to all of this we are patching in the new "Tech" skins with the Tech Skinbox. We are also rolling out this update to patch in content for the upcoming Easter 2020 event. More information about that event will be released in the near future.

	 

	For now, let's get in to the patch notes.

	 

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added various new content for the upcoming Easter 2020 event. Easter secret spots have been added to all maps. Please note that once again these spots are already showing in the game but won't be spawning any loot until the Easter 2020 event starts.	[/*]	[*]		All the beginner missions that activate when joining the beginner training map are now translated in all available languages.	[/*]	[*]		The in-game chat font has been updated to a different one that supports more languages including Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Thai and more. There will no longer be weird block icons showing when using characters from a specific language. If you still experience issues with writing your language in the in-game chat please let us know so we can work on this.	[/*]	[*]		The character name allowance has been improved as well. We now allow characters to be created again with a lot more characters and letters from specific languages.	[/*]	[*]		The Steam friends system is now integrated in to the game. This means you can now see and invite any of your Steam friends from the game to come and play with you.	[/*]	[*]		Added a tutorial slideshow for new players. This screen can be accessed by pressing F1 in either the main menu or in-game. There is separate screens for the different game-modes and there is separate screens for in the menu and in the game. We have also localized these screens although we are not 100% finished with the translations and all the screens yet. More will be added in future updates.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added an option to enable / disable the automatic equip of gear and attachments when picked up or attached.	[/*]	[*]		Picking up a better helmet will no longer automatically switch the gas mask when a player is inside the radiation zone or when a night vision is enabled.	[/*][/list]
	[b]SERVERS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Support for Oceania servers has been added. This means this is now a new region added in the game. There is no servers running in this new region just yet but there will be a later specific announcement about this.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Updated all Custom Guerilla Fallen Angel skins. We have reworked the wings just like we did on the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel skins. The wings look better, are in a better position and are more optimized.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Police Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Halloween 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Summer 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Valentine 2020 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Winter 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the store icon and the recipe icon for the QBZ-95 Tech skin. This skin will also be added to the new Tech Skinbox.	[/*][/list]
	[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Chrome texture. The skin should now be properly chrome again.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the Heavy Armor BR Champion. It is now better rigged around the character and should fit any character better.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Purple skin. The wings are now chrome again instead of white glowing.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Desion skin. The wings are now chrome red-ish again instead of white glowing.	[/*]	[*]		Rank skins now also apply to Battle Royale team wins.	[/*][/list]
	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the VSS Vintorez (sniper) & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the VSS Compact & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Honey Badger & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the QLB & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the SVU & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Flashlight & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Hatchet & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Blaser & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the AWP & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Bizon & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the P90 & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the MP5/10 SD & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the B93r & it's skinned variants.	[/*][/list]
	[b]FURTHER WEAPON STATS REWORK:[/b]
	Continuing the guns rework, we have revisited prior changes we've made to SMGs and readjusted them to better serve their real purposes. 
	SMGs are made to be extremely powerful close combat weapons and they should not be strong at a high distance. The issue with their previous status is that, first of all, they had no pattern... Some were extremely strong at certain distances, while others were useless even at close range. Now, we've adjusted to make them at least a bit more logically similar (but not the same) as they all serve the same purpose. 
	Basically, we have adjusted damage, improved speed and spread while nerfing the damage distance on them. We also took into consideration each gun's fire-rate and clip size to make this fair. That way, they will adapt to your play style better and you will be inclined to use each one, depending on how you like playing (rushing and pre-firing, tap-shooting, waiting-and-shooting, spray-and-spray, etc...). 

	LMGs needed a rework as well, however this is very delicate. LMGs's current main purpose and use is for farming, especially for killing super/alien zombies so we had to tread carefully here. 
[olist]	[*]		We cannot lower their damage or it will affect their current main use, which we don't want to hinder. 	[/*]	[*]		We also can't make it too precise as they are extremely powerful for automatic weapons, with very high damage. 	[/*]	[*]		We shouldn't leave them stuck only for extremely close combat. 	[/*][/olist]
	So with these three things in mind, we have added the Spread Variation System to it, where the more you shoot the more spread it has, with a fair limit to it, so it also doesn't go to the sky. 

	Future tweaks may occur on these weapons in the near future, but for now, enjoy their new stats and try them out!

notes.title: Patch 3.1
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z1priiN.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8897-patch-31/)	 

	Here we are already at patch 3.1. We planned on releasing this update later, but due to some particular issues and improvements we have made to the game we decided to release the update earlier. We were also forced to roll out this update as soon as possible as there was a major issue related to the navigation regions for zombies. This caused not only corruption and crashes but also caused players to experience major performance issues and zombies behaving incorrectly.

	 

	Here's the notes for this patch:

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a crash related to VOIP. (VOIP is the in-game voice system)	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a client-sided memory leak.	[/*][/list]
	[b]OPTIONS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added an option to adjust the sensitivity of weapon distance sounds. This option allows you to adjust the distance for weapon sounds (for example when you hear a weapon firing mostly).	[/*][/list]
	[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Gear will now also auto-update if you pick up a better version than the gear you are currently wearing. This also goes for helmets.	[/*]	[*]		Swapping weapons will now remember attached attachments. Here is an example: [url=https://i.gyazo.com/c85091043d2df73db08b3f1b6eca2f17.mp4]https://i.gyazo.com/c85091043d2df73db08b3f1b6eca2f17.mp4[/url]	[/*]	[*]		Adjusted the auto-update backpack feature where you can now pick up backpacks even if your backpack is full, it will just put the backpack in your inventory. As long as the backpack is bigger, it will still auto-equip that backpack.	[/*]	[*]		Logging in to a server with a unskinned item will no longer un-attach attachments upon auto skinning to your favorite skin.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where grenades and other throwable items would not go to your quick slots when picking them up.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing the airdrop plane to stutter instead of flying through the air smoothly.	[/*][/list]
	[b]MODELS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed some texture/material related errors related to LOD versions of particular pine tree meshes.	[/*][/list]
	[b]VEHICLES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a texture issue related to the Tuk Tuk vehicle where the inside of the front glass had an incorrect texture.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to the newly added (not released yet) 'racer' vehicle. This vehicle is still work in progress but planned to be added soon.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ZOMBIES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		The "Night Zombies" (which were work in progress) no longer spawn. These were never intended to spawn in the first place as it was still work in progress. You can recognize a "Night Zombie" because it has a very dark texture with glowing eyes. Night Zombies will be released when they're ready.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing zombies to run around (glitched) in a t-pose animation.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed zombie aggro issues.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to zombies stacking up in groups causing huge performance drops.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Updated all (6) Heavy Armor Fallen Angel skins. We have reworked the wings, and moved them to a better spot so instead of them being attached to the shoulders they are now attached to the back of the armor. This was requested by the community in huge amounts. We have also optimized these skins better.	[/*][/list]
	[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to a missing texture related to the AWP sniper rifle.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the Scimitar melee rotation in both FPS and TPS when holding this melee.	[/*][/list]
	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the Heavy Armor store icons and all it's skinned variants.	[/*][/list]
	[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved the inspect animation for previewing a karambit (melee) or any of it's skins.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Open World Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]Caliwood (OW):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Removed some of the player spawns in the south side of the map.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Battle Royale Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a bug where sometimes players would get kicked while reviving a team mate.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing the auto selection of group Battle Royale games to not work correctly when in a party.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Arena (BR):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added radiation zones.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Tropico (BR):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added radiation zones.	[/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 3.0
notes.content:
[u] [/u][img]https://i.imgur.com/G5JSKDr.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8867-patch-30/)

	Here we are at Patch 3.0. Now, you might wonder why we are continuing our patch series from 3 now instead of the usual 2 and that's because next to splitting the Battle Royale game-mode into it's own game we have also done major improvements to the original game; New Z. The biggest most major change actually happened 1 patch ago where we ported New Z to 64-bit. Since this was such a huge change and improvement for the game we aimed to separately release that update first in case of any potential issues.

	Everyone who hasn't read the previous patch notes where we ported the game to 64-bit we would really recommend to read these patch notes at: [url=https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8800-patch-244/]https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8800-patch-244/[/url]

We would also like to announce that Infestation: Battle Royale is officially released on Steam now! Go check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RnWnALV.jpg[/img]

	Before we jump in to the patch notes of patch 3.0 we would recommend you all the watch the new dev-blog video from Fred where he goes over some of the points for the patch.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mptE5sNWuSk	

	Now, make sure to like and comment on the video while you're at it! Let's jump into the actual patch notes.

	 

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Various new content has been added for the new upcoming Season Pass #3. For more information about the season pass and it's content we recommend you all to check the content in-game after this update. We have added a lot of exciting and cool rewards so it's definitively worth to check this out! The new Season Pass #3 will be available for purchase directly after this update. Something new this season pass is that you can also be rewarded with any of the newly added in-game currencies.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed particular issues related to the navigation mesh system. (controls where zombies can walk and where not etc.)	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an error related to the Filipino localization which was causing the game to crash.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a shadow issue related to the pine tree models in Colorado when lighting quality was set on ultra.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug related to the account level system where a silver border would show for levels 400-410 even though it is supposed to be gold here.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a game crash that happened when changing the game from or to full screen or when changing resolution settings.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a visual graphics bug related to the SSAO setting along with the setting presets.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing the menu buttons to bug after using the bus or clan transport system in game.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a rare crash related to airdrops that had landed while a player was joining a server.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a game freeze related to zombies updating and multi-threading in 64-bit.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing your body to show invisible on the death screen when dieing in first-person.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when changing language in the server. This bug also caused the "hold E" menu to pop up and glitch.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed various UI visual bugs related to the in-game menu.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a terrain issue for far away textures.	[/*]	[*]		Added a new slider option for the render sharpness. This controls the render bias. Here is an example: [url=https://i.gyazo.com/1b8724ab4b62eb6d941f33735221ab37.mp4]https://i.gyazo.com/1b8724ab4b62eb6d941f33735221ab37.mp4[/url]	[/*]	[*]		Added back the option presets due to requests of the community. This means the presets; potato, low, medium, high and ultra are back. You can now also change individual settings after selecting an option preset without the preset switching.	[/*]	[*]		Added a skinbox opening animation. When opening a skinbox an animation will now play where you can visually see how close you were to getting that super rare skin! If you want to see how it looks we recommend you to watch the dev-blog video mentioned at the start of these patch notes.	[/*]	[*]		Added a system that will detect if the player is stuck in the water to aid release.	[/*]	[*]		Added a tips system that will help new players to get started with the game. You can disable tips in the game settings.	[/*]	[*]		Re-generated navigation mesh in 64-bit. This for better optimizations and to improve stability.	[/*]	[*]		Improved some of the level leading features to be multi-threaded for faster loading speed.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved the bus stop camera animation.	[/*]	[*]		Improved the reputation icons in the in-game HUD that you see when aiming at other players. The icons will no longer block the visibility of the level border on the character tags.	[/*]	[*]		Improved the airdrop animations. Should be a lot smoother now for both the falling crate and the plane.	[/*]	[*]		Attachments will now automatically attach to your weapon(s) when picking an attachment up that's supported by the weapon. For example: if you have no attachments attached to your M16, and you pick up a kobra sight, the kobra sight will automatically attach to your M16.	[/*]	[*]		Attachments will attempt to automatically attach to your compatible weapon(s) upon joining a server in both Open World and Survival. This means that if you join a server with an M16 and a kobra sight in your backpack, the kobra sight will be attached for you when successfully joined the server.	[/*]	[*]		Attaching and removing any attachment from any weapon will now correctly be synced with the hand animations.	[/*]	[*]		Picking up a backpack that has bigger inventory size than the backpack you are currently wearing will automatically switch your backpack to that one. For example: if you have a small backpack equipped and you find a large backpack, when you pick it up the large backpack will automatically be equipped.	[/*]	[*]		Quick slots will be "reserved" for consumables until the rest of the backpack can no longer hold more items. What happened before was that even weapons went in to the players' quick slots even though the weapon can not be used when being put in a quick slot.	[/*]	[*]		Optimized the HUD. Frames no longer drop when running or moving the camera around.	[/*]	[*]		The in-game minimap (M) will now update live with your position even when you are moving yourself.	[/*]	[*]		Using fast travel (bus or clan) will no longer break the depth of field.	[/*][/list]
	[b]VEHICLES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing players to fly up in to the air or to be teleported to a random position when leaving a vehicle.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the camera system for the vehicles: improved the car passenger(s) camera smoothing and the vehicle camera no longer rotates when opening the in-game menu.	[/*]	[*]		You can now slightly control a vehicle while being air-borne. This allows players to land properly and control the vehicle while being in the air.	[/*]	[*]		Added a feature that allows players to un stuck their vehicle by rolling and moving the vehicle slightly using the 'WASD' keys when the vehicle is stuck in or on something.	[/*]	[*]		Stats of the vehicles have been reworked with focus on stability. You should notice a great improvement in drivability.	[/*][/list]
	[b]LAUNCHER:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Our launcher now uses https for improved security.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Blue as a skin.	[/*]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Desert as a skin.	[/*]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Desert Goggles as a skin.	[/*]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Green as a skin.	[/*]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Urban Goggles as a skin.	[/*]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Forest as a skin.	[/*]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Forest Goggles as a skin.	[/*]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Camo as a skin.	[/*]	[*]		Added the M9 Helmet Sand as a skin.
		 	[/*]	[*]		With the M9 helmet variants being converted to skins there is a couple of things you guys should know. Every account that has logged in un till 1 months ago, will receive all the "default" m9 helmet skins learned.
		 	[/*]	[*]		New skins have been added to the Pink Graffiti collection! This includes: IBA Pink Graffiti, MTV Pink Graffiti, M. Style Helmet Heavy Pink Graffiti, IMI Tar-21 Pink Graffiti, M4A1 Pink Graffiti, M4 Semi Pink Graffiti, M4 Pink Graffiti, M16 Pink Graffiti, Mosin Nagant Pink Graffiti, MP7 Pink Graffiti, UZI Pink Graffiti. All these news skins are added to the currently available Pink Graffiti skinbox.
		 	[/*]	[*]		New skins have been added to the Hynx and Hynx v2 collection! This includes: Famas Hynx v2, AK-74M Hynx v2, M16 Hynx, MP5/10 Hynx, FN P90 Hynx v2, AKS-74U Hynx, G36 Hynx, IBA Hynx, MTV Hynx v2, M9 Helmet Hynx, M9 Helmet Hynx v2, M. Style Helmet Hynx, M. Style Helmet Hynx v2. All these new skins are added to the currently available Hynx skinbox.	[/*][/list]
	[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Updated the item name of the "M9 Helmet Black" to "M9 Helmet Basic". This to fit the conversion to skins for the other M9 helmets.	[/*][/list]
	[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed the Mauser SP66 Pink Graffiti skin glow map. This weapon skin now glows as it should be.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the dropped model for the Vindicator Skinbox that was showing the Valentine skinbox when being dropped on the ground.	[/*][/list]
	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the M. Style Helmet Heavy. Also reworked it's skinned variants.	[/*][/list]
	[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved the AA-12 Pink Graffiti. The iron sight is now skinned as well.	[/*]	[*]		Added a skinned iron sight for the AA-12 Halloween.	[/*]	[*]		Added a skinned iron sight for the AA-12 Winter.	[/*]	[*]		Added a skinned iron sight for the AA-12 Vindicator.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Open World Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]COLORADO V2 (OW):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a flying clan territory flag at the NATO base.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a player spawn that was under the terrain.	[/*][/list]
	[b]COLORADO V1:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Optimized the zombie spawns around the airport.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Survival Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a dedicated currency to the Survival game-mode. This is done based on the huge demand from the community. For now the in-game store won't have any items available for this currency (yet) except for the skin boxes that are available in the Open World for Game Dollars. This means that dedicated ONLY Survival players can now farm a similar free currency and have the ability to use this free currency to buy particular items just like how it has been in the Open World game-mode. We are also able to control the rate so for future events we are able to do double currency periods.	[/*]	[*]		Players can now trade Survival Dollars with other players through the trading menu just like how it is with Game Dollars in the Open World game-mode.	[/*][/list]
	[b]COLORADO V1:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Optimized the zombie spawns around the airport.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Battle Royale Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]

	In Patch 3.0 Battle Royale will be separated from the original Infestation: The New Z. This means players can no longer play the Battle Royale game-mode directly from the original game. A new separated variant of the game will be launched on March 4, 2020 aka tomorrow.

	Accounts including the skins, GC, experience and more are made global meaning you can use the same account with the same skins and currencies for both games. We recommend every player that would like more information about the Battle Royale release to visit the following links:
[list]	[*]		Steam page of Infestation: Battle Royale: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/[/url]	[/*]	[*]		Forum announcement with more information: [url=https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8827-infestation-battle-royale-free-to-play-coming-on-steam-march-4th/]https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8827-infestation-battle-royale-free-to-play-coming-on-steam-march-4th/[/url]	[/*]	[*]		We will save the original all-time Battle Royale leaderboards and reward top players in upcoming patch instead.	[/*][/list]
	With Battle Royale turning in to it's "own game" we have made a lot of tweaks and adjustments.
[list]	[*]		Added a dedicated currency to the Battle Royale game-mode. This is done based on the huge demand from the community. For now the in-game store won't have any items available for this currency (yet) except for the skin boxes that are available in the Open World for Game Dollars. This means that dedicated ONLY Battle Royale players can now farm a similar free currency and have the ability to use this free currency to buy particular items just like how it has been in the Open World game-mode. We are also able to control the rate so for future events we are able to do double currency periods.	[/*]	[*]		Battle Royale now has region selection. Players are now able to choose what region to queue in when choosing a map to queue on in the pre-queue screen in the main menu.	[/*]	[*]		You can now see how many players are currently playing a particular Battle Royale map per region in the pre-queue screen.	[/*]	[*]		The airdrop and safe zone icon / indicators have been added to the HUD radar. (The HUD radar is the radar on the top of the screen in Battle Royale that indicates what is north, south, east, west, etc.)	[/*]	[*]		Sprinting speeds has slightly been increased in the Battle Royale game-mode to fasten the overall gameplay experience.	[/*][/list]
	[b]LOOT:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Major changes have been made to the loot in the Battle Royale game-mode. A lot more items that are available in the game are now also available in Battle Royale. Of course all with controlled rarities. High end gear such as a heavy armor or a sniper are still only available from radiation zones or airdrops.
		
		For further feedback about the loot in Battle Royale we would like to invite all of you to let us know here: [url=https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5380-loot-battle-royale/]https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5380-loot-battle-royale/[/url]	[/*][/list]
	[b]COLORADO:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Colorado is now available as a Battle Royale map! We have made a custom variant of the known Colorado map fit for Battle Royale. With this initial addition the map and gameplay style varies a bit from other Battle Royale maps. These are noticeable changes:		[list]			[*]				Loot mainly spawns inside houses and buildings.			[/*]			[*]				Vehicles are available and can spawn anywhere around the map.			[/*]			[*]				Original safe zones have been turned in to radiation zones. You will need a gas mask to enter a radiation area. Gas masks spawn pretty much anywhere around a radiation area.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	[b]ARENA:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added more end-zones. Meaning, there is now a bigger variety of where the final safe zone of the Battle Royale game can be.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the overall lighting.	[/*][/list]
	[b]TROPICO:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added more end-zones. Meaning, there is now a bigger variety of where the final safe zone of the Battle Royale game can be.	[/*]	[*]		Vehicles are available and can spawn anywhere around the map.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the overall lighting.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ARIZONA V2:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added more end-zones. Meaning, there is now a bigger variety of where the final safe zone of the Battle Royale game can be.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the overall lighting.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Competitive Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a dedicated currency to the Competitive game-mode. This is done based on the huge demand from the community. For now the in-game store won't have any items available for this currency (yet) except for the skin boxes that are available in the Open World for Game Dollars. This means that dedicated ONLY Competitive players can now farm a similar free currency and have the ability to use this free currency to buy particular items just like how it has been in the Open World game-mode. We are also able to control the rate so for future events we are able to do double currency periods.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[b]Estimated patch size: Around 440 mb.[/b]

	[b]Patch ETA: Patch will roll out at this moment.[/b]

	[b]Estimated downtime: Around 1-2 hours. It's a big one.[/b]

	[u]Pre-patch notes might be changed if we need to fix / add something.[/u]

	 

	Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these patch notes with your friends and followers!

	For any feedback about the game or this patch please let us know at [url=http://playnewz.com/feedback]http://playnewz.com/feedback[/url]

	If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at: [url=https://suggest.playnewz.com/]https://suggest.playnewz.com/[/url]

	To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
	[b]Facebook:[/b] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/]https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/[/url]
	[b]Twitter:[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/infestationnewz]https://twitter.com/infestationnewz[/url]
	[b]Discord: [/b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz]https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz[/url]
	[b]Youtube:[/b] [url=http://www.youtube.com/c/InfestationTheNewZOfficial]http://www.youtube.com/c/InfestationTheNewZOfficial[/url]

	 

	Best Regards,

	 

	// Fredaikis

notes.title: Weekend Event
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5Jj16ql.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

	 

	The weekend is coming again and that means time for another weekend event!

	We would also like to remind all of you that this is the last actual weekend before our official "Infestation: Battle Royale" release. For more information about the upcoming Battle Royale release read: [url=https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8827-infestation-battle-royale-free-to-play-coming-on-steam-march-4th/]https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8827-infestation-battle-royale-free-to-play-coming-on-steam-march-4th/[/url]

	 

	For this weekend event we'll have it live the following period of time:

	 

	[u][u][b]START:[/b][/u][u][b] February 28, 2020 12:00 PM (CET)[/b][/u][/u]

	[u][u][b]END:[/b][/u][u][b] March 2, 2020 12:00 PM (CET)[/b][/u][/u]
	 

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ety24d7.jpg[/img]

	 

	Now, let's jump into further details about this weekend's weekend event:
[list]	[*]		[u][b]Survival Super Zombie Hunt (SURV)[/b][/u]
		All super zombies in the Survival game-mode have upgraded loot. This means there is a higher chance they drop better items.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Caliwood Double Game Dollars (OW)[/b][/u]
		All official Caliwood maps will give players double game dollars. Players can get game dollars from killing zombies and / or other players.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Battle Royale Loot Upgrade (BR)[/b][/u]
		The loot in the Battle Royale game-mode has gotten an upgrade. Weapons and other items that are normally unavailable in the Battle Royale game-mode now are. This goes for [b]any [/b]item.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Rocky Ford Headshot ONLY (PVP)[/b][/u]
		A new temporary Rocky Ford PVP map will be live with the head shot ONLY feature enabled. This feature means that you can only kill / do damage to other players when they land shots on the head. Enjoy!
		 	[/*][/list][list]	[*]		[u][b][u]ROUTINE:[/u] Battle Royale Map Rotation[/b][/u]
		As always, the main and only Battle Royale map will be changed. This time we are changing over from Arena to Tropico.
		N[u]ote: We change the map rotation in the Battle Royale game-mode every week due to the low(er) amount of players playing Battle Royale. If you have any suggestions, ideas or feedback please let us know at [url=https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5388-maps-battle-royale/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5388-maps-battle-royale[/url][/u]
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b][u]BONUS XSOLLA SALE: [/u]30% DISCOUNT on the 50€ GC package![/b][/u]
		This week we are doing a discount through our website (Xsolla) where if you purchase the 50€ package you'll get 30% discount. This means instead of the package costing 50€ it now costs 35€! Only through: [url=http://playnewz.com/buygc]http://playnewz.com/buygc[/url]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/ybYtVg4.jpg[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b][u]MARKETPLACE SALE: [/u][/b][b]Revolution Skinbox[/b][b] 50% DISCOUNT![/b][/u]
		This week we are doing a sale on the Revolution Skinbox where it's on 50% discount.

notes.title: INFESTATION: BATTLE ROYALE - FREE-TO-PLAY COMING ON STEAM MARCH 4TH!
notes.content:
Dear players,

	We are proud to announce the upcoming release of Infestation: Battle Royale on Steam!

	Infestation: BR is a zombie-infested Battle Royale set in the classic Infestation/WarZ environment. While much is recognizable, this release features massive updates, such as a 64-bit engine, new maps, new content, ranking system, friends system and season passes!

	Play alone or in groups of 3 in 100-player matches set in various maps including the classic Colorado. Earn rewards and make your way up the ranking system in this fast-paced Battle Royale. All this in a fair environment thanks to the custom made Fredaikis Anti-Cheat (FAC).

	Releasing on Steam March 4th, make sure to add it to your wishlist now already!

	[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/[/url]
	
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO THE CURRENT BATTLE ROYALE MODE?[/b]	[/*][/list]
	What started out as a beta has now grown so big that we decided it's time to make Battle Royale its own game. BR will be lifted out of New Z before the release and added to the launcher and Steam as a separate game. By doing so we hope to raise the attention of new players, and also players who are into Battle Royale games but not necessarily survival.  For the patch set for early March/late February we are bringing a lot of new content both to The New Z and Battle Royale such as Colorado V1 BR, massive vehicle improvements, performance optimizations, 64-bit gameplay, new loot with new spawn mechanisms etc.
[list]	[*]		[b]CAN I STILL USE MY NEW Z ACCOUNT? WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO MY PURCHASED CONTENT?[/b]	[/*][/list]
	Don't worry, you will still use the same account in order to log in. You will not lose anything from the splitting, all skins, sprays and other content which you've purchased in New Z will still be available in the new Battle Royale game.
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]OK, SO THE ACCOUNTS WILL STILL BE LINKED?[/b]	[/*][/list]
	[u]Correct, things like experience, season passes, account subscriptions will still be synced over both games, just like before. If you make a purchase in Infestation: Battle Royale it will be availible in The New Z and vice versa.[/u]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO THE CURRENT LEADERBOARDS?[/b]	[/*][/list]
	As this in a way means that Battle Royale is stepping out of Beta, hopefully with a great influx of new players - we feel that it makes sense to also reset the current leaderboards. This will be done on the Steam launch date - 4th of March - and high ranked players will be contacted and granted a special reward.
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]I DON'T PLAY BATTLE ROYALE, HOW IS THIS BENEFICIAL FOR ME?[/b]	[/*][/list]
	Our hope is that this will as well raise the public's attention to New Z and that it will help bring an influx of players to both games!
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]WHAT ABOUT NEW Z, WILL IT BE LEFT BEHIND?[/b]	[/*][/list]
	[b]NO! [/b]Together with the BR separation we are patching The New Z into patch 3.0! With the 64-bit additions and focus on performance improvements and bugs lately we think it's time for New Z to step into the next stage and we aim to bring you updates just like we have been for the past 4 years! [u]
More info about patch 3.0 will come at a later stage![/u]

	
	We hope this double-release (BR and Patch 3.0) brings you good news and that you are as excited as we are about this!
	
	Feel free to ask any questions you may have in the comment field below!
	
	Best Wishes from the Fredaikis team
