notes.title: Patch 2.44
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/H65rACS.jpg[/img]

	 

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8800-patch-244/)	 

	A new patch is rolling out as we speak with some major improvements and additions for the game. We have done a lot of work related to performance, improving loading speeds, fixing crashes and re-styled parts of the UI.

	We hope you like this update. Here are the notes:

	 

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed some spelling mistakes in the UI related to renaming a character in the main menu.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a major server bug causing the server to lagg when reaching a high amount of players.	[/*]	[*]		Our game servers now also run in 64-bit for improved performance and stability.	[/*]	[*]		Majorly improved the "loading game data" stage. This happens every time a player enters the main menu of the game. It is a lot faster now as we have made huge improvements to the loading speed of this process.	[/*]	[*]		Also improved the game loading time when a player loads into a server. It is a lot faster now to join a server and play.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some crashes related to changing the resolution or the when using the full screen option.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a crash related to using sprays.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a crash that happened when players tried starting their game with corrupted key bind settings.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed 2 different crashes related to the vehicle system.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing the servers located in Hong Kong to show as a US server in the "My Servers" menu in the main menu.	[/*]	[*]		Daily rewards and other notifications will now show separated per game-mode. This is because the daily rewards are now separated per game-mode as we have now added a daily reward system for the Survival game-mode as well.	[/*]	[*]		The trading lounge has been updated back to the original lounge.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Players no longer take damage when exiting a vehicle.	[/*][/list]
	[b]LAUNCHER:[/b]
[list]	[*]		The launcher will now set the game on default to 64-bit. You can still use the 32-bit version of the game.	[/*]	[*]		The launcher has been update to 60 FPS. (instead of 30)	[/*]	[*]		For those who missed it: we have updated our game launcher to a new style. Here is a preview:
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/LIiojV9.png[/img]	[/*][/list]
	[b]UI:[/b]
[list]	[*]		The UI of the game has been updated to 60 FPS. (instead of 30) This will finally make the UI feel smooth especially when for example moving items.	[/*]	[*]		General UI style has been updated trough out the entire main menu.	[/*][/list]
	[b]REWORKED OPTIONS UI:[/b]

	In this patch we have reworked the options UI. The old options UI was very outdated and limited us to add new features and next to that also was very inconvenient to use. The whole style and basic lay out has been reworked.

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/JMTC4hN.jpg[/img]

	Further improvements and options we have added next to reworking the UI are:
[list]	[*]		Added settings to change the default audio device. (Before players were not able to do this)	[/*]	[*]		Added an option to control anisotropy quality.	[/*]	[*]		Added an option to control the item color highlight setting in the main menu options UI as well.	[/*]	[*]		The "Overall Quality Option" does no longer override all the settings. This allows players to for example set their game to "HIGH" as overall quality but theyll still be able to change settings independently. (Before this was not possible)	[/*]	[*]		Players can now change pretty much all their settings inside the game. (Before they had to log out and do that in the main menu) There are some exceptions so not every single setting is available the in-game options UI.	[/*][/list]
	[img]https://i.imgur.com/a2ZEf2o.jpg[/img]

	[b]WINTER 2019-2020 EVENT:[/b]

	The major Winter 2019-2020 event is now over. Winter secret spots are removed from the maps, the item spawns related to the Winter event have been disabled and the Winter 2019 Box is no longer available. The staff craft (2) missions / trade-ins in Survival are still available to do but will be removed in the patch after this. If you have crystals left, trade them in so you can get your final staffs because this will be disabled as well soon.

	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a new skin for the K. Style Helmet: K. Style Helmet Shark Attack.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/14cZXZv.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the K. Style NVG: K. Style NVG Shark Attack.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/9a97i2S.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Custom Guerilla: Custom Guerilla Shark Attack.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/16GdWm7.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skinbox: Graffiti Skinbox. This skinbox will be released upon patch.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/4euTm06.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the SVD: SVD Pink Graffiti. This skin is part of the Pink Graffiti Collection and will be in the Pink Graffiti Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/uzctx3X.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Heavy Armor: Heavy Armor Pink Graffiti. This skin is part of the Pink Graffiti Collection and will be in the Pink Graffiti Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/tmI66FQ.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the K. Style NVG: K. Style NVG Pink Graffiti. This skin is part of the Pink Graffiti Collection and will be in the Pink Graffiti Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/mJn9VHj.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Custom Guerilla: Custom Guerilla Pink Graffiti. This skin is part of the Pink Graffiti Collection and will be in the Pink Graffiti Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/NEP4zmo.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Adventure Backpack: Adventure Backpack Pink Graffiti. This skin is part of the Pink Graffiti Collection and will be in the Pink Graffiti Skinbox.

	[b]ASSAULT RIFLES REWORK:[/b]

	The AR Rework is finally here and as we've shown on our[b] [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8744-devblog-assault-rifles-rework/]DevBlog[/url][/b] last month, we aimed to make ARs a feasible option in PVP again. We have pretty much looked at each of the ARs individually and gave them a very special attention, which is something they really required. All the ARs have been changed in some way and some more than others. Though we won't go into much details on this as this is something for you guys to find on your own, you will notice that some guns will server specific purposes better than others, but they should all be pretty balanced out. Some of these ARs were also put as a second thought to players and they are now a very good option for PVP, depending on your style. Rather than focusing only on the main guns, we've made these changes to make them make more sense as well. For example, lighter guns will have a greater recoil while having a good speed for close encounters. Some others should be good enough to punish sniper users who miss too many shots. We went through a period of testing with some players and partners and using the feedback, adjusted them accordingly. We may make small adjustments to them later on but for now we are all (including the players who were part of the testing process) very happy with this balance. They are better than they were, but they are not extremely overpowered. We would also like to hear your feedback on these changes, as they will not only affect the PVP players but also PVE as they'll be able to farm zombies in a better way.

	You can find further information about the AR rework development here (also for feedback): [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8796-ar-rework/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8796-ar-rework/[/url]

notes.title: Patch 2.42
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bFdaMAm.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

	 

	A smaller patch to fix some issues, do some improvements and to disable the Christmas 2019 content. Quick note here: the Christmas 2019 event and content is disabled meaning that the Christmas trees are gone, Christmas loot is no longer spawning etc. although the major Winter event is still active and running.

	Now, in this update we are also introducing a smaller feature called the Waypoint System.

	We are working very hard on a bigger patch for 2.43 but for now this update was mandatory to be rolled out.

	 

	Enjoy!

	 

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Removed all the Christmas content from the maps. Christmas 2019 event is fully disabled now.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to trading game dollars where when players traded over 2.1 billion game dollars the game dollars number would show incorrect or glitch after trading.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed / improved overall server stability and connection.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue causing the report message box to stay open and bug your game after you revive yourself.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed backpack name text being too large for it's container. Sometimes the text wouldn't properly resize when it was too long.	[/*]	[*]		Increased the clan territory transport spawn protection from 5 to 10 seconds. 	[/*][/list]
	[b]TAUNTS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a new taunt: "Dance V1".
[previewyoutube=G1g1eZqT5EI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[/*][/list]








	[b]WAYPOINT SYSTEM:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a new system: The Waypoint System. Using this system players can mark a location on their minimap. This location will only show for yourself. You will be able to see the set waypoint on your minimap, in the in-game HUD and in the HUD compass. This will make it easier to travel to a set location without having to open the minimap all the time.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/jDdB4jb.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/2NbWW3g.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	[b]SLICER ZOMBIE:[/b]
[list]	[*]		The new slicer zombie is almost ready! We are currently doing final testing so we can 99% sure say that in the next upcoming patch the new creature will be released into the worlds of New Z! Now, one of the things left to do for us is to decide it's spawn behavior. When should it spawn, and where. If you guys have any ideas feel free to let us know in the comments!
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/avHRbm5.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed the K. Style NVG Devil Horn textures. The skin wasn't using the correct textures.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the iron sight for the AK-12. There was two iron sights colliding with each other before. (Example of the fixed issue: [url=https://prnt.sc/qnefui]https://prnt.sc/qnefui[/url])	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the description of the L85 Christmas 2019.	[/*][/list]
	[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved overall assault rifle statistics. We are currently working on advancing and balancing out even further for the assault rifles but in this patch we have made tweaks already to the system that affects all the assault rifles at once.	[/*][/list]
	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Light Gear and it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Medium Armor and it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the MTV Armor and it's skinned variants.	[/*][/list]
	[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved the iron sight for the Thompson. Also fixed this for the skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Improved the iron sight for the AS VAL. Also fixed this for the skinned variants.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Open World Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]LOOT:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Decreased chances on super zombies for: AR Stock, AR Barrel, Sniper Stock, Sniper Barrel.	[/*]	[*]		Decreased chances on alien super zombies for common items making rare items a bit more common.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Oregon (OW):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Updated the minimap. Opened up more of the playable area.	[/*][/list]
	[b]COLORADO V1 (OW):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a miss-placed stair in Campos City where the players were able to look under the building.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some miss-placed objects at the airport. Some were flying or clipping through other objects.	[/*][/list]
	[b]MIRROR FIELDS (PVP):[/b]
[list]	[*]		The new PVP map has been added to the rotation. This new map will be released right after the update.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/tmi7FiF.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/2HFrTEj.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/dR6ulOf.jpg[/img]

	[u]Pre-patch notes might be changed if we need to fix / add something.[/u]

	 

	Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these patch notes with your friends and followers!

notes.title: Christmas 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zhcijTN.png[/img]

	 

	Dear Community,

	 

	The time is finally there! Christmas is coming and that means Christmas Events in New Z! This year we have a new Christmas 2019 box together with Double XP, GD events, a free premium weekend and A LOT more! For all details read the thread below!

	 

	Before we jump into the event(s) we'd like to wish all of you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year.

	 

	Something worth to mention is that the Christmas 2019 event is an event that is applied on top of the Winter 2019 event. So, from this moment two events will be active. When the Christmas 2019 event ends the Winter 2019 event will stay active. For more information about the Winter 2019 event go to: [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8542-winter-2019/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8542-winter-2019/[/url]

	 

	 

	[u]Christmas 2019![/u]

	 

	 

	Welcome to the official Christmas 2019 event announcement!

	 

	Before we jump into any event details let's make it clear over what period of time this event is taking place:

	 

	[u][b]Start: December 20, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.[/b][/u]

	[u][b]End: January 6, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b][/u]

	 

	Now, let's jump into the details of the event:

	 

	[u][b]Double XP & GD:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		During this Christmas event there will be separate Double XP & GD events per game-mode. Also, there will be multiple moments that Double XP & GD will be activated. This means that it might happen that only a certain game-mode has a 'double' event active at a particular time. Here is exact moments per game-mode:
		
		[u]Double XP Survival Moment #1:[/u]
		[b]Start: Saturday, December 21, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.[/b]
		[b]End: Friday, December 27, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.[/b]
		
		[u]Double XP Open World Moment #1:[/u]
		[b]Start: Saturday, December 21, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.
		End: Friday, December 27, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.[/b]
		
		[u]Double GD Open World Moment #1:[/u]
		[b]Start: Tuesday, December 24, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.[/b]
		[b]End: Friday, December 27, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/T4gu57C.jpg[/img][/b]
		
		[u]Double XP Survival Moment #2:[/u]
		[b]Start: Friday, January 3, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b]
		[b]End: Monday, January 6, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b]
		
		[u]Double XP Open World Moment #2:[/u]
		[b]Start: Friday, January 3, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b]
		[b]End: Monday, January 6, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b]
		
		[u]Double GD Open World Moment #2:[/u]
		[b]Start: Friday, January 3, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b]
		[b]End: Monday, January 6, 12:00 PM (CET) 2020.[/b]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/s16FniU.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Christmas Free Premium:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Also in this event we will do a free premium period! This means that every account that logs in in the particular period of time, will have premium for a certain amount of time. Always wanted to try out premium? Here is your chance!
		
		[u]Free Premium Weekend:[/u]
		[b]Start: Wednesday, December 25, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.[/b]
		[b]End: Monday, December 30, 12:00 PM (CET) 2019.[/b]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/MVcerwy.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Christmas 2019 Content:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		During the event we will release some new items. Here is a list and how to get them:
		
		[u][b][u]All the new content:[/u][/b][/u]
		 		[list]			[*]				[b]Christmas Box 2019:[/b]
				Will be available in the in-game marketplace and findable in-game but very rare.
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/4HkWa1j.png[/img]
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Skins:[/b]
				The following will only be available from the Christmas Box 2019:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/iHkjDk0.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/WOXjvnl.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Xi3c4we.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/AwzHMRm.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/IDHs8ee.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/t1Ul3tV.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/NG0fo7Q.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/QW6QHbv.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/RVFphFs.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/pbgltiB.png[/img]
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Returning Skins:[/b]
				The following will be returning from previous year(s):
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/NBnLUAQ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/D86FlK1.png[/img]
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Sprays:[/b]
				The following will only be available from the Christmas Box 2019:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/AkNUT1N.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/NVnKqwj.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/5SChA3P.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/GesFBxB.png[/img]
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Character Clothes:[/b]
				Will only be directly available through the character customize menu. (You can buy them there)
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/MA8iLl8.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/oC8Wvtr.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/oGNyxz8.png[/img]
				Also, some character clothes will come back from previous years so keep an eye open in the selection.
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Items:[/b]
				The following items will be ONLY available during the event:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/l74dOjV.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/NLTAnOx.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/7NVT97T.png[/img]
				And these items are returning from previous years:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/rbvI1Cz.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/xGpTanX.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/BgEG3X0.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZP6PdQ8.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/P7Jnkri.png[/img]			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Loot:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		During the Christmas 2019 event there will be advanced loot tables including all the items mentioned above spawning.
		All of the loot mentioned above will be spawning in both game-modes. However, for Survival, chances will vary and not be the same as in the Open World game-mode.
		This also includes:		[list]			[*]				Christmas themed zombies. (all game-modes) These zombies will drop and sometimes be equipped with Christmas themed items.			[/*]			[*]				Christmas type of loot will be dropped all over the maps. (all game-modes)			[/*]			[*]				(Upgraded) Winter secret spots will drop Christmas themed loot and spawn Christmas themed zombies.
				
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/6bkOvXJ.jpg[/img]			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Exclusive Ruby Staff PVE Loot Event:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		This time we are back with another exclusive item: the "Ruby Staff of Power". This melee is part of the three staffs that are released during the Winter 2019 event and this "Ruby Staff of Power" is the third being released ONLY during the Christmas 2019 event.
		
		How to get the staff? That basically works the same way as for the Emerald and Sapphire staff: Find the "Ruby Crystals" and:
		- For Survival: Craft a 100 Ruby Crystals into 1 Ruby Staff of Power.
		- For Open World: Trade in a 100 Ruby Crystals for 1 Ruby Staff of Power. (In the Trading Lounge through the repeatable mission)
		
		[b]Remember! The Ruby Staff and Crystals are ONLY available during the Christmas 2019 event. [/b]
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/7NVT97T.png[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Christmas & New Year's Sales:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Throughout the entire event there will be special sales and flash sales. Stay tuned and keep an eye open in our in-game marketplace. Sales will be announced through the official Infestation: The New Z social media channels.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Christmas Secret Spots:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		In both Open World and Survival there is special dedicated Christmas themed secret spots in Colorado V2, V1, Caliwood and Oregon. Now, you might have already found one of the spots as we have to patch these in during a patch before the event starts. However you will then have noticed that Christmas loot hasn't spawned there yet. Christmas loot will simply be live on those locations as soon as the Christmas 2019 Event starts. notes.title: Season Pass 02
notes.content:
Dear Community,

(Original Post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8610-season-pass-02/) 

	After releasing the first Season Pass ever for Infestation: The New Z we have received A LOT of feedback. We proudly present to you: Season Pass 02. We have made this Season Pass based on all of your feedback and aim to have this fit more to New Z and it's player base.

	The most important criteria point that we have used your feedback on is the [b]price[/b]. Although in Season Pass 01 you'd get "what you pay for" back in terms of skin boxes and GC, it was still set to a very high base price for a lot of players. For some even to an unaffordable level. Season Pass 02 is a lot cheaper and set to a base price of 1500 GC. That is 3500 GC cheaper than the price of Season Pass 01! Next to all of this in Season Pass 02 players can get up to 500 GC back by completing the pass. This GC you can get back is extra next to all the normal rewards including skinboxes, unique skin recipes, sprays and more!

	Next to the price you guys have complained about the [b]duration[/b]. Season Pass 01 did indeed have a relative short period of time that players had to complete the pass. This was set to about a month. (even less) For Season Pass 02 we have increased the duration to 2 months+. We think this should give you all enough time to complete the Season Pass. To not over complicate things we have left the levels and XP needed to reach them the same, just so we can process the feedback in two segments. Price and duration were the most important so this is what we have focused on.

	Season Pass 02 has been released and enabled at this moment and will end: [b]29 February, 2020 at 12:00 PM (CET).[/b]

	[b]Wondering what's in it for you before purchasing the pass?[/b] In the main menu there is a button called "Season Pass" where you can preview the Season Pass's content before purchasing the pass. Remember, XP progress on the pass only starts counting [b]after [/b]you purchase the pass.

	 

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/xv1AgL9.jpg[/img]

	 

	Have any further feedback about the Season Pass? Let us know in this dedicated feedback section: [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8564-season-pass/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8564-season-pass/[/url]

	 

	Thank you for your support!

	 

	Best Regards,

	 

	// The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Weekend Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WpE1goI.jpg[/img]

	 

	Dear Community,
	 

	Are you ready for another weekend event?! Before we jump into the actual weekend event we'd like to remind to you that we have just released patch 2.40. For patch notes go here: [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8541-patch-240/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8541-patch-240/[/url]

	Also, the new Winter 2019 major event has finally started. We are releasing a new box, new map, new trading lounge and a lot more further content! Winter 2019 is a major event and will be active for the upcoming 2-3 months. For information go to: [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8542-winter-2019/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8542-winter-2019/[/url]

	 

	 

	For this weekend event we'll have it live the following period of time:

	 

	[u][u][b]START:[/b][/u][u][b] November 29, 2019 12:00 PM (CET)[/b][/u][/u]

	[u][u][b]END:[/b][/u][u][b] December 2, 2019 12:00 PM (CET)[/b][/u][/u]

	 

	Now, let's jump into further details about this weekend's weekend event:

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lif4hQs.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]		[u][b]Free Revive Weekend.[/b][/u]
		Revive will be free this weekend for anyone that doesn't have premium!
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Battle Royale Madness.[/b][/u]
		In Battle Royale Madness we shake up the loot completely. Snipers, strong weapons, riot shields and all other good items that normally don't spawn in the Battle Royale game mode are now spawning! Last "Battle Royale Madness" event the snipers were a bit too common so this time we'll adjust that and have them more rare.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Caliwood Double Reputation. (OW / SURV)[/b][/u]
		In Caliwood for both the Open World and the Survival game-mode all reputation gained will be doubled. This only goes for official servers. 
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Camo Skinbox from Super Zombies (OW / SURV).[/b][/u]
		The Camo Skinbox is now spawning from Super Zombies in both the Open World and Survival game-mode. Note that the skinbox is rare to drop so you're going to have to kill a lot of Super Zombies to get an actual Camo Skinbox! Good luck!
		 	[/*][/list][list]	[*]		[u][b][u]ROUTINE:[/u] Battle Royale Map Rotation[/b][/u]
		As always, the main and only Battle Royale map will be changed. This time we are changing over from Tropico to Arizona.
		N[u]ote: We change the map rotation in the Battle Royale game-mode every week due to the low(er) amount of players playing Battle Royale. If you have any suggestions, ideas or feedback please let us know at [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5388-maps-battle-royale/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5388-maps-battle-royale/[/url][/u]
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/kUXZkJK.jpg[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b][u]SALE:[/u] Black Friday Sale![/b][/u]
		50% discount on all skinboxes only for the upcoming 24 hours!
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lo1VLhi.jpg[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b][u]EXTRA:[/u] Streamer Event![/b][/u]
		Stream New Z for at least 6 hours in total this weekend and earn a 1000 GC reward!
		[u][b]How to redeem your reward?[/b][/u]
		To redeem your reward you'll have to send a private message to ElChupacabra#4582 on Discord.
		[b][u]What are the rules?[/u][/b]
		1. Past Broadcast must be saved and open for anyone to view. 
		2. Stream needs to be of Infestation: The New Z gameplay. 
		3. AFK Streams will be instantly ignored.
		4. Game must be streamed under Infestation: The New Z.
		5. You need to stream using the Twitch account linked to your Infestation: The New Z account.
		6. Stream at least 6 hours in total this weekend. This also means you could for example do 2 streams that are 3 hours+ each.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b][u]MARKETPLACE SALE:[/u] Random Skins + Solari Skinbox discount![/b][/u]
		This time we are doing a sale on a lot of random skin recipes. Some of the skins are available for direct purchase in the in-game marketplace and the Solari skinbox is on a 15% discount! Also some other more random skins are available in the in-game marketplace for this week!
		[u]Note: This sale is a weekly one so has already started before the weekend event and will not have the same start-end times as the weekend event.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/9QdKXBY.jpg[/img][/u]	[/*][/list]
	 

	Please let us know what you think of this weekend event so that we can use that feedback in the future for new weekend events! If you have any ideas or suggestions feel free to share that as well as we might be able to use your idea for upcoming weekend events!

	NEW! Feedback thread for weekend event(s). Have anything to share, any ideas, feedback or complaints about the weekend event(s)? Let us know at: [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8532-feedback-weekend-event/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8532-feedback-weekend-event/[/url]

	 

	If you experience any type of issue(s) with the game please contact us through social media or create a support ticket at[url=https://playnewz.com/support.php/]https://playnewz.com/support.php/[/url]

	For any feedback about the game or this patch please let us know at [url=http://playnewz.com/feedback]http://playnewz.com/feedback[/url]

	If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at: [url=https://suggest.playnewz.com/]https://suggest.playnewz.com/[/url]

	To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
	[b]Facebook:[/b] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/]https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/[/url]
	[b]Twitter:[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/infestationnewz]https://twitter.com/infestationnewz[/url]
	[b]Discord: [/b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz]https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz[/url]

	 

	 

	Have a nice weekend!

	 

	// Sven

	 

	// The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Winter 2019

	For this major event there is no particular end date set yet but it will be up for around 2-3 months from now.

	This event is much more than just a weekend or week event. It's starting now, with  the release of this patch and will end in around 2-3 months. The event can be considered as a seasonal event. notes.title: Patch 2.40
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6vMSN3v.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8541-patch-240/)

	Good morning! It's time for patch 2.40 which includes the release of the base building system in Survival, the winter 2019 major event has officially started, we are about to release a new type of zombie and on top of that a lot of fixes and improvements!

	 

	Now, without further ado, let's jump straight into the patch notes.

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]WINTER 2019:[/b]

	It's time to announce and enable our major Winter 2019 event. This event is much more than just a weekend or week event. It's starting now, with  the release of this patch and will end in around 2-3 months. The event can be considered as a seasonal event. This means all features listed below will only be active and available during the event period. Here's what we have for you guys:
[list]	[*]		Winter 2019 Trading Lounge & PVP Map.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/Brh5ME8.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/l3uf4uk.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/93KFZZa.jpg[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		Winter themed Season Pass #2. More about this soon. Season pass won't be instantly released at this patch but will be released soon after, most likely the Monday after the weekend event which will be December 2, 2019.
		 	[/*]	[*]		Winter 2019 Box. Brand new content including the new "Winter Camo" skin set. Also includes items such as the Riot Shield Winter Camo, Snow Ball Grenade and the Bear Hat to keep you warm this winter! Check the icons below or just check the content of the box in the in-game marketplace.		[list]			[*]				Box will be available in the in-game marketplace for GC.			[/*]			[*]				Box will be spawning from Super Zombies, Alien Super Zombies, Toxic Super Zombies & rare loot in both Open World and Survival.
				The Box:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/9tDCokQ.png[/img]
				Item Content:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/n02vNcy.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/9TJWI9U.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/6RDk5qR.png[/img]
				Skin Content:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/XmVdEXT.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/UcEt33V.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/sHApbTf.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/dg20glS.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/iAL6ZyC.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/yuHfXQl.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/34CrYZv.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/0r1oxqG.png[/img]			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Winter 2019 staves. 2 Special collectable unique staffs that players both in the Open World and Survival game-mode can grind for. Here are the two staves:		[list]			[*]				Sapphire Staff of Hope
				The Sapphire brings the power of hope. A hope for a better world. A hope for a better life. Hope in humanity. Hope in the future.
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/9qkD0CI.png[/img]			[/*]			[*]				Emerald Staff of Wisdom
				The green emerald emanates the light, which has the power of wisdom. Just by being in the presence of it will help you understand the world.
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7bmWVG.png[/img]
				Now, you might wonder how to get them. This is different in Open World and Survival. Below we will explain how to get the staff(s):
				In both game-modes players can find and collect so called 'crystals'. There is two crystals added:			[/*]			[*]				Sapphire Crystal
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z2baBBh.png[/img]			[/*]			[*]				Emerald Crystal
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/LbXZFi8.png[/img]
				And here is what to do with the crystals once you have enough:			[/*]			[*]				Open World: Players can trade in 250 Sapphire OR 250 Emerald Crystals in the trading lounge (using the repeatable mission) at the vending machine. For 250 of each crystal you can get a unique staff. You can collect and trade in as many as you want.			[/*]			[*]				Survival: Players can craft 250 Sapphire OR 250 Emerald Crystals in a Sapphire or Emerald Staff. For 250 of each crystal you can get a unique staff. You can collect and craft as many as you want.
				 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Winter 2019 Secret Spots. Secret winter spots players can find and farm at in both Open World and Survival. Winter secret spots can be found on the following maps: Colorado V2, Colorado V1, Caliwood, Oregon. Winter spots have a higher concentration of spawning winter related items including crystals and the Winter 2019 box.
		 	[/*]	[*]		Winter 2019 Character clothes. Available for purchase through the character selection screen. Winter 2019 Character clothes will be available for the following characters: Rockin' Rolla, Hunter, Ex Cage Fighter and Club Promoter.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added big amounts of content for the Christmas 2019 event already. More info about this will follow throughout December. Christmas 2019 event planned start date is December 20, 2019.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where not all map filters would show on the servers list in the main menu.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug related to the taunt system where your game would glitch when using a taunt.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a crash that happened when leaving a group.	[/*][/list]
	[b]MODELS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to the Halloween circus tent models where players could glitch from the inside through the wall to the outside.	[/*][/list]
	[b]CHARACTERS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added rank 1 character skins for November 2019.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ZOMBIES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a new super zombie type: The Slicer. This is a new unique kind of big/super zombie in New Z. At the moment we are still testing it and making sure it's 100% working before we release it but we're at a stage now that we are 99% sure it will be released very soon. The slicer has unique sounds, animations, stats and behavior. It's around the same size as a super zombie but has a lot more health.
		
		The slicer won't be released just yet but you all can expect it will be released in both Open World and Survival very soon. We will finalize its stats and AI and when we release the Slicer we will let you all know exactly how it will behave, how much health it will have etc.
		
		For now, here is some preview pictures:
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/67ntsel.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/c8MjHER.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/y4wpkQT.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Melees now have separated player and zombie damage values. This allowed us to change and adjust the damage values for melees better and more in-depth. We have left the damage against zombies for melees the same while we have lowered the damage of most of the melees against players. There is now also a new bar added in the statistics UI (when selecting a melee) that shows the damage vs. a player and/or against a zombie.	[/*][/list]
	[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to dropping taunt recipes where there was no model. There is now a model and it's no longer invisible.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to the FN Scar CQC Desion where it had too much reflection on some maps.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to the M4 Desion where it had too much reflection on some maps.	[/*][/list]
	[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Sprays now have their own TPS/dropped model. When dropping any spray on the ground there now is a spray can model.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a new normal Riot Shield: Riot Shield Golden Tar Gibelin. This is a shield dedicated to the player who had the most kills on the last New Z Super Cup.	[/*]	[*]		Added a new clan Riot Shield: Riot Shield 24HR.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Open World Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]PVP SERVERS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Spawns in PVP servers will now check for the spawn with the least amount of players nearby.	[/*][/list]
	[b]COLORADO V2:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Adjusted the fog level around night time. Slightly increased the amount of fog on further distances around 11 PM in-game time.	[/*][/list]
	[b]CALIWOOD:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Adjusted the fog level. Slightly increased the amount of fog on further distances.
		 	[/*][/list]
	[u][b][u]Survival Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]BUILDING SYSTEM RELEASE:[/b]
[list]	[*]		It's time we take the building system to the next level. After this patch we will enable building on at least 1 Colorado V2 server per region. We'd like to see first how the Survival players react to this and based on further feedback we might make final changes before we enable building on all Survival servers.
		We are able to turn building on/off per server dynamically without restarting anything so if all goes according to plan expect every Survival server to have building enabled later on.
		
		We expect feedback and therefore we have created this dedicated forum thread where you all can write any feedback and ideas you might have about the building system. Here is the link: [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8538-building-system/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8538-building-system/[/url]	[/*][/list]
	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added the base build hammer to the crafting list. You need the following materials to be able to craft this hammer: 10x Wood, 8x Metal, 2x Glue, 1x Nails.	[/*]	[*]		Added the cupboard to the crafting list. You need the following materials to be able to craft this hammer: 25x Metal.	[/*]	[*]		Exchange missions have been updated:		[list]			[*]				Consumables Exchange				[list]					[*]						Exchange 3x Water 375ml for 1x Electro-AID.					[/*]				[/list]			[/*]			[*]				Pistol Exchange				[list]					[*]						Exchange 5x Kurger .22 for 1x Desert Eagle.					[/*]				[/list]			[/*]			[*]				Assault Rifle Exchange				[list]					[*]						Exchange 2x Scar CQC for 1x Scar Night Stalker.					[/*]				[/list]			[/*]			[*]				Sub Machine Gun Exchange				[list]					[*]						Exchange 2x Thompson for 1x P90S.					[/*]				[/list]			[/*]			[*]				Mixed Exchange				[list]					[*]						Exchange 2x PKM Ammo Box for 5x Stanag 30.					[/*]				[/list]			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	[b]COLORADO V1:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Removed the radiation zone from Clearview since there is a high concentration of PVP in this area.	[/*][/list]
	[b]CALIWOOD:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Adjusted the fog level. Slightly increased the amount of fog on further distances.	[/*]	[*]		Harvestable resources have been added to the map. This means players can now also farm wood, metal and stone in this map.	[/*]	[*]		Also added "no building" areas everywhere to prevent players to build in particular areas.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the terrain around the safe zone. The safe zone is no longer clipping inside the terrain and overall terrain has been made smoother.	[/*]	[*]		Players can now also do the exchange missions in Caliwood.	[/*][/list]
	 

	 

	 

	Before we end these patch notes let's talk about what you guys can expect to be coming in terms of event(s).
[list]	[*]		Black Friday Sale on November 29, 2019	[/*]	[*]		Christmas Calendar starting December 1, 2019 and ending December 25, 2019.	[/*]	[*]		Christmas 2019 event starting December 20, 2019 and ending January 6, 2019.	[/*][/list]
	 

	 

	[b]Estimated patch size: around 900 mb.[/b]

	[b]Patch ETA: update will roll out as soon as possible.[/b]

	[b]Estimated downtime: around one hour.[/b]

	[u]Pre-patch notes might be changed if we need to fix / add something.[/u]

notes.title: Weekend Event!
notes.content:

notes.title: Halloween 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dLDwcOE.png[/img]

	Leave your lights on tonight. This won't be pretty. Halloween comes once a year and it always comes with a bang. You will see horrible things, you will hear horrible things and you will most definitely feel horrible things. Now, now... If you think a world filled with zombies is scary enough, it's time to revisit that part of your brain. No, zombies are not the scariest part of this story... Always be on your toes as anything can hit you from anywhere. From monsters, to ghosts, to witches, to demons. But the scariest part of it all, is and will always be. Humans. Yes... Humans will take everything you own. They will kill you on sight. They will hunt you down throughout the lands of Colorado, Caliwood, Oregon, Arizona and even on the peaceful island Tropico. I have one advice for you... Don't be afraid... Be terrified. 

	 

	 

	They're here...

	 

	 

	[u]Halloween 2019![/u]

	 
(Original Announcement: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8432-halloween-2019-event/)
	 

	Welcome to the official Halloween 2019 event announcement!

	 

	Before we jump into any event details let's make it clear over what period of time this event is taking place:

	 

	[u][b]Start: October 25, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b][/u]

	[u][b]End: November 4, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b][/u]

	 

	Now, let's jump into the details of the event:

	 

	[u][b]Double XP & GD:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		During this Halloween event there will be separate Double XP & GD events per game-mode. This means that it might happen that only a certain game-mode has a 'double' event active at a particular time. Here is exact moments per game-mode:
		
		[u]Double XP Survival:[/u]
		[b]Start: Monday, October 28, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b]
		[b]End: Monday, November 4, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b]
		
		[u]Double XP Open World:[/u]
		[b]Start: Wednesday, October 30, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b]
		[b]End: Monday, November 4, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b]

		[b]Start: Thursday, October 31, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b]
		[b]End: Monday, November 4, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/ASRUjlE.jpg[/img][/b]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Halloween Free Premium Weekend:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Also in this event we will do a free premium weekend! This means that every account that logs in in the particular period of time, will have premium for a certain amount of time. Always wanted to try out premium? Here is your chance!

		[b]Start: Thursday, October 31, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b]
		[b]End: Monday, November 4, 12:00 PM (CEST) 2019.[/b]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/DnlvYQt.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Halloween 2019 Content:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		During the event we will release some new items. Here is a list and how to get them:
		
		[u][b][u]All the new content:[/u][/b][/u]
		 		[list]			[*]				[b]Halloween Box 2019:[/b]
				Will be available in the in-game marketplace and findable in-game but very rare.
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/ep0bmhu.png[/img]
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Skins:[/b]
				The following will only be available from the Halloween Box 2019:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/7bJ75Ef.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/OaNwTPf.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/h3CUhSG.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/yrDZqEm.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/E2URJKZ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Il80UKH.png[/img]
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Sprays:[/b]
				The following will only be available from the Halloween Box 2019:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/UWJPFRG.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/z3rnRmm.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/cFRlfW8.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/P0OTgbu.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/iKJNFk4.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/FktTsnZ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bCPBwZ9.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/SzLl18c.png[/img]
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Character Clothes:[/b]
				Will only be directly available through the customize menu.
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/6etHzGA.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/gOGD6Pp.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/EmfdiVY.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/mOmNj1u.png[/img]
				Also, some character clothes will come back from previous years so keep an eye open in the selection.
				 			[/*]			[*]				[b]Items:[/b]
				The following items will be ONLY available during the event:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/3PwuNmR.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/WJSkWn9.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/BxKHdEo.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZmcaPmU.png[/img]

				[img]https://i.imgur.com/UKPFX94.png[/img]
				And these items are returning from previous years:

	[u][b]Loot:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		During the Halloween 2019 event there will be advanced loot tables including all the items mentioned above spawning.

(all game-modes)			[/*]			[*]				Halloween secret spots will drop Halloween themed loot and spawn Halloween themed zombies.

	[u][b]Exclusive Blue Scythe PVE Loot Event:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		This time we are back with another exclusive item: the "Blue Scythe". This is a melee that does a lot of damage and will only ever be available through the Halloween 2019 event. How to get it? You'll simply have to be lucky. This item will be very rare and available in both the Open World and Survival game-mode. This item is spawning through the entire Halloween 2019 event period.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/nTS36YM.png[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Halloween 2019 Box Finger Event:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Besides that you'll be able to find or buy the Halloween 2019 Box there will be another way to get this box. We have added a new item; the "Finger". Fingers can be found and used to be exchanged for a Halloween 2019 Box. Here is for both game-modes how it will work:
		
		[b]Survival:[/b]
		Find 10 fingers and use them to craft 1 Halloween 2019 box. You can do this anywhere in any map at any time as long as you have 10 fingers in your inventory. It will remove the 10 fingers from your inventory and give you 1 Halloween 2019 Box. Fingers are spawning everywhere and drop from zombies, you have the highest chance of finding one of the Halloween secret spot(s).
		
		[b]Open World:[/b]
		Find 10 fingers and use them to trade for 1 Halloween 2019 box. You can do this only in the trading lounge (map) at any time as long as you have 10 fingers in your inventory. You'll have to open your missions and accept the trade in mission, it will tell you what to do. It will remove the 10 fingers from your inventory and give you 1 Halloween 2019 Box. Fingers are spawning everywhere and drop from zombies, you have the highest chance of finding one of the Halloween secret spot(s).
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/lZuXVlA.png[/img]	[/*][/list]

	[u][b]Halloween Secret Spots:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		In both Open World and Survival there is special dedicated Halloween themed secret spots in Colorado V2, V1, Caliwood and Oregon. Now, you might have already found one of the spots as we have to patch these in during a patch before the event starts. However you will then have noticed that loot hasn't spawned there yet. Halloween loot will simply be live on those locations as soon as the Halloween 2019 Event starts. Once again for Survival chances will vary and not be the same as in the Open World game-mode.
		Check further under "Loot" to see further details about the loot.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/paB8KSp.png[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Halloween Themed Trading Lounge & PVP map:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		The trading Lounge will turn into a scary Halloween themed map. Scare your friends away using Halloween skins and Halloween items & trade in style!
		 	[/*]	[*]		There will be a new PVP map available. This is the same map we use as trading Lounge. Ready to scare all your enemies away?!
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/sMLIsA0.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]Halloween Giveaway:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		During the Halloween 2019 Event we will be doing a special giveaway. This giveaway will go through New Z's social channels so make sure to follow us and stay tuned for further announcements.	[/*][/list]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8430-patch-239/)	 

	A new patch! This patch is mostly aimed to implement the content and preparations for the Halloween 2019 event. Next to that we have added a taunt system, we have done some fixes here and there and we have added some further new content. Overall not a huge patch but needed for the Halloween 2019 event.

	For those wondering about the Halloween 2019 event; we have planned to release a final announcement including all information about the event later today / tomorrow. The Halloween 2019 event will start tomorrow at 12:00 PM (CEST).

[i][b]NOTE: Since we added the taunt system your key binds mind have been resetted. This is caused because of the new mapping we did to use a taunt. By default to use a taunt you have to press "p".[/b][/i]


	Now, let's jump into the patch notes.

	 

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added content for the new Halloween 2019 event week that is coming soon. Most reason for the patch here is because of this and everything we patched in / all the events we have planned will follow in a later Halloween 2019 announcement. Halloween secret spots have been added to the maps and a new Halloween trading lounge will be available. For more info stay tuned for the official announcement. [list]	[*]		Reworked the entire chat system for better functionality. Switching between chat channels can now be done by pressing the 'TAB' key. notes.title: Patch 2.38
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/epkZo6H.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8367-patch-238/)

	It's once again time for another update. This time we have a HUGE patch including the account level system & prestiges with level borders, a season pass system, for Survival (finally) the resource gather system, a lot of quality of life improvements and further more a lot of new content!

	We would like to thank all of you for your patience and we hope you all like this brand new update.

	 

	Let's jump straight into it!

	 

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Skins in the skin menu are now ordered alphabetically.	[/*]	[*]		Separated double XP and double GD functions per game-mode. This allows us to do double XP and or double GD events separately per game-mode(s). (Yes we know Survival doesn't have GD but you get the point)	[/*][/list]
	[b]MODELS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to the hospital building where players could shoot through a gap in one of the staircases. We have now removed the elevator shaft from that particular staircase. Example of the original issue: [url=https://prnt.sc/p49vik]https://prnt.sc/p49vi[/url]	[/*][/list]
	[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Players can no longer contest clan points when they're dead.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug related to the clan point perk that decreases the revive timer where the revive system would bug out when applied.	[/*]	[*]		Clan territory points no longer count on the leaderboards from servers that are disabled.	[/*][/list]
	[b]UI:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added an indicator to the "view content" menu when viewing content of a skinbox/box that indicates which skins/items are new.	[/*]	[*]		Players are now able to buy characters and character clothes (parts) directly from the character selection screen. This means that character clothes no longer show in the in-game marketplace. It was very confusing for players to buy a particular character cloth as they'd have to find it in the huge list in the marketplace. Now you can just browse through characters and clothes and if you want to buy a certain clothing you can do that directly for GC/GD.	[/*]	[*]		Crafting resource quantities in the crafting menu are now easier to see / more visible.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ACCOUNT LEVEL SYSTEM:[/b]
	The brand new account level system is finished and will be released in this patch. This system allows any player to have an account level, grind and level up. It's completely account based so experience can be gained by playing any game-mode. With this we have introduced a new value called "[b]Account Experience[/b]" which is the global experience amount for an account. Linked with that is an account level. It starts small at the lowest levels but becomes bigger and bigger towards the higher levels. Combined with all of this there is something we call "prestige" that decide your so called "Account Level Border".
[list]	[*]		Account level is shown in the main menu, friends list.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/bHdgi20.png[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/dvI5d5y.png[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		Account level + account level border is also shown in the ingame tab list. You can find a preview picture for them further below in the patch notes.	[/*]	[*]		Account level experience, the new value, will also be the fundament for our new season pass system. Further information and explanations about that system will be made further below in the patch notes.	[/*]	[*]		Account levels update when a player exits a server and is back in the main menu. If your account levels up, you will get a level up notification there.	[/*]	[*]		Account experience can be gained by playing any game-mode. You get, for instance, XP by killing players, winning a Battle Royale game, winning a Competitive game, killing zombies, etc.	[/*]	[*]		The experience needed per level increases each level. That means that to level up from level 1 to 2 you need A LOT less XP than to level up from level 350 to 351. The higher level you are, the more XP you will need to level up.	[/*]	[*]		You can also see someone's account level border when aiming at that player ingame. This is how it looks:
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/MP6gkBj.png[/img]
		
		[b]Prestige System:[/b]	[/*]	[*]		To make the whole system more attractive and cool, we have linked it to a prestige system. It is relatively simple. There is 6 in total as following:
		 		[list]			[*]				Silver: Level 1 - Level 400.			[/*]			[*]				Gold: Level 401 - Level 800.			[/*]			[*]				Platinum: Level 801 - Level 1200.			[/*]			[*]				Diamond: Level 1201 - Level 1600.			[/*]			[*]				Elite: Level 1601 - Level 2000.			[/*]			[*]				Master: Level 2000+.
				 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Here is an overview that will hopefully allow you to understand the whole border/prestige system better:
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/xXuSGUy.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Basically you can be level 1-100 and when you reach level 101 your level will (only visually) be reset to 1, although you will have a prestige of 1 level up. Every time you do so, a diamond in that prestige area style will be added. When you reach level 401, you will then enter the Gold level and so on. Here are some examples:		[list]			[*]				Player that is level 97:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/q5cfOe2.png[/img]			[/*]			[*]				Player that is level 647:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/6wqg5z5.png[/img]			[/*]			[*]				Player that is level 2374:
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/VWFxOHh.png[/img]
				
				[u]Note: Each diamond per type stands for a 100 levels. Meaning if you see a silver border with 3 diamonds under, it means that that player is somewhere above level 300. (100 x 3 diamonds = 300)[/u]
				 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		The idea behind this is that the players can recognize other players' level range, using the border, where the "higher" the border is the higher the player's level will be. Basically let's say a player sees a diamond (blue) border, they then know that the player has to be between level 1201 and 1600. He can then count the diamond icons under for each 100 levels and then, based on the style of the border, he can know how high he is in that prestige ranging from 1-100.	[/*][/list]
	[b]TAB LIST:[/b]
	For this update we have reworked the TAB list, aka the in-game menu that shows a list of all players in the current server. We have reworked this for three reasons: optimizations, support for the new account levels and to improve the overall look of it. Below we will show a picture of what the list will look like and under that we will mention changes & updates in particular in a short list.
	
	[img]https://i.imgur.com/zF8qu4E.png[/img]
[list]	[*]		Support for account levels has been added. As you can see the account level for a player and the border of the account level has been added in front of the character's name/server number.	[/*]	[*]		We have also added the clan tag for characters. If a certain character is in a certain clan, it will now show the clan tag + color of the clan tag in front of the character name as well. This way you can know what clan a certain character is in.	[/*]	[*]		The account subscription icons, veteran icon and friend icon have been repositioned. This now shows after the character's name.	[/*][/list]
	We have also changed the on-click menu that shows when clicking on a particular player. This is how it looks:
	[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ld8KCt.png[/img]
[list]	[*]		Note that this picture is how it looks when clicking on yourself. Buttons such as "mute" and "report" are still there and will show under the avatar and account level border. A cool trick is that when clicking on any player you can see his 'total' level, in the example above, 3000. On the tab list itself (without clicking on a player) you'll only see his current level in THAT prestige. How that all works can be found under the "Account Level System" part of these patch notes.	[/*][/list]
	[b]SEASON PASS SYSTEM:[/b]
	With the new level system being introduced we had a solid basis to also develop a season pass system. With the season pass and the progress for it we use the new Account Experience value as a basis. Only players who actually buy a season pass will be able to participate in it. Please note that the price of the season pass will be based on its content. We aim to particially add unique content to and for the season pass to make this unique but the season pass will also have returning rewards for things that are already in the game including GC or in-game items, for example.
[list]	[*]		We thought about you Survival players and yes, rewards in the season pass can be both for the Open World and the Survival game-modes.	[/*]	[*]		Since we use the account experience as a basis, progress will be linked to that. Although progress only starts counting when the season pass is purchased.	[/*]	[*]		Account experience is global and can be gained by playing any game-mode, this means it doesn't matter what game-mode you play, you'll still progress in the season pass.
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/3D3Cgws.png[/img]
		[u]Note: the picture above is purely for preview purposes and does not contain anything accurate towards how the final season pass will be.[/u]
		
		[b]How does it work?[/b]
		A season pass will be available through the in-game marketplace. Once you bought a season pass you can go to the "Season Pass" menu by clicking the "Season Pass" button in the main menu and you'll see your current season pass overview. Season passes have an end date. The end date means that when that period is reached the season pass will be gone/disabled.
		
		On the season pass menu you will also see a timeline with points. Every point stands for a "level". When a level in the season pass is reached, you'll be rewarded with items, skins and/or content for that level. You can see the rewards for each level by clicking on them. Every season pass will be different in terms of the amount of levels and the amount of XP you need for a level. In the example pictured above you can see that after reaching a 100 XP you will reach level 1 of the "Test Season Pass". (This is just an example)
		
		The experience, XP, is the same as your account experience. Season pass experience will ONLY start counting after a season pass is bought.
		
		We plan on releasing a new season pass with unique content from time to time and we would like to address with this season pass being the first one ever, we expect some feedback. This first season pass will mostly be focused on more of a try-out, most likely 1 month, where we get the chance to fully process all the feedback. With that being said, please let us know if you have any feedback.
		 	[/*][/list]
	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed the third person model for the Mauser SP66. It was using an incorrect scope.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the texture of the K. Style NVG Ice. The texture now matches the rest of the skin collection.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the texture of the Alice Backpack Solrath.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug related to the claymore not dealing damage to players or zombies sometimes.	[/*]	[*]		Players inside vehicles can no longer trigger bear traps.	[/*][/list]
	[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved the specular texture for the Custom Guerilla. Increased the resolution and improved the overall quality of this texture making all custom guerilla armors including the default one look a lot better in high quality lighting.	[/*]	[*]		Increased the glow amount of the Karambit Jedi skin.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the item description of the Military Backpack.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the item description of the Hunter Backpack.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a new light-machine gun: M249-E3 Para. This light machine weapon is a better variant of the M249 and uses M249 ammo. Although we have added this new weapon to the game, it won't be available in any game mode just yet. Stay tuned for more information later on when / how we release this new weapon.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/WPt8vVB.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Katana: Light Sword Cross Purple. This light sword will be added to the content of the Jedi Skinbox at the moment of this patch.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/AhpSsBn.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Katana: Light Sword Twin Purple. This light sword will be added to the content of the Jedi Skinbox at the moment of this patch.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/hpnZXS7.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Katana: Light Sword Yellow. This light sword will be added to the content of the Jedi Skinbox at the moment of this patch.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/ixp0iHW.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the M107: M107 Black Night. This skin will not be released / available just yet.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/d0BPXJM.png[/img]
		
		[u]Please note that most item additions listed above won't be released instantly. Keep an eye on our social media to stay up to date for their individual releases.[/u]	[/*][/list]
	[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Updated the bear trap store icon. This one looks better and is overall better looking and better quality.	[/*]	[*]		The Karambit Blue is is from now on glowing.	[/*]	[*]		Bear traps and claymores no longer deal damage to players in PVE servers.	[/*]	[*]		Bear traps and claymores can now also be triggered by zombies.	[/*][/list]
	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the store icon of the Custom Guerilla. Also reworked all its skins.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon of the Custom Vest. Also reworked all its skins.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the basic light swords. The entire model has been reworked and most importantly been optimized at the same time. Also store icons and recipe icons have been updated.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the cross light swords. The entire model has been reworked and most importantly been optimized at the same time. Also store icons and recipe icons have been updated.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the twin light swords. The entire model has been reworked and most importantly been optimized at the same time. Also store icons and recipe icons have been updated.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the curved light swords. The entire model has been reworked and also most importantly been optimized at the same time. Also store icons and recipe icons have been updated. Note that this one has been switched to a curved saber since it made a lot more sense to have it like this. The curved skins still have a more "chromish" hold part.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Survival Updates:[/u][/b][/u]
	We know you all really want us to implement and release the base building system although we have decided to cut the whole feature in to two separate parts: 1) The resource gather system which is the system that allows players to farm materials and use those to build a base with.
	2) The actual base building system.
	For this update we have proceeded to release part 1 where in Colorado V2, Survival, players can now find and farm resources. We want to make sure this is balanced first before releasing the base building system itself. These are two very big steps for us to take and we just want to make sure we do it right and create some breathing room and space for feedback from players.
	
	[u]Note 1: Resources will also start spawning on other Survival maps including Caliwood, Colorado V1 and Oregon in the near future. To balance everything we need to focus on 1 map for now which is Colorado V2. However we definitively plan to add the resources to all Survival maps soon.
	Note 2: For those wondering about the base building system and resource system being implemented into the Open World game-mode; yes we are considering this to a certain extent although we want to focus on balancing and fully releasing it into the Survival game-mode first.[/u]

	 

	[b]OVERALL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Random spawned weapons (loot) now spawn with a random amount of bullets.	[/*]	[*]		Toxic super zombies now drop 3 items instead of 1.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Colorado V2 (Survival):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a clan territory where the wrong boost perk was assigned.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Colorado V1 (Survival):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a clan territory where the wrong boost perk was assigned.	[/*][/list]
	[b]CRAFTING:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the model and store icon for Metal.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the model and store icon for Wood.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the model and store icon for Stone.	[/*][/list]
	The following crafting requirements (recipes) have been updated based on the new resource gather system:
	[u]Note that we only show below the required items that we adjusted.[/u]
[list]	[*]		Hatchet: increased to 100 wood, 20 metal. Removed: 1 plastic, 1 glue. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Pickaxe: increased to 100 wood, 20 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Fire axe: increased to 125 wood, 50 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Brotherhood: increased to 100 metal, 4 tactical knives. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Canoe Paddle: increased to 75 wood. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Improvised fire axe: increased to 100 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Arrow: increased to 5 wood, 5 stone. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Bada Boom: increased to 50 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Clean Sweep: increased to 50 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Cricket Bat:  increased to 90 wood. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Wrench: increased to 20 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Bat: increased to 90 wood. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Metal Bat: increased to 20 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		M9 Bayonet: increased to 20 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Machete increased to 40 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Fireman helmet: removed metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Heavy Armor: increased to 100 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		K. Style Helmet: increased to 50 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		C01-Vaccine: increased to 10 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Binoculars: increased to 20 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Code lock: increased to 100 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Small code locker: increased to 250 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Armor plates: increased to 75 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Wooden code locker: increased to 100 wood, 15 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Repair kit: increased to 50 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*]	[*]		Forward grip: increased to 10 metal. Rest remains same.	[/*][/list]
	The following crafting recipes have been disabled (for now) based on the new resource gather system:
	[u]Note that these will most likely not come back as they were a 'temporary fix' pre to the resource gather system that's now here.[/u]
[list]	[*]		Metal Recipe. (Metal scrap is temporary not spawning)	[/*]	[*]		Stone Recipe. (Rocks are temporary not spawning)	[/*]	[*]		Wood Recipe. (Sticks are temporary not spawning)	[/*][/list]
	[b]GATHER SYSTEM:[/b]

	Stone, wood and metal now spawns in Survival Colorado V2. We are adding the resources to the rest of the Survival map(s) in the near future. Resources spawn around the map and can be farmed using tools. Only particular melees have particular gather rates. Some can only farm wood, some only metal, some both. Some are more sufficient than others.

	The following melees have gather rates and can be used to either farm wood, stone or metal:
[list]	[*]		Flashlight: 1 wood, 1 stone, 1 metal per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Hammer: 3 metal per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Hatchet: 6 wood per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Pickaxe: 6 stone per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Chainsaw: 10 wood per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Crowbar: 5 metal per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Fire axe: 7 wood, 2 metal per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Power drill: 1 metal per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Wrench: 1 metal per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Brotherhood: 7 wood per hit.	[/*]	[*]		Double Fire Axe: 8 wood, 3 metal per hit.	[/*][/list]
	Resources spawn around the map and have a maximum health values. When a resource is being farmed and reaches 0 health, it will despawn. Resources spawn back randomly, and have a cool down just like normal items. The following health values have been set:
[list]	[*]		Wood: 100 health. Common. Spawns pretty much anywhere.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/ezg9Aca.jpg[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		Stone: 50 health. Medium. Spawns mostly outside cities & towns.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/cpqDuud.jpg[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		Metal: 20 health. Rare. Spawns mostly inside cities & towns.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/6Di3lHa.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	[b]BASE BUILDING (BETA):[/b]
[list]	[*]		Updated the gather resources on the Cliffside beta server to the new (3) variants.	[/*]	[*]		Base build objects now decay if they are not attached to a base with a Cupboard.	[/*]	[*]		Added a demolish option to the building hammer. This way builders don't have to switch to another weapon to destroy a wall they just placed.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the footstep sounds for building objects. They should now match with the material.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug related to the building system causing walls to be rotated 90 degrees after placing stairs.	[/*][/list]
	The following adjustments have been made to the building objects based on the new resource gather system:
[list]	[*]		Foundation: 125 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Ceiling: 100 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Roof: 100 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Foundation Stairs: 100 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Stairs v2: 100 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Stairs v3: 100 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Wall: 100 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Door frame: 75 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Window frame: 75 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Small window frame: 75 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Small wall: 75 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Pillar: 50 wood.	[/*]	[*]		Door: 100 wood, 20 metal. (Since it has a code lock already on the door)	[/*]	[*]		Metal Window Cover: 60 metal.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Open World Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]OVERALL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Toxic super zombies now drop 3 items instead of 1.	[/*][/list]
	[b](PVP) Lounge:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed some flying objects around the left side of the pool area.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to "Fred's Mission" where one of the way points was flying in the air.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Battle Royale Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]Arizona V2:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed some places where there were some issues related to the terrain not being high enough.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some flying rocks pretty much all over the map.	[/*]	[*]		Tweaked settings for players playing on Medium and Low to increase and improve overall performance.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[b]Estimated patch size: 300-400 mb. (It's a big one)[/b]

	[b]Patch ETA: Patch will roll out as soon as these patch notes are released.[/b]

	[b]Estimated downtime: We will try to keep the downtime around 1 hour.[/b]

	[u]Pre-patch notes might be changed if we need to fix / add something.[/u]

	 

	Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these patch notes with your friends and followers!

	For any feedback about the game or this patch please let us know at [url=http://playnewz.com/feedback]http://playnewz.com/feedback[/url]

	If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at: [url=https://suggest.playnewz.com/]https://suggest.playnewz.com/[/url]

	To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
	[b]Facebook:[/b] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/]https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/[/url]
	[b]Twitter:[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/infestationnewz]https://twitter.com/infestationnewz[/url]
	[b]Discord: [/b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz]https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz[/url]

	 

	Best Regards,

	 

	// Fredaikis

notes.title: Weekend Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/C1kqcPE.jpg[/img]

	 

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8358-weekend-event/)

	 Time for another one! This time we have epic stuff happening in Battle Royale with Battle Royale Madness, we have loot events for both Survival and Open World, Lounge PVP map is back in the PVP Servers section with instant reload and we are doing a discount on the 2500 GC package! Enjoy!

	Oh yeah, and for those wondering we have a HUGE patch coming up with HUGE new features including an account level system, a season pass system, survival resource gathering system and A LOT more. This is all coming very soon as we are currently in the final stage of testing. Stay tuned for this!

	 

	For this weekend event we'll have it live the following period of time:

	 

	[u][u][b]START:[/b][/u][u][b] September 27, 2019 12:00 PM (CEST)[/b][/u][/u]

	[u][u][b]END:[/b][/u][u][b] September 30, 2019 12:00 PM (CEST)[/b][/u][/u]

	 

	Now, let's jump into further details about this weekend's weekend event:

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/qeRZPDC.jpg[/img]

	 
[list]	[*]		[u][b]Loot Event![/b][/u]
		Since this particular time we couldn't come up that would affect both Open World and Survival [b]at the same time[/b], we have split this point in 2:		[list]			[*]				Survival: We have noticed it's very hard for people to get their hands on the new "Juggernaut Armor". So, this weekend only we have made it easier to get the armor (parts). This means the "Become a Juggernaut!" contract is now more common, the Juggernaut Spikes & Head case are now a lot more common from dropping from normal Super Zombies, the Juggernaut Body piece now also drops from normal Super Zombies and chances for it on the Alien Super Zombie have been increased. Also, to juice this all up the unique Juggernaut Armor / Helmet skin now has a super small chance of being dropped by a normal super zombie. Note: We are still going to give everyone these 2 skin recipes that manages to get their hands on the ultimate versions of both the armor or the helmet, but this will be an extra way (this weekend only) to get one or two! For more information about that reward and the juggernaut armor itself please read: [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8255-patch-237/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8255-patch-237/[/url]
				[img]https://i.imgur.com/yiElgBZ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/EChXzz6.png[/img]			[/*]			[*]				Open World: Vehicle spawners are back! You can now get the original vehicle spawner items again but only from normal Super Zombies. Vehicle spawners are the items you can use to spawn in a vehicle.
				Note: You can only use these vehicle spawners on private servers. 
				Now, you might wonder why add this in the official servers when you can only use this in private servers? 1) loot is global so also in private servers, we can't separate it; i guess nice to farm for the weekend. 2) we are on our way fully introducing vehicles back in the game, of course balancing here is our prioritization. We would like to see where this leads us.
				 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Battle Royale Madness![/b][/u]
		For this weekend event only, we'd like to try something new in the Battle Royale game-mode. Loot has been changed completely! Just some examples: Heavy Armors, K. Style Helmets, VSS's, Snipers, Riot Shields, everything spawns! Also we have enabled double speed to make this even MORE MADNESS!
		If you have any further madness related to the BR loot, please let us know as we can still add even more items to the loot tables LIVE, during the Weekend Event! Just let us know your ideas in the comments!
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Lounge PVP Map + Instant Reload[/b][/u]
		The Lounge PVP map is back in the PVP Servers section. This time we have also enabled the instant reload feature for this PVP map! This means that you won't have to reload any weapon! Enjoy!
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b]Xsolla Sale: 20% discount on the 2500 GC package.[/b][/u]
		This weekend only there will be a 20% discount on the 2500 GC package only through Xsolla on our website at: [url=https://playnewz.com/buygc.php]https://playnewz.com/buygc.php[/url]
		 	[/*][/list][list]	[*]		[u][b][u]ROUTINE:[/u] Battle Royale Map Rotation[/b][/u]
		As always, the main and only Battle Royale map will be changed. This time we are changing over from Arizona to Arena.
		[u]Note: We change the map rotation in the Battle Royale game-mode every week due to the low(er) amount of players playing Battle Royale. If you have any suggestions, ideas or feedback please let us know at [url=http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5388-maps-battle-royale/]http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5388-maps-battle-royale/[/url][/u]
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/zk3etUe.jpg[/img]
		 	[/*]	[*]		[u][b][u]SALE:[/u] Invisible Backpack Skin + Mystery Skinbox Sale[/b][/u]
		This time we are doing a big sale on the invisible backpack skins and we are doing a 20% discount on the Mystery Skinbox.
		[u]Note: This sale is a weekly one so has already started before the weekend event and will not have the same start-end times as the weekend event.[/u]
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/77RixQa.jpg[/img]	[/*][/list]
	 

	Please let us know what you think of this weekend event so that we can use that feedback in the future for new weekend events! If you have any ideas or suggestions feel free to share that as well as we might be able to use your idea for upcoming weekend events!

	 

	If you experience any type of issue(s) with the game please contact us through social media or create a support ticket at[url=https://playnewz.com/support.php/]https://playnewz.com/support.php/[/url]

Let's not jump too much into that but summarized up it has to do because of prioritization & feedback from players. Anyways, with me taking over I'd like to introduce some changes. Hopefully some of many to follow because your feedback is important and my prioritization of these weekend event(s) will always go to keeping as much players as possible happy and satisfied with these weekend event(s).

	Now, I do not think it's a good idea to abruptly introduce all changes at once but starting with this weekend event you'll start to see some particular things change.
