notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/09/07 (The Crafting System)
notes.content:
Dear Players,

(Original post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/1504-patch-notes-20170907-the-crafting-system/)

We are very excited to share this new patch with you all. Before we jump into the patch notes we would like to make clear what our goal with this patch is and what we're aiming for in the next upcoming weeks.

First of all this patch isn't all about survival and the crafting system. As you will read in the patch notes is that the crafting system that will be released in this patch will be the "basis" of a development we will follow in the upcoming weeks. We just want to get the "basis" out there and work from there while at the same time our community can give us feedback too. Second of all this patch is mainly focused to fix more "general" issues rather than bringing major new content / features. There's a lot happening behind the scenes related to this patch as we have improved our crash report system. Crashes have our number one priority and with this patch we will be able to keep track of crashes a million times better than before. This is the actual main reason for this patch as when this patch is released we will be able to fix crashes better and faster in the future. 

Now, let's jump into the patch notes.

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the alien super zombie to have the normal textures of the normal super zombie. The alien super now looks like an actual alien super zombie again.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a common town building used in almost every map of the game to randomly be invisible for players. (Some players could see this building, some players couldn't.)
[*]Fixed an issue related to the Steam Achievements causing them not to work. Steam Achievements should now work properly again. Our excuses for the issues.
[*]Fixed an issue related to the White House building where textures of this building would sometimes not load / glitch.
[*]Fixed an issue related to the Airport Tower building where textures of the antenna would sometimes not load / glitch. Also fixed a way players could glitch through a wall inside a non-accessible area.
[*]Fixed the animation issues related to the GD Airdrop Caller.
[*]Fixed an issue related to the big market building where players could no-clip through a certain wall.
[*]Fixed the issues related to the Steam Achievements. Steam Achievements are now working and updating properly again.
[*]Fixed a bug causing the last previewed skin to show instead of your character.
[*]Fixed an issue related to the game freezing / crashing upon exiting the game.
[*]Fixed a bug in the launcher causing the login button to get stuck.
[*]Fixed some UI bugs on the marketplace.
[*]Fixed an issue related to stacking gasoline.
[*]Fixed a bug in the spawn system causing players to spawn under the ground or outside the map after a failed game join.
[*]More beginner dedicated loading screens are being created / already made to improve the experience in the game for starting players and help them to get into the game as easy and fast as possible.
[*]Removed "Open World items" from the Survival and Battle Royale marketplaces. Game dollars is the Open World currency and only items that are for game dollars will show in the Open World marketplace. GC items will always show in every marketplace.
[*]Separated the marketplaces for each game-mode to prevent confusion.
We are trying to funnel beginning players more into the survival game-mode rather than Open World since most beginning players will die faster in Open World from more experienced players. More information about this can be found on the "Survival" part of these patch notes.
[*]Doing any inventory actions will now alert you before-hand if the action will reset your character spawn. People didn't seem to know this. This is also a feature we added that's more aimed towards the beginning players.
[/list]
[h1]PVP Map Rotation:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Smallville has now been removed. (Don't worry, this map will be back soon again.)
[*]SpringValley now has the random spawn system.
[*]The new map: "District" has been added to the rotation and is now available.
[/list]
[h1]Item Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the shank (melee) animation issue that was caused in our latest patch. Also fixed the texture issues and the icon problem. This melee should work properly again now. Our excuses for the problems.
[*]Fixed the MP5/SD zombie attraction shoot radius. Zombies should not attract that far to this weapon now when shooting.
[*]Added a new country riot shield: "Riot Shield Pakistan".
[*]Added the following extra text to the vehicle spawner's description: "(Item can ONLY be used in Premium & Private servers)". This is done so players know before buying them where they can use these items.
[*]Added back: "Riot Shield Glad".
[*]Updated the painkiller (medical item) store icon.
[*]Updated the antibiotics (medical item) store icon.
[*]Updated the medkit (medical item) store icon.
[*]Updated the bandages (medical item) store icon.
[*]Updated the bandages (medical item) DX store icon.
[*]Once and for all the "Ballistic Shield" is now finally working properly. This shield will be available after this patch. We will probably add it to the in-game marketplace for open world + make it find-able. Expect an update about this after the patch on our social media channels.
[/list]
[h1]Skin Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the "Sig Sauer 556 MMFK" texture problems. (Update)
[*]Fixed the "AK-74M Collapse" texture and animations issues. This skin is now ready to be released.
[*]Fixed the "EVO 3 Spector" texture and animation issues. This skin is now ready to be released.
[*]Fixed the "M9 Bayonet Matte" store icon and animation issues.
[*]Fixed the "M9 Bayonet Tiger" animation issues.
[*]Fixed the "M9 Bayonet Destruction" animation issues.
[*]Fixed the "M9 Bayonet Fade' animation issues.
[*]Fixed the "M9 Bayonet Red Strike" animation issues.
[*]Fixed the "Heavy Armor Fun Edition" description.
[*]Fixed the "K. Style NVG Fun Edtion" description.
[*]Added a new QBZ-95 skin to the Fun Edition Skinbox called: "QBZ-95 Fun Edition".
[*]Added a new Custom Guerilla skin to the Fun Edtion Skinbox skin called: "Custom Guerilla Fun Edition".
[*]Added the Custom Guerilla Toxic to the Mystery and Revolution Skinbox.
[*]Added the IMI-TAR 21 Leather to the Mystery and Revolution Skinbox.
[*]Added the Famas Tiger to the Mystery and Revolution Skinbox.
[*]Added the Desert Eagle Fire to the Mystery and Revolution Skinbox.
[*]Added the Saiga Leaves to the Mystery Skinbox and Open World loot.
[*]Added the Custom Guerilla Zombies to the Mystery Skinbox and Open World loot.
[*]Added the IBA Matrix to the Mystery Skinbox and Open World loot.
[*]Added the Heavy Armor Forged Iron to the Mystery and Revolution Skinbox.
[*]Updated the "AUG Skully Pink" skin (textures) based on community feedback.
NOTE: These skins have been in the game but never got released. We wanted to bring something new to the players but at the same time "clean up" so therefor these skins. (In case you're wondering about a certain skin that you've seen the name of it before.)
[*]Updated the "Mystery Skinbox" content. This skinbox was unavailable for a certain period because we wanted to update all the content inside the skinbox. This is done now and the skinbox is available again after this update.
[/list]
[h1]Character Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Average Joe Head Tattoo hair texture issue. (Related to the alpha layer of the texture.)
[*]Fixed the Mechanic Female Body Latex store icon. This is also why this body wasn't released in the marketplace yet. This new body will be available in the in-game marketplace after this update.
[*]Fixed the Park Ranger character part item names. After this update also all the new Park Ranger character clothes should be available.
[/list]
[h1]Battle Royale Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Load-outs are now updated. We've added more various and different kind of load-outs. This goes all the way from very strong ones to very simple ones. We hope this will bring more fun and variation to the warm-up game-play inside the Battle Royale lobby's. (Over 20 new load-outs are added)
NOTE: We are now planning to update the Battle Royale load-outs monthly to keep them updated and interesting.
[/list]
[h1]Survival Updates:[/h1]

[b]OVERALL:[/b]

The Crafting System. It's there! The "basis" of the crafting system is done! Let's jump into details.
The crafting system is a huge new feature for survival our community has been waiting for. It's time to update you all regarding the progress of this new feature. The crafting system was a feature that was suppose to be released together with the survival mode but that didn't happen due the fact that we wanted to release survival earlier. Ever since then we have been working on this new crafting system and right now we are about to release the first version of this feature. Here's a list that explains shortly what's going to be available when the crafting system gets released:

- Crafting items will for now only be find-able. Components will be added to the loot tables. As tools are still disabled (so you can't use an axe to cut wood yet) the items will only be find-able.
- Full crafting menu is finished and will be released including a list of all craft-able items, a crafting queue (that can be cancelled for example) and more!
- Armors, melees, food, medical items, barricades etc is all released and available to be crafted.

We are asking you all for your feedback and we would also want to let you know that this is just the "basis" of the crafting system. If you want to know more about our plans and what is coming for the crafting system we recommend you to read the full developer blog about this listed below.

For more information about the new crafting system we recommend you to read the following developer blog: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/1498-survival-the-crafting-system-update/
[list]
[*]Players now have around 30% more stamina in survival.
[*]Survival is now the first button in the game-mode selection screen and [*]Open World has been moved to the third place.
[/list]
[b]MAP UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the amount of cars spawning so that players can find them easier and travel around the map faster. (community request.)
[*]Component items are now spawning in the map. Also added "nature" spawns where players can find sticks and rocks in the forests.
[*]Fixed some flying barrels in Campos City.
[*]Fixed some misplaced loot where loot was sometimes spawning inside walls in Campos City.
[/list]
[h1]Map Updates:[/h1]

[b]COLORADO V1:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a misplaced rock at Oak Mountain Rest Stop.
[*]Fixed a misplaced part of the big house in Frosty Pines.
[*]Fixed a navigation mesh problem one of the airport hangar's at Ridgeway Airport.
[/list]
[b]COLORADO V2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more collision walls on top of the fire station in Death Valley.
[*]Added more collision walls on top of the "Beach House" in Boulder City.
[*]Replaced the "Beach-House" in Boulder City with a different one because player were glitching on top of it.
[*]Deleted some containers at Ridgeway Airport that were double placed.
[*]Removed the collision walls which are in front of the tunnel at Norad Military Base.
[*]Fixed some flying rocks around Rifle Ridge.
[*]Fixed a glitched fence at Lonetree Farm.
[*]Fixed a terrain issue at Emerald Peak where the terrain was too low.'
[*]Fixed the big market at Clearview where players could glitch inside through the wall. (on the side of the garage.)
[/list]
[b]CALIWOOD:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a minimap spelling mistake where military was spelled wrong.
[*]Deleted some miss-placed walls around the convention center.
[/list]
[b]ROCKY FORD: (PVP MAP)[/b]
[list]
[*]Moved some tree outside the map where players were glitching inside in.
[/list]
[b]SPRING VALLEY: (PVP MAP)[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the full random spawn system. (Like mentioned earlier already)
[*]Fixed a misplaced street.
[*]Fixed a no-clippable fence at the construction buildings area.
[/list]

With all this said we would also want to let you guys know what we're aiming for for the next upcoming patch. Just to keep you all updated about what's coming. Please keep in mind this is "roughly" and doesn't mean these are the ONLY things that are most likely coming. It's just a simple list:

Fix more crashes now that we have our new system. (Read the start of these patch notes for more information regarding this.)
Bring a huge (mostly survival related) content patch. Also this includes finishing all the plans we're working on that are listed in the developer blog about the survival crafting system.
Make the game more beginner friendly. We are aiming to do all sorts of changes (that won't affect current players of course) to make our game as beginner friendly as possible. For example: tutorials etc.
 

[b]Average patch size: 170 mb.[/b]

[b]Patch is expected to roll out at: September 7, 2017 around 10:00 / 11:00 AM (UTC+2)[/b]

 

To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/infestationnewz
Discord: https://discord.gg/gafUzrD

 

Best Regards,

 

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/08/14
notes.content:
Dear Players,

(Original Notes: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/1257-patch-notes-20170814/)

After a lot of troubleshooting and a lot of work investigating some issues, also thanks to a lot of player reporting issues, we have a "small" hotfix ready. This isn't really that much of a hotfix but more an actual patch since the amount of work we've put into this is insane. A LOT of crashes have been fixed and we have fixed a lot of other stuff. Here's all the fixes:

[b]Average size of this patch: 80 mb.[/b]

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a huge issue preventing some people from starting their game. After the latest patch we released before the weekend there has been player's that were unable to start their game. This issue is now fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue causing private servers to crash other servers on the same machine when they expire. This crash has been happening since the release of the original Infestation and was a major / very common crash related to the private servers. We are very happy we've been able to fix this issue. This will increase the private server performance with a lot.
[*]Fixed the issue where we weren't able to sell the new character parts. We are now able to start selling them like planned. Our excuses.
[*]Fixed a texture issue related to one of the new zombies that caused the hair of the zombie to be wrong / glitched.
[*]Fixed an issue related to one of the skyscraper buildings. There was some issues with the doors. This is fixed. Example: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VotlFIwKI2w
[*]Fixed a total of 3 Server and 11 Client Crashes. (We are sorry we can not go more in depth about these fixes but thanks to all players that uploaded crash dumps / reported crashes we have been able to do a lot of work related to improving the stability of the game.)
[*]Fixed a server crash related to the player report system. Also improved the player report system.
[*]Fixed an issue related to the ping limit system. The whole system is improved and should work better now.
[*]Fixed some issues related to private servers in Hong Kong and South America causing "client must be updated".
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented cars to be placed down while moving.
The 2 new zombie types are now confirmed to be spawning in Caliwood, Colorado V2, Colorado V1.
[*]Removed 3 Steam achievements that were no longer possible to get due Battle Royale game-play changes. (Removed: "Double the trouble!", "We are a team!" & "2 hero's".
[/list]
Also we would like to give a special and huge thanks to all players that have been helping us fixing crashes / performance issues / any other issues related to the stability of the game. Please keep uploading your crash dumps if you crash and report them on our forums. With your help we are able to fix these kind of issues much faster and easier. Once again, thanks!

[h1]Skin Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the texture + store icon of the Hynx skinbox. The skinbox look is more like a mix now between both of the Hynx skin versions.
[*]Updated the content of the "Mystery Skinbox" and added all the new released skins.
[/list]
[h1]Item Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the item name of the "Team Silenterror PSO Scope".
[*]Fixed the texture issue of the Shank. (Melee)
[/list]
[h1]Battle Royale Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue related to placing a shield while the countdown of the Battle Royale game started, causing the player to spawn in with the actual riot shield indicator. This is now fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue related to the grenade animation bug while spawning in Battle Royale. This was already fixed last patch but not entirely.
[/list]
[h1]Survival Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a major issue related to player spawns. Players have been reporting: "I only spawn at Campos / Clearview". This is now fixed. Players should now properly spawn around in the entire map.
[/list]
[h1]Map Updates:[/h1]

[b]COLORADO V2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated the skinbox area in the New Z Office at the NATO Military Base. Also fixed some of the skinboxes.
[*]Moved some objects, which where in front of new opened doors in Smallville. Players should now be able to move properly through these doors.
[*]Fixed a lot of flying objects in Smallville.
[*]Fixed the terrain on some places where it was not high enough in Smallville. (There was some random holes in the ground.)
[*]Fixed the shadows on ultra settings. Shadows should look way better now while playing in ultra settings.
[*]Fixed an error with the placed dragon skinbox at the NATO Military Base.
[*]Fixed an error with the placed silent Riot Shield at the NATO Military Base.
[/list]
[b]CALIWOOD:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some flying objects around the broken bridge. (Located in the center of the city.)
[*]Fixed a terrain issue at the beach motels.
[*]Fixed the terrain at the beach area's where players would be able to kind of glitch inside the sea.
[/list]

[b]Patch is expected to roll out tomorrow morning: Monday, August 14, 2017 around 19:00 PM (UTC+2)[/b]

To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/infestationnewz
Discord: https://discord.gg/gafUzrD

Best Regards,

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/08/10
notes.content:
Dear Players,

(ORIGINAL PATCH NOTES: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/1207-patch-notes-20170810/)

Here we finally are! The patch is about to be released and we're very excited to share these pre-patch not for tomorrow morning with you. We are sorry it took a little bit longer to finish this patch due summer & longer testing. This patch contains a lot of exciting new things for example: we have finally finished the ping limiter, a new character system rework & new clothes, a lot of new skins, a lot of new items, a lot of new features and a lot of fixes! Now, let's jump into the actual patch notes for more info:

Btw, if you have any questions regarding one of the notes, feel free to ask us anything in the comments!

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Two new character models are now available! Check out the in-game marketplace for prices. Let us know what you think of these new characters in the comments.
[*]There's also a new zombie model finished. We would like to NOT share any pictures of this new zombie so that our community can find it in-game themselves. Let us know if you've found any of the new zombies. (Note: The new zombies aren't like a new boss but more like an extra type of "normal" zombies)
Note: Another character is still being finished. Stay tuned for that!
[*]Airdrops have been buffed globally in every game-mode airdrops appear. [*]Airdrops should appear more often now.
[*]The GD Airdrop Caller icon is now updated so that players can see a visual difference between the two different airdrop callers to avoid scamming.
[*]Reworked the daily reward item list. Removed more "useless items" and added a lot of new variate in items. Daily reward should reward players generally with better items now. Here's more in-depth notes about the exact changes:
[*]Removed the normal skinbox from the daily reward.
[*]Added numerous of new different items as daily reward.
Increased the spawn protection timer for players after using the bus system. (due fast load) Spawn protection is now 5 seconds longer after using the bus system.
[*]Player's stamina will now reset to 100% after using the bus system.
[*]Added the "Mystery Skinbox" to the Deluxe reward system.
[*]Added the "Alien, Jedi & Hynx Skinbox" to the Extreme reward system.
[*]Health Bar Percentage shows an accuracy of up to 0.1% when low health. [*]We thought this would be useful for some players!
[*]Players can no longer place down cars or other vehicles while walking. [*]Players can only place vehicles while standing still now.
[*]Players can now stack empty weapons even if they had different kinds of ammo inside the weapon. This has been a huge request by our community and we are very happy we were able to make this happen. Player's global inventories will now look way cleaner than ever before. (This indirectly fixes the bug where player's can't stack the same weapon that's empty. Now they are able to.)
[*]Players can no longer pick up or place vehicles that are under 5% durability.
[*]Beginner servers are now officially and permanently removed. We have announced this a while back to avoid confusion for our community and we recommend everyone that wants to know why exactly the beginner servers got removed to read the following thread: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/1101-beginner-servers-are-going-to-be-removed/
[*]Beginning players will now have a new dedicated info screen explain the basics of the game / menu and the game-modes. We felt this was needed after removing the beginner servers to help the new players get into the game easier and faster. Please note that every account might have this screen the first time you start the game after this patch.
[*]Weapons you get from the daily reward system are brand new, so now it shows properly that its a brand new weapon. (This wasn't showing properly in the UI before.)
[*]Fixed a bug related to while being inside a vehicle where the stamina bar didn't update. The stamina bar now visually updates too while driving.
[*]Fixed texture issues related to the antenna model. (Used for example in [*]Colorado V2 on top of the airport tower.)
[*]Fixed an issue related to the Tactical Weapon Crate where players could bring them from the Open World game-mode into the Survival game-mode. [*]This is no longer possible. Players who did this have been punished.
[*]Fixed the "Report Players" loading screen spelling mistype.
[*]Fixed the loudness problem of the shooting sound of the mosin. (rifle)
[*]Fixed an issue related to reviving characters. Players are now able to revive their characters properly again. (This fix has already been live for a while)
[*]Fixed a huge issue that allowed players to glitch inside buildings and other big objects by logging out on top of a riot shield or other high objects. When players try to do this they will now be forced crouched while joining back in the server not allowing them to glitch inside somewhere.
[*]Fixed a bug where the time capsule text editor would bug and block you from writing to it.
[/list]

[h1]Server Updates:[/h1]

This section isn't entirely related to the "servers" but we just titled it like that to avoid confusion. We would like to explain a major and game-breaking issue that has been happening in the game ever since we released on Steam. The problem here goes as following: (This is also how players reported this issue many times)

"New Z has servers in 4 different regions in the world. The problem is that anyone can play anywhere which is causing numerous amounts of issues for players playing against each other from different kind of regions of the world. For example: players from Thailand play on the EU servers and make it harder for EU players to play because they have to fight players that have a bad connection aka high ping."

We would like to go more in-depth about the "high ping" part that we mentioned above and we would like to explain what we updated in the game to avoid these issues. So, what happened?

Added a ping limit system to the servers. (Please read more information about this below since this isn't just a ping limit system as you think it is.)
The ping-limit system that we are using is not IN the actual server but it's in the menu. How does this work? Basically New Z will have 2 type of game servers:
[list]
[*]1) Normal server.
[*]2) Ping Limited server. (Limit is dynamically decided by us but on default 100 ms.)
[/list]
After this update half of the New Z server will be type 2 and half of the servers will be type 1. Players are able to see in the menu which servers are type 2 and which servers are type 1. We will explain now how the ping limit system works: New Z checks the player's ping while loading the servers list. When a player wants to join a type 1 server he can do that with no problems but when a player wants to join a type 2 server the game checks if the player's ping is lower than the max. allowed ping on that server. This will allow EU players (that have low ping to EU servers) to always join the EU ping limited servers but for example players from Thailand (who in no matter what they do with their internet connection) will ALWAYS have a higher ping than 100 ms not allowing them to even join the server. Next to that WHILE being inside a server IF you manage to have your ping going over 100 ms (for example when you have lagg) the server will behave normally and not kick you from the server or anything else.

This will result that players always have to play in the region that's closest to them. Players that don't like to play in a ping limited server can still play in a normal type server but then there's a chance they play against people with a high ping / bad connection. This will be their own choice.

Why haven't we added a ping limit system before? We haven't thought "outside of the box yet" and basically the only solution we saw was an inside-server ping limit system where players would simply get kicked if their ping was too high. We never wanted to do this since this would probably cause a lot of players to leave the game. Now we finally came up with a better system.

If you have any more questions about this feel free to ask them in the comments or on our other social media channels.

[h1]Skin Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new skinbox called: "Revolution Skinbox". (Check our social media channels to see when this skinbox will be released)
[*]Added new skins in the Hynx Skinbox called "Hynx v2" skins. See below what skins are added in the box.
[*]Added a new SVD skin to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "SVD Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new Adventure Backpack skin to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "Adventure Backpack Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new Karambit to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "Karambit Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new IMI TAR skin to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "IMI TAR Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new K. Style Helmet skin to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "K. Style Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new K. Style NVG Helmet skin to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "K. Style NVG Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new Heavy Armor skin to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "Heavy [*]Armor Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new Custom Guerilla skin to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "Custom Guerilla Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new Moto Helmet skin to the "Hynx Skinbox" called: "Moto Helmet Hynx v2".
[*]Added a new B92 skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "B92 Aquaris".
[*]Added a new Bat skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "Bat Reaver".
[*]Added a new Frying Pan skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "Frying Pan Ravanger".
[*]Added a new IBA Sand skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "IBA Insanity".
[*]Added a new M4 Semi skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "M4 Semi Knightfall".
[*]Added a new M16 skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "M16 Equalizer".
[*]Added a new M107 skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "M107 Valkyrie".
[*]Added a new Medium Backpack skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "Medium Backpack Delirium".
[*]Added a new MP5 skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "MP5 Soulburn".
[*]Added a new Heavy Armor skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "Heavy Armor Serenity".
[*]Added a new K. Style Helmet skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "K. Style Serenity".
[*]Added a new PKM skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "PKM Fury".
[*]Added a new Karambit skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "Karambit Deathraze".
[*]Added a new SVD skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "SVD Daywalker".
[*]Added a new M4A1 skin to the new "Revolution Skinbox" called: "M4A1 Peacemaker".
[*]Added a new IMI TAR skin to the "Elite Skinbox" called: "IMI TAR Elite".
[*]Fixed the details of the skinned versions of the M4A1.
[*]Fixed some "Fun Edition" skin names and descriptions.
[*]The OTs-03 SVU "Fun Edition" now has a skinned PSO scope attached by default. (Fun Edition PSO Scope)
[*]The Fredaikis's Hat is now a skin. Everyone who had the actual hat as an item will still have it + those people who had at least one of the hat's in their global inventory will automatically already have this skin learned. The hat is a skin for the K. Style Helmet.
[*]With the new "Revolution Skinbox" coming out we are permanently saying goodbye to the "Epic Skinbox". This means the Epic Skinbox is no longer available in the in-game marketplace and won't ever come back. Chances in the "Epic Skinbox" will stay the same as how they are right now and all skins inside the "Epic Skinbox" will stay inside. Dear Players,

(ORIGINAL PATCH NOTES: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/1207-patch-notes-20170810/)

Here we finally are! The patch is about to be released and we're very excited to share these pre-patch not for tomorrow morning with you. We are sorry it took a little bit longer to finish this patch due summer & longer testing. This patch contains a lot of exciting new things for example: we have finally finished the ping limiter, a new character system rework & new clothes, a lot of new skins, a lot of new items, a lot of new features and a lot of fixes! Now, let's jump into the actual patch notes for more info:

Btw, if you have any questions regarding one of the notes, feel free to ask us anything in the comments!

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Two new character models are now available! Check out the in-game marketplace for prices. Let us know what you think of these new characters in the comments.
[*]There's also a new zombie model finished. We would like to NOT share any pictures of this new zombie so that our community can find it in-game themselves. Let us know if you've found any of the new zombies. (Note: The new zombies aren't like a new boss but more like an extra type of "normal" zombies)
Note: Another character is still being finished. Stay tuned for that!
[*]Airdrops have been buffed globally in every game-mode airdrops appear. [*]Airdrops should appear more often now.
[*]The GD Airdrop Caller icon is now updated so that players can see a visual difference between the two different airdrop callers to avoid scamming.
[*]Reworked the daily reward item list. Removed more "useless items" and added a lot of new variate in items. Daily reward should reward players generally with better items now. Here's more in-depth notes about the exact changes:
[*]Removed the normal skinbox from the daily reward.
[*]Added numerous of new different items as daily reward.
Increased the spawn protection timer for players after using the bus system. (due fast load) Spawn protection is now 5 seconds longer after using the bus system.
[*]Player's stamina will now reset to 100% after using the bus system.
[*]Added the "Mystery Skinbox" to the Deluxe reward system.
[*]Added the "Alien, Jedi & Hynx Skinbox" to the Extreme reward system.
[*]Health Bar Percentage shows an accuracy of up to 0.1% when low health. [*]We thought this would be useful for some players!
[*]Players can no longer place down cars or other vehicles while walking. [*]Players can only place vehicles while standing still now.
[*]Players can now stack empty weapons even if they had different kinds of ammo inside the weapon. This has been a huge request by our community and we are very happy we were able to make this happen. Player's global inventories will now look way cleaner than ever before. (This indirectly fixes the bug where player's can't stack the same weapon that's empty. Now they are able to.)
[*]Players can no longer pick up or place vehicles that are under 5% durability.
[*]Beginner servers are now officially and permanently removed. We have announced this a while back to avoid confusion for our community and we recommend everyone that wants to know why exactly the beginner servers got removed to read the following thread: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/1101-beginner-servers-are-going-to-be-removed/
[*]Beginning players will now have a new dedicated info screen explain the basics of the game / menu and the game-modes. We felt this was needed after removing the beginner servers to help the new players get into the game easier and faster. Please note that every account might have this screen the first time you start the game after this patch.
[*]Weapons you get from the daily reward system are brand new, so now it shows properly that its a brand new weapon. (This wasn't showing properly in the UI before.)
[*]Fixed a bug related to while being inside a vehicle where the stamina bar didn't update. The stamina bar now visually updates too while driving.
[*]Fixed texture issues related to the antenna model. (Used for example in [*]Colorado V2 on top of the airport tower.)
[*]Fixed an issue related to the Tactical Weapon Crate where players could bring them from the Open World game-mode into the Survival game-mode. [*]This is no longer possible. Players who did this have been punished.
[*]Fixed the "Report Players" loading screen spelling mistype.
[*]Fixed the loudness problem of the shooting sound of the mosin. (rifle)
[*]Fixed an issue related to reviving characters. Players are now able to revive their characters properly again. (This fix has already been live for a while)
[*]Fixed a huge issue that allowed players to glitch inside buildings and other big objects by logging out on top of a riot shield or other high objects. When players try to do this they will now be forced crouched while joining back in the server not allowing them to glitch inside somewhere.
[*]Fixed a bug where the time capsule text editor would bug and block you from writing to it.
[/list]

[h1]Server Updates:[/h1]

This section isn't entirely related to the "servers" but we just titled it like that to avoid confusion. We would like to explain a major and game-breaking issue that has been happening in the game ever since we released on Steam. The problem here goes as following: (This is also how players reported this issue many times)

"New Z has servers in 4 different regions in the world. The problem is that anyone can play anywhere which is causing numerous amounts of issues for players playing against each other from different kind of regions of the world. For example: players from Thailand play on the EU servers and make it harder for EU players to play because they have to fight players that have a bad connection aka high ping."

We would like to go more in-depth about the "high ping" part that we mentioned above and we would like to explain what we updated in the game to avoid these issues. So, what happened?

Added a ping limit system to the servers. (Please read more information about this below since this isn't just a ping limit system as you think it is.)
The ping-limit system that we are using is not IN the actual server but it's in the menu. How does this work? Basically New Z will have 2 type of game servers:
[list]
[*]1) Normal server.
[*]2) Ping Limited server. (Limit is dynamically decided by us but on default 100 ms.)
[/list]
After this update half of the New Z server will be type 2 and half of the servers will be type 1. Players are able to see in the menu which servers are type 2 and which servers are type 1. We will explain now how the ping limit system works: New Z checks the player's ping while loading the servers list. When a player wants to join a type 1 server he can do that with no problems but when a player wants to join a type 2 server the game checks if the player's ping is lower than the max. allowed ping on that server. This will allow EU players (that have low ping to EU servers) to always join the EU ping limited servers but for example players from Thailand (who in no matter what they do with their internet connection) will ALWAYS have a higher ping than 100 ms not allowing them to even join the server. Next to that WHILE being inside a server IF you manage to have your ping going over 100 ms (for example when you have lagg) the server will behave normally and not kick you from the server or anything else.

This will result that players always have to play in the region that's closest to them. Players that don't like to play in a ping limited server can still play in a normal type server but then there's a chance they play against people with a high ping / bad connection. This will be their own choice.

Why haven't we added a ping limit system before? We haven't thought "outside of the box yet" and basically the only solution we saw was an inside-server ping limit system where players would simply get kicked if their ping was too high. We never wanted to do this since this would probably cause a lot of players to leave the game. Now we finally came up with a better system.

If you have any more questions about this feel free to ask them in the comments or on our other social media channels.

[h1]Character System Rework:[/h1]

Like mentioned in earlier developer blogs we have finally reworked the entire character system. There's a lot that happened behind the scenes related to this but to explain you all in the easiest way we will only explain what's changed for you guys. The character system rework contains a new system the way characters and character clothes (customization) works. With this new system all character clothes will transform into actual items (kind of like the way the spawn protection colors work now). New character clothes will be available in the future - those will be sold.

Most important for players to know is that all the character clothes that are in-game right now will all stay free. (New character clothes that will be added in the future will most likely not be free.)
We would like to explain that we haven't reworked the character system because we want to sell the character clothes. The main reason we have reworked the character system of the game is because this allows us to add new characters way easier and work with characters in general easier. On top of that it allows us to start adding a lot of new clothes and other customization's much easier than before. The biggest change is that with this new system when buying a character a player will no longer automatically have all the clothes and parts for that character. Summed up this is a short summary of the change:
[list]
[*]A lot happened behind the scenes allowing us to add new characters and clothes much easier than before.
[*]The character customization screen has been changed / updated to adapt to the new character system.
[*]Character clothes and parts are now actual items. Future parts will be available in the in-game marketplace.
[*]The way characters work in our engine has been optimized generally.
Clothes, parts and characters will stay account based meaning that once a character is bought (can only be done once) you can use this character for every game-mode unlimited amount of times. The same goes for the future-added new character clothes and parts: once a character cloth or part is bought you will have it permanently on your account.
[/list]

WARNING: Everyone's character customization's will be reset after this update! You will still be able to skin your character back to clothes you had, you'll just have to re-do that. Our excuses for this.

Here's some more updates we did related to the characters:
[list]
[*]One of the Average Joe character body's textures have been updated due copyright reasons.
[/list]

[h1]Survival Updates:[/h1]

[b]OVERALL:[/b]
[list]
[*]Zombies & zombie AI has been completely reset to "normal". Zombies no longer behave like the custom system we've made meaning zombies in [*]Survival are now exactly as how they are in open world. Keep in mind that they are still head-shot only to be killed.
[*]Grouping has now been enabled in survival up to 3 players max. Grouping has been disabled since the release of survival and we felt (based on feedback from our community) that grouping was definitively a useful and wanted feature and therefor we've added it back.
[/list]

[b]MAP:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added back the tint function to the grass.
[*]Removed the broken ambient sound which was close to camp splinter.
[/list]

[b]COMING SOON:[/b]
[list]
[*]CRAFTING! Yes, we hope to finish crafting for survival in the next upcoming patch! Stay tuned for progress.
[/list]

Thanks everyone for helping us making the new survival game-mode best as possible. We will keep working on the game-mode based on your feedback!

[h1]Battle Royale Updates:[/h1]

[b]OVERALL:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an animation bug in Battle Royale where if players would throw a grenade in warm-up right before the Battle Royale starts, their character animation would glitch upon spawning in Battle Royale. Thanks everyone for pointing out this issue to us.
[*]Disabled the AFK kick on Battle Royale. Players that are AFK will no longer automatically get kicked.
[/list]

[h1]Map Updates:[/h1]

[b]LOUNGE:[/b]
[list]
[*]Disabled physics of the backpacks due FPS drops. (There's some backpacks placed in the map for show.)
[*]Added back the crashed airplane (and parts) outside of the map in the ocean.
[*]Lowered the volume of the ambient sounds in general. Thanks for letting us know the sounds were too loud!
[/list]

[b]COLORADO V2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed the old secret spot.
[*]Added a new secret spot. (Good luck finding the new secret spot!)
[*]Copied over the lighting/terrain settings from the Colorado Survival Map. [*]Colorado V2 now has an amazing new look!
[*]Fixed a miss-placed thrash can object in Smallville behind the post office.
[*]Fixed a miss-placed item spawn on top of the medic in Smallville.
[*]Added back the tint settings to the grass. (Same as on the Survival Colorado map.)
[*]Added some collision walls around the "beach house" in Boulder City.
[/list]

[b]CALIWOOD:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed the old secret spot.
[*]Added a new secret spot. (Good luck finding the new secret spot!)
[*]Fixed some misplaced objects for example: walls, which were to high.
[/list]

[b]COLORADO V1:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new secret spot. (Good luck finding the new secret spot!)
[/list]


[b]Patch is expected to roll out tomorrow morning: Thursday, August 10, 2017 around 11:00 AM (UTC+2)[/b]

To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/infestationnewz
Discord: https://discord.gg/gafUzrD

Best Regards,

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

[*]You can now see the positions of dead or revived characters in the character screen map!

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/06/30 (New Game-Mode: Survival)
notes.content:
Dear Players,


The long awaited moment is finally there! Survival is ready. After a lot of testing, patching, beta testing we are finally done with the first version of our new game-mode: survival. Are you ready?! First of all we want to thank everyone for participating in the beta testing for survival. You guys saved us a lot of times and came up with a lot of good feedback. We are rewarding everyone who participated in the beta testing period with a special gift. Read more about that below.

Now, before we jump into the patch notes we would like to ask you to read the following:

[h1]Twitch.tv / YouTube Event:[/h1]
To promote the release of the new game-mode: survival we are doing a 2-3 week event where streamers and YouTubers can help us promote the new game-mode and in return get awesome rewards like free GC, Airdrops or even a streamer tag permanently in-game. For more information please go to: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/594-twitchtv-youtube-event-get-free-gc-more/

Now, let's get into the patch notes:

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Backpack slots / weight changes done last patch have been reverted. [*]Survival will use different backpack statistics now. Thanks everyone for the feedback we hope everything related to the backpacks / slots / weight is fine again now. Also due this change backpack skins will NOT work on survival permanently.
[*]The ranking system has been added back to open world.
Added new informative loading screens. We will keep doing this more frequently.
[*]Players who played the new game-mode: survival during the beta testing will receive a new custom skin: "Kruger Rifle Survival". Why a kruger rifle? - We wanted a skin for something unique - funny - and a common item in survival. Thanks to everyone who helped us testing in the beta!
[*]Fixed a crash related to equipping a tactical sniper scope to a SVD.
[*]Fixed a bug with operating your Open World Global Inventory.
[*]Fixed some crashes related to some players having huge Global Inventories.
[*]Fixed a bug causing "Disconnected From Server" when using a melee.
[*]Fixed an issue regarding reloading / unloading clip not stacking sometimes.
[*]Fixed a bug that characters couldn't be rotated after creation.
[*]Putting the game on potato quality will now force SSAO and Anti-aliasing off. [*]People weren't aware that these settings affected FPS and performance so much. Now these settings automatically get adjusted in case people forget.
[/list]
[h1]Skin Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the P90 Trigon Wave to the Normal Skinbox.
[*]Added the Blaser Army Black to the Premium Skinbox.
[*]Added the Blaser Hollandia to the World Skinbox.
[*]Added a new skin: "Kruger Rifle Survival". This skin is ONLY given to ALL players that played the survival beta.
[*]Fixed the Blaser Army Black recipe icon.
[/list]
[h1]Item Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Riot Shield P4sC4L store icon. This Riot Shield will be added back to the in-game marketplace after this patch.
[*]Fixed the Riot Shield China description.
[*]Fixed the M9 Helmet Black Goggles item name.
[*]Fixed the Uncle Sam's Hat Red protection.
[/list]
[h1]Building Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem with some buildings where a fence wasn't visible from two sides. http://prntscr.com/fordbs
[/list]
[h1]New Leaderboards:[/h1]
With survival being released this patch we have finally reworked the leaderboards in the main menu. There's now independent leaderboards for each game-mode meaning survival will have it's own unique leaderboard. This also means that for the new game-mode, everyone will start from an entirely wiped / clear leaderboard. Isn't that awesome? Battle Royale leaderboard for now, only contains wins.

[h1]Survival Updates:[/h1]
We're finally here. The release of our third game-mode: survival. This is a moment a big part of our community has been waiting for since the Steam release. We've seen so much hype, demand, questions, and discussions about this new game-mode. We are very excited to finally be able to release survival and even play it ourselves! For survival we have independent patch notes since this is an independent game-mode:

[b]RELEASE NOTES:[/b]
[list]
[*]On the official release of survival we will have 10 official servers in each region. For the beta release 10 servers were too much but now with the official release, since premium and normal players can play now, we expect way more people to come. In case servers start to become too full we can always restart and add more.
[*]Favorites and Recent added to survival. Players can now use these two buttons for the new game-mode properly.
[*]EVERYONE's statistics including player's global inventories WILL BE WIPED (ONLY SURVIVAL GLOBAL INVENTORIES) for the official release. On the official release (after this patch) everyone will start from 0. There will NEVER be a wipe again after this moment.
[/list]
[b]MAP:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the streets in Frosty Pines and Greenwood Springs, they had grass on it with broken physics.
[*]Fixed the re-spawn timer of the super zombie in camp splinter. Super zombies should never spawn back instantly.
[*]Fixed the global ambient sounds. Re-added the 'old WarZ' ambient sounds back. These should work properly now.
[*]Fixed the re-spawn timer of zombies and super zombies. This is done on multiple locations around the whole map.
[*]Fixed the loot tables of super zombies. Also updated the loot for them. (Check 'Loot' section of these notes)
[*]Fixed a shadow problem when having NVG's turned on. (Check 'Game Play' section of these notes)
[*]Fixed some flying objects around Greenwood Springs.
[*]Fixed the loot in Sleepy Crest. Also fixed the missing zombies problem here.
[*]Fixed the missing zombies problem at Delta Peak Ranger Station.
[*]Added back the small military camp on top of the middle bridge in Campos City. (Community was requesting this since the old Colorado V2 from Infestation had this place too.)
[*]Removed the radioactive zones for now. (They will come back later when they are entirely finished - should be soon).
[/list]
[b]GAME PLAY:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the small circle shadow if you have night vision on.
[*]Backpacks are now different in survival than in open world. Backpacks for survival stay the same, open world have been reverted.
As already mentioned earlier, backpack skins will not work in survival.
[*]Zombies are nerfed / fixed. Our goal from the start was to make zombies more 'a thing' in survival. By making them harder to fight, they also became more buggy / glitched. We have been aware of this from the beginning. We have now done necessary changes and the zombies should work properly now.
[*]Synced the Zombie animations with the damage in Survival. This was a big part of the reported problems. Zombies before were hitting you but you weren't taking damage or zombies were not hitting you and you would take damage. Now zombies only damage you when you actually see them hitting you.
[*]Fixed a problem where players could not switch backpack.
[*]Fixed the bleeding icon. (icon was showing up as "bleeding" even though the player was not bleeding)
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause open world items to end up in survival.
[*]Heartbeat sound (when being low HP) is now lowered. (less loud)
[/list]
[b]LOOT:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased painkiller and bandage spawns.
[*]Increased amount of items in the civilian loot group. A more variate amount of items should spawn now.
[*]Increased the chances of shovels in the civilian loot group.
[*]Added normal bandages to the zombie loot. Players can now get bandages from normal zombies.
[*]Added more weapons to the random airdrop loot.
[*]Added the civilian NVG to the civilian loot table.
[*]Lowered the chances of empty spawns of Super Zombies. Super zombies should drop better gear now.
[*]Lowered the chances of silencers.
[*]Lowered the chances of custom guerilla.
[*]Lowered the chances of attachments.
[*]Lowered the chances of alice backpacks.
[*]Lowered the chances of m9 NVG's.
[*]Removed the desert eagle spawns from item boxes.
[*]Removed the excessive force (melee) from spawning. This item will still be available later when crafting is enabled.
[/list]
[h1]Map Updates:[/h1]

[b]OVERALL:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered the terrain quality for "Potato" and "Low". This is also done to increase FPS and performance.
[*]Optimized the shadow quality overall on each map. This is also done to increase FPS and performance.
[/list]
[b]SAN PAVEL:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered the overall contrast. (vision) The map should overall be less bright now.
[/list]
[b]CALIWOOD:[/b]
[list]
[*]Higher-ed the amount of zombies around the beach area's.
[/list]

Patch will roll out ANY TIME after these patch notes get published.

Best Regards,

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Survival Beta Closing Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Players,


We would like to update you all with the latest news regarding the survival beta and the upcoming patch.

Now with the beta for survival almost being over we would like to update you all on what's the current status regarding the development and release of this new game mode and what's the status and planning for the next upcoming game update.

The Survival beta will close tomorrow: June 28, Wednesday around 11:00 AM (UTC+2). We would like to ask everyone who has played the beta to let us know what their feedback is by going to our forums -> survival and create a post there! YOUR FEEDBACK is extremely important to us so don't hesitate to let us know if you haven't already. (Create a feedback post in this section: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/forum/62-feedback/ )

After we have closed the survival beta we will finish up the game mode and based on feedback from our community we will do all necessary changes. We will release the final draft about all the final features and decisions for survival together with the next patch notes. This will be upcoming Friday.

Upcoming Friday there will be a final patch that contains all the changes we have done on survival based on feedback from our community and testing. This patch will not only contain changes for the survival game-mode but also other major content and fixes. Stay tuned for these patch notes. (Patch date ETA: June 30, Friday, 2017)

Link to original forum post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/554-survival-beta-closing-soon/


Best Regards,
// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/06/23
notes.content:
Dear Players,

[h1]READ MORE HERE ABOUT SURVIVAL BETA TESTING! https://goo.gl/3vQyKD[/h1]

We are finally there! Survival beta IS READY and will be enabled tomorrow morning on the patch. Together with the survival beta we will release a huge patch with a lot of updates and fixes. Before jumping into the patch notes we have a short video about the update. We highly recommend you to read the patch notes anyways since a lot of the patch is not covered in the video. Now, let's jump into the patch notes..

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IqKOGjBqG7A&l0k

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Because of some changes in backpack statistics all items that were in backpacks have been transferred to player's global inventories. (more information about this change can be found under the "Survival" section of the patch notes.)
[*]Muting a player will now also mute the invite sound for that player.
[*]We finally figured out the footstep sound issues: the third skill (green) was causing this because the skill was nerfing footsteps sounds too much. This has been fixed.
[*]The compass in the UI is smoother when in third-person.
Shields and other barricades can now be placed normally in buildings again. We have fixed the issues that were causing this.
[*]Fixed the issue that caused skinned versions of MTV's to spawn in-game. Skinned MTV's no longer spawn.
[*]Fixed some UI / Lang.pack problems where the beginner server information would still say 12 hours. Updated to 72 hours.
[*]Fixed the mouse sensitivity bar in the settings. The bar is 'less sensitive now' and changing sensitivity should be easier now.
[*]Fixed various UI bugs related to the settings menu. All settings options that had problems are fixed now.
[*]Fixed various Anti-Cheat related crashes. Anti-Cheat is now more optimized and will work better now.
[*]Fixed a server crash related to players accessing their global inventories while being in a server.
[*]Fixed a server crash that was only caused in the Lounge.
[*]Fixed a visual bug causing characters to show "darkened" in the main menu after logging out with close to no health left.
[*]Fixed a bug in Battle Royale where using a melee would deal 0 damage, this also happened after using grenades.|
[*]Fixed a client-sided crash related to the networking system of the game.
[*]Fixed a very common crash that players were having when logging in and out of servers constantly.
[*]Fixed some server kicks related to the in-game trading window.
[*]Fixed a small bug with riot shields causing them to "fly" in the air when placed.
[*]Added a new global game setting option: "Potato". This is done to spread out the quality changes to better adapt to peoples computers or desired fps.
[*]Added an extra blood indicator to show averagely what direction damage comes from. This should make it easier for players to for example fight other players that have silenced weapons since the player that's getting shot at, will now also be able to visually see where he's getting shot from.
[/list]
[h1]Reworked Hit-marker System:[/h1]
Due lot's of complaints from players we have reworked the entire system. Hit-markers, including the normal and the red ones, are now fully server sided. This means that hit-markers will only appear when the server registered the shot and the other player took actual damage. This will fix all issues and complaints related to players reporting to hit a player but the other player is not die-ing.

[h1]Icon Updates:[/h1]
So we have finally decided to rework all in-game gun icons due the following reasons: Some gun icons don't look like how the gun actually looks in-game, some skin icons don't look how the skin looks in-game, Some icons are not good quality, some icons are not made using the same camera angle and more issues. Next to that by doing this we can finally make icons look more realistic and make our game more unique in general. We are now also able to make more detailed skin icons that will always look exactly like how the skin would look in-game. It's very important for us to do this since players pay real money for these skins. For more information about the icon rework project we recommend you to read the following developer blog: https://goo.gl/Gdh3zV

[b]RIOT SHIELDS:[/b]
[list]
All Riot Shield icons have been reworked and updated.
[/list]
[b]WEAPONS:[/b]
[list]

[h1]Battle Royale Updates:[/h1]

This makes it practically very hard to team since you don't know who is your friend. We hope this will fix all issues related to players abusing the Battle Royale system and team up in huge groups. The advantage now lays at the solo player's side instead of the grouping player's side.

For now this is how we have Battle Royale. We have plans to later (when the lobby / matchmaking system for Competitive is done) also enable a teaming lobby for Battle Royale. This will follow most likely later.

[h1]Survival Beta Release:[/h1]

As promised to our community here we finally are: the patch that enables the survival beta. The survival beta will be a testing period where certain players can already play survival so that we can gather feedback and guarantee that the survival game mode will be perfect upon release. For more information about the progress and development of this game mode we recommend you to read this developer blog: https://goo.gl/yEERNm

After the beta testing is over we will close the survival game mode temporary to finish it. Then, the game mode will be fully released. Please keep in mind that all progress that's made by beta testers will be wiped. On official release everyone will start from 0. Beta testers will not have any advantages. For more information about the beta testing and for general information about the game mode we recommend you to read the following announcement:

The final survival beta draft: (With these key-points survival will be beta released)

[b]An introduction: (What is Survival)[/b]

Survival is a brand new game-mode in Infestation: The New Z that's entirely based on the old Infestation game-play. A big part of the Infestation: The New Z players came from the original game Infestation: Survivor Stories and came to New Z with the expectations it would be similar to the old game. We all know NewZ is not like Infestation and a lot has changed. One big change is the rarity of loot. Some people like this, some people don't. After developing NewZ for almost 2 years now we have always wanted to bring back that old Infestation feeling by having a game where loot is rare and has value and a game that is generally more aimed to survival. Wiping wasn't an option due our past so our only chances in ever making a game like this was by having it inside NewZ as a separate game-mode: Survival. Basically survival will be an independent game-mode in Infestation: The New Z that's aimed to being like the old Infestation with survival aspects (like crafting) added.

[b]The key points:[/b]
[*]Separate game-mode meaning all statistics are separated from the other game-modes: open world & battle royale. 
[*]An independent new global inventory. No global inventory access everywhere but ONLY in safe-zones marked around the map. Players will be able to access their global inventory after reviving their character.
[*]Original independent Infestation Colorado V2 map. Of course there will be changes done by us but we will follow the main legacy version of Colorado V2 originally created for Infestation.
[*]No early revival. Since there's no currency for this game mode yet early revival won't be possible. Revive timers will be 10 minutes, premium revive timers will be half of that: 5 minutes.
[*]No game dollars. There won't be a currency yet but at some point we will most likely introduce a currency.
Original XP from zombies and super zombies. Premium will have double XP. [*]Normal XP from zombies will be 5 XP per zombie and from super zombies you will get 250 XP.
[*]No private servers will be available on release. We will most likely introduce private servers at a later state.
[*]There will be lockers but they will only be loot-able and they will be extremely rare. Lockers will be disabled at start.
[*]Original zombie spawns. Super zombies will spawn in the same locations as they did in Infestation. Normal zombies also spawn in their original places like in Infestation. Zombies will only give players possible items and XP since game dollars are disabled and there's no other currency.
[*]Clans and groups are disabled. We might introduce this at a later state but for the first release this will both be disabled. The main reason clans and groups are disabled is because we do not want the bigger groups to have an advantage over the solo players. Players are still allowed to group up however they like but without any tags. It will be hard to know who is your friend and who not. We think this will be a lot of fun!
5 new dedicated characters for this game-mode only.
[*]Independent skill-tree. Epic skills from NewZ have been removed. We are planning to rework the entire skill-tree at a later state. (Add more skills and change the way the skill-tree works)
[*]Car spawners are completely removed / disabled. Cars will be enabled but they will only spawn randomly around the map (like in Infestation). Players will not be able to pick up cars. Cars will use gasoline. Gasoline is find-able in-game.
[*]Hunger and thirst will be present and will be a big part of the game-play.
[*]Bleeding and infection has been added back. To recover from bleeding a player has to use a bandage. To recover from infection a player has to use a vaccine. Those items will be find-able in-game.
[/list]
[b]Updated / Added by the NewZ development team:[/b]
[list]
[*]Zombie AI has been updated and reworked by us. Zombies are generally smarter and stronger. After testing this turned out to be way more fun and zombies are a bit more of a challenge now.
[*]Zombies have a lower detection radius when they're not facing you. This will allow players to for example sneak up behind zombies and not get detected until the zombie turns around and actually sees the player. Then the zombie will aggro.
[*]More screaming and sprinting zombies to make them a bit more of a challenge.
[*]Random airdrops are enabled just like how they are in open world but they will spawn own dedicated items like sniper ammo, low grade snipers, high grade guns and other valuable loot. Random airdrops are random and rare.
[*]Bus system is present but only in safe-zones. Travelling using the bus system is free. You can only travel from safe-zone to safe-zone.
[/list]
[b]Still in development:[/b]
[list]
[*]Crafting & that further into base building. Crafting is ALMOST finished, but it will be released in later updates.
[*]Loot balancing (overall). This will be finished during beta based on test player's experience and feedback. Balancing of loot is practically already done at this moment.
[*]Re-balancing of items. Since the game uses one database for the item statistics and survival will have the same statistics on for example weapons like how they are in open world we will have to change some statistics. This will be done based on feedback and experience.
[/list]
For more information about the beta release, how you can help testing, etc, you can read this announcement: https://goo.gl/5c2nta

[h1]Survival (New Game-Mode) Updates:[/h1]

Since this is a patch containing development updates for the game we will also list out all the changes / development / progress that's technically made on the survival game mode. Again, for more information about the new game mode we recommend you to read the announcement listed earlier.

Since survival will be using a different (old) Colorado v2 there will be separate changes done on this map. Here's the updates / changes we have done to the Colorado of survival:
[list]
[*]Optimized shadow and lighting quality. Lighting is different than on the open world Colorado.
[*]Added bus stops to every safe zone. Players can travel for free from safe zone to safe zone.
[*]Changed the day-night cycle. Less night, more daytime.
[/list]
Since survival will use the same item statistics as open world we are re-balancing some items. These changes are for the entire game affecting each game mode. We are doing this to make survival more balanced. The following changes are done (for now): 
[list]
[*]Normal NVG Goggles now have 0% protection. (NVG Goggles Civilian & NVG Goggles Military)
[*]All masks now have 8% protection. (Shadow mask, slash mask, etc..)
[*]All normal hats now have 3% protection. (Everything except military helmets)
[*]Small backpack size has been decreased to 8 slots and max. carry weight to 15 kg.
[*]Teddy Bear backpack size has been decreased to 14 slots and max. carry weight to 20 kg.
[*]Medium backpack size has been decreased to 18 slots and max. carry weight to 25 kg.
[*]Large backpack size has been decreased to 25 slots and max. carry weight to 50 kg.
[*]Alice backpack size has been decreased to 40 slots and max. carry weight to 60 kg.
[*]Santa's Sack size has been decreased to 45 slots and max. carry weight to 60 kg.
[*]Military Backpack size has been decreased to 60 slots and max. carry weight to 100 kg.
Double Barrel reload time has been increased.
[*]Fixed the m16 + skins fire rate. The skins had different fire rates than the original un-skinned gun.
[/list]
NOTE: We will be doing more changes before the official release based on feedback we gather during the beta testing.

[h1]UI Updates:[/h1]

First of all we have reworked the menu UI. The main reason we have done this is because now that survival is about to be released the game and it's independent game-modes need to make sense in a logical way. With these changes we think the game is easier to understand generally and the menu more 'user friendly' to use. Here's what exactly we have done.
[list]
[*]When starting the game the first menu a player gets to now is the menu where the player has to select the game-mode the player wants to play.
http://i.imgur.com/y0nEt12.jpg
[*]When a game-mode is chosen the player can still switch game modes by using the button at the top left of the screen.
http://i.imgur.com/PxaAdRW.png
[*]When hovering over the button it will display as this:
http://i.imgur.com/rklrTqW.png
[*]To make the way the marketplace works more clear we added a big text saying: "all items bought in the marketplace will go into the open world inventory".
http://i.imgur.com/VACSZu8.png
[/list]
Second of that we have reworked the in-game UI. This is mainly done for survival since we had to add back bleeding and infection but we decided to rework the entire in-game UI completely because 'we might as well' do it while we're add it. This are the changes we have done:
[list]
[*]The left part of the UI is entirely reworked. There's a new health bar, we have added a minimap and statistics are removed since the text of those displaying was too small anyways.
https://image.prntscr.com/image/5ePKVa0QQU6Lyv0HAxGi9w.png
[*]The ammo part of the UI (right part) now ONLY pops up / displays when a weapon is selected that has ammo. For example on the picture a VSS is selected by the player and then the ammo pops up. If a melee is equipped nothing on the down right of the screen will show.
Players can scroll to zoom in and out in-game in the minimap.
[*]The car UI (when being inside a vehicle) now adapts and uses the same menu instead of adding a new element to the UI. This is how the UI looks when being inside of a vehicle:
https://image.prntscr.com/image/dIBE2BZvQn6WhwjNjJKe3A.png
[/list]
[h1]Map Updates:[/h1]

[b]San Pavel (Release):[/b]
[list]
[*]San Pavel is now released and available as PVP map in the PVP section of Open World.
[/list]
[b]Colorado V2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added smaller (props) objects around the buildings to make general city scenes look better with more variety of scenery.
[*]Added some new buildings to Boulder City (waiting for feedback - let us know what you guys think of this change).
[*]Added some more normal loot to cars in general around the entire map.
[*]Added 2 alien super zombie spawns to the N.A.T.O. Military Base.
[*]Moved the bus stop a bit more away in Boulder City.
[*]Moved some objects which were blocking the new entries of the new opened building parts.
[*]Re-worked the entire loot at the NATO Military Base, loot should spawn way better now.
[*]Re-worked the New Z in the NATO-Military-Base.
[*]Re-worked the loot in Whitestone Mountain.
[*]Fixed some terrain issues in Frosty Pines
[*]Fixed an issue related to the bridge models. One of the parts of the bridge did not have the right size.
[/list]
[b]Caliwood:[/b]
[list]
[*]Re-added the two green buildings near the beach due to community feedback.
https://image.prntscr.com/image/7962755cee3f4dfca24d673f2344f6a3.png
[*]Added some vehicles to the road because there were no vehicles.
[*]Added a second ambient sound to the school / university area.
[*]Added a whole new area to the Beach due to community feedback. The area was too open and there was nothing to take cover.
https://image.prntscr.com/image/5c409857378243cfbe4fe02af7a2100c.png
[*]Collision walls have been added to the Shopping Centre building to prevent people from glitching on top of it.
[*]Removed grass in some buildings.
[*]Removed or moved randomly placed objects on the map.
[*]Changed Skydome.
[*]Lowered the volume of the wind ambient sound.
[*]Fixed the concrete walls at the beach where players could not jump over it [*]because they were too high.
[*]Fixed some flying concrete rocks at the river.
[*]Fixed some flying containers near the Convention Center.
[*]Fixed some flying trees at Caliwood Estate.
[*]Fixed flying objects inside the houses at the beach.
[*]Fixed terrain/objects on top of the hill at Military Tents near the beach.
[/list]

---------------------------

PATCH ETA: Friday, June 23, 2018. Time: 10:00 AM (UTC+2)

---------------------------

Best Regards,

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

Dear Players,

[h1]READ MORE HERE ABOUT SURVIVAL BETA TESTING! https://goo.gl/3vQyKD[/h1]

We are finally there! Survival beta IS READY and will be enabled tomorrow morning on the patch. Together with the survival beta we will release a huge patch with a lot of updates and fixes. Before jumping into the patch notes we have a short video about the update. We highly recommend you to read the patch notes anyways since a lot of the patch is not covered in the video. Now, let's jump into the patch notes..

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IqKOGjBqG7A&l0k

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Because of some changes in backpack statistics all items that were in backpacks have been transferred to player's global inventories. (more information about this change can be found under the "Survival" section of the patch notes.)
[*]Muting a player will now also mute the invite sound for that player.
[*]We finally figured out the footstep sound issues: the third skill (green) was causing this because the skill was nerfing footsteps sounds too much. This has been fixed.
[*]The compass in the UI is smoother when in third-person.
Shields and other barricades can now be placed normally in buildings again. We have fixed the issues that were causing this.
[*]Fixed the issue that caused skinned versions of MTV's to spawn in-game. Skinned MTV's no longer spawn.
[*]Fixed some UI / Lang.pack problems where the beginner server information would still say 12 hours. Updated to 72 hours.
[*]Fixed the mouse sensitivity bar in the settings. The bar is 'less sensitive now' and changing sensitivity should be easier now.
[*]Fixed various UI bugs related to the settings menu. All settings options that had problems are fixed now.
[*]Fixed various Anti-Cheat related crashes. Anti-Cheat is now more optimized and will work better now.
[*]Fixed a server crash related to players accessing their global inventories while being in a server.
[*]Fixed a server crash that was only caused in the Lounge.
[*]Fixed a visual bug causing characters to show "darkened" in the main menu after logging out with close to no health left.
[*]Fixed a bug in Battle Royale where using a melee would deal 0 damage, this also happened after using grenades.|
[*]Fixed a client-sided crash related to the networking system of the game.
[*]Fixed a very common crash that players were having when logging in and out of servers constantly.
[*]Fixed some server kicks related to the in-game trading window.
[*]Fixed a small bug with riot shields causing them to "fly" in the air when placed.
[*]Added a new global game setting option: "Potato". This is done to spread out the quality changes to better adapt to peoples computers or desired fps.
[*]Added an extra blood indicator to show averagely what direction damage comes from. This should make it easier for players to for example fight other players that have silenced weapons since the player that's getting shot at, will now also be able to visually see where he's getting shot from.
[/list]
[h1]Reworked Hit-marker System:[/h1]
Due lot's of complaints from players we have reworked the entire system. Hit-markers, including the normal and the red ones, are now fully server sided. This means that hit-markers will only appear when the server registered the shot and the other player took actual damage. This will fix all issues and complaints related to players reporting to hit a player but the other player is not die-ing.

[h1]Icon Updates:[/h1]
So we have finally decided to rework all in-game gun icons due the following reasons: Some gun icons don't look like how the gun actually looks in-game, some skin icons don't look how the skin looks in-game, Some icons are not good quality, some icons are not made using the same camera angle and more issues. Next to that by doing this we can finally make icons look more realistic and make our game more unique in general. We are now also able to make more detailed skin icons that will always look exactly like how the skin would look in-game. It's very important for us to do this since players pay real money for these skins. For more information about the icon rework project we recommend you to read the following developer blog: https://goo.gl/Gdh3zV

[*]Fixed the M248 Elite skin store icon. Updated to the right icon.

[h1]Item Updates:[/h1]
