notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/04/21
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We're finally done and ready to release a brand new patch! This patch contains a lot of promised features that we made in past developer blogs and we are very excited to finally release everything. Let's jump straight into the patch notes: 

(More information about when the patch is going to roll out can be found at the end of this announcement)

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed missing physics of general objects in the entire game.
[*]Fixed the restuarant models where players could get stuck in the windows.
[*]Fixed some loading screens that were displaying incorrect links (urls) / text.
[*]Fixed texture bugs related to the antenna model (used on top of the control tower at the airport in Colorado v2).
[*]Fixed an issue related to the windows of the restaurant buildings where players could get stuck sometimes.
[*]Fixed a crash that would kick you if you died in warmup just as you reloaded. (At the same time)
[*]Fixed a bug where clan tags broke the minimap in-game. (Clan tags wouldn't show on the minimap)
[*]Fixed an anticheat kick when sending screenshots. Players shouldn't be affected by this much anymore.
[*]Fixed many server kicks, specially for lag issues. Improved server stability.
[*]Fixed a server crash on the Lounge. (Related to players accessing their global inventory)
[*]Fixed a Battle Royale Server Crash. (A bug where players could somehow disconnect from the same session twice)
[*]Fixed a Private Server Crash. (Was related to private servers spawning too much loot) (Increased / Improved this)
[*]Added a new loading screen and fixed some older ones. Deleted loading screens that are unused.
[*]The Brotherhood has been removed from the daily reward system. (Based on feedback from the community)
[*]Any action that makes you lose spawnprotection will make you lose zombie repellent.
[*]Removed the randomised join for Solo Servers. Players are now able to pick the server they want instead of joining a random one. We hope more players will start playing Solo Servers. 
[*]Stamina will no longer freeze when driving a car.
[*]When opening a Skinbox/Crate you will no longer lose the item is your backpack if full/too much weight. It will instead drop to the ground.
[*]NewZ will now force using the best GPU, if available in laptops with dual graphic cards.
[*]Globally tweaked the main menu style. Added some new text, some buttons are more clear.
[*]Updated the in-game main menu background.
[*]Implemented a ranked system, reworked the main menu and improved the Battle Royale game mode overall with a lot of changes. Read further patch notes for more info.
[*]Players can now get an epic skinbox from opening a tactical weapon crate. The skinbox is rare though.
[/list]

[h1]Item Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed / Updated the name and description of the Riot Shield FistyCuffs29.
[*]Fixed the damage of some skinned katana's that would have the wrong damage amounts.
[*]Updated the description of the Famas. (Also for skinned versions of the gun)
[*]Updated the item name of the 'Tactical Knife' to 'M9 Bayonet'. Also all skinned item names / recipes / descriptions are fixed and updated.
[*]Updated the icon of the ASVAL. Adjusted the icon and changed some colors.
[*]Updated the texture of the Riot Shield Mysta.
[*]Added a new media Riot Shield: Riot Shield Official_Alec12.
[*]Increased the speed of the Golf Club. Lowered the damage so it's the same as a baseball bat. (Melee)
[*]Increased the damage of the M9 Baynote. (Melee)
[*]Increased the damage of the Hatchet. (Melee)
[*]Increased the damage of the Jokoto Katana. (Melee)
[*]Increased the damage of the Wakizashi. (Melee)
[*]Increased the damage of the Machete. (Melee)
[*]Increased the damage of the Pickaxe but decreased the speed. (Melee)
[*]Decreased the damage of the Shovel. (Melee)
[*]Decreased the damage of the Garden Shears. (Melee)
[*]Decreased the damage of the Metal Bat with a tiny bit. (Melee)
[*]Decreased the fire rate of the M4 Semi. (Assault Rifle)
[*]Decreased the spread of the AKS-74U. (Assault Rifle)
[*]Decreased the recoil of the AKS-74U. (Assault Rifle)
[*]Decreased the damage of the B93R. This pistol has been way too overpowered compared to other pistols & guns. (Pistol)
[*]The AK47 can no longer use attachments due a bug / glitch. The AK47 will be able to use attachments again when we've found a way to fix the issues.
[*]Skinned lockers (Personal Neon Dragon / Red Dragon / E-Unit / Hynx Lockbox) now are Global Inventory Acces lockers meaning player's global inventory can be accesed through these lockers.
[/list]

[h1]The Main Menu Rework:[/h1]
As you might have read a while ago in a developer blog about upcoming changes for the game is that we've reworked the way the main menu of the game works. This doesn't mean that the menu is different, but from now on it will just work in a more logical way.
You might now be like "what the hell are you talking about?" and therefor we recommend you to read the developer blog about it first before going into the patch notes. You can read the blog here: http://playnewz.com/getpost.php?id=60469
The most simple and easiest way to explain the changes to the menu is that basically the game is now split in 4 different parts. Every game mode has it's own menu, own characters, own buttons, own layout etc. With this change there will be no more confusion and mixing up of different game modes.
For example: before, it was hard for new players to understand how the Battle Royale game mode worked combined with the characters. Also because no statistics saved but also because the same character from open world needed to be used to play Battle Royale.
With this change everything is more clear and logical, easier for new players to understand but also creates a solid fundament for our new 2 upcoming game modes. To make everything even more clear here is a list of the exact changes we have done: 
[list]
[*]There's now 4 tabs added at the top of the screen in the main menu. The tabs are as following: "Open World - Battle Royale - Survival (Legacy) - Competitive". 2 of the tabs are still disabled since those game modes aren't released yet.
[*]The open world tab remains the same. Everything in this tab will still work the same way.
[*]The Battle Royale tab is now adapted for that game mode. It doesn't have a global inventory button since global inventory is not used in the Battle Royale game mode. 
[*]The Battle Royale game mode now has it's own unique character. 
[*]Marketplace and Community->Clans are only for Open World. These menu features don't work for the other game modes.
[/list]

[h1]The Ranking System:[/h1]
Yes! It's finished (as promised). For players wondering about this, we've published a developer blog about this a week ago. You can read it here: http://playnewz.com/getpost.php?id=60469
Ranked has been something "Coming Soon" for a long time in the game and we felt very forced and needed to finally finish this! Also this is a perfect example of the mindset we like to follow listed earlier: "this creates much more reason to play". 
Ranked will work independently for every game mode. This means that for every game mode players will be able to have different ranks. There is however some similarities for example:
[list]
[*]There will be 6 tiers that each have 3 divisions (levels) so in total there are 18 ranks different ranks a player can be in.
[*]Progress between the ranks is the same for every game mode.
[*]There will not be 'promotions' to rank up (like League of Legends for example) so ranking up will always be instant.
[*]For more details and pictures about the ranks etc. we recommend you to read the following post: http://playnewz.com/getpost.php?id=60469
[/list]
As already explained earlier is that ranked will work for every game mode (Survival, Open World, Battle Royale & Competitive) independently. For now (as the other 2 game modes are not released yet) ranked will only be available for Open World and Battle Royale. Open World ranked will work as following:

[h1]Ranked in Open World:[/h1]
Ranked in open world is relatively simple. This ranking system is not session based so that means that your rank can change all the time. (dynamically) Your rank will be set based on your ELO. ELO is an amount in our database that defines every player's skill. We can not release exactly where this is set on and what values are used but based on a lot of testing we can conclude that the ELO system is really accurate. (We don't want people to boost or whatsoever so that's why) Things ELO is based on for example are: kills, death, headshot ratio, etc.. (A lot more)
ELO defines a players skill and based on ELO the player's rank will be set. This means that ranked is very dynamically meaning playing bad for a couple of hours is going to lower a player's ELO and then lower his rank. Playing good works the same way. You don't have to be playing 1000's of hours to have a high ELO, you just need to be good. 
We are very happy to be able to make this skill based since that's very important. We rather focus on the actual skill of a player than amounts (of players killed or something) because that doesn't really say everything as we all know.
Right now ranks just display in the menu. We are planning to do way more with it in the future. Right now we just have the 'basis'. Expect MORE to come!

[h1]Ranked in Battle Royale: [/h1]
Ranked in Battle Royale will work in an entire different way. Again also this ranking system will be very skill based meaning you have to play good to rank up but you don't always have to be the best.
We have started to log every Battle Royale game played and from now on player's positions save. (As you can also see in the video: Players can even see in the menu what their last placements were of their latest played Battle Royales) All these games a player play will be summed up and a number between 1-100 will be chosen (averagely). Players will have an average position of where they finish in Battle Royale games and that will be linked to a rank. 
Your rank will only start counting after you played a set amount of Battle Royale games so you won't have a rank instantly after playing 1 Battle Royale game only. If you manage to play around 20 Battle Royale games and finish first place on every single one of them your rank will obviously be the highest: Elite 1. (Because your average position will be #1)

[h1]Item Simplification:[/h1]
Based on feedback from our community about a "too much variaty of different items" leading to a confusion sometimes we've came up with a process we will follow in the upcoming patches. We also feel very limited when deciding to add new content since we don't want to "flood" the game.
With the process of simplification we want to rework certain items / ammo and try to group them up in a way they make more sense. The upcoming patches we will do some changes to certain items. Here's what we've done for this update:
[list]
[*]Medium Armor Desert & Forest are now skins. They will be available through the premium skinbox & findable in-game. All current Medium Armor Desert & Forest have been 'unskinned' to normal Medium Armors.
[*]Light Gear Forest & Urban are now skins. A new Light Gear basic armor is added. 
[/list]
We will continue with this process in the next upcoming patches. Any feedback is welcome!

[h1]Skin Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed / Updated the Desert Eagle Gold skin icon.
[*]Fixed / Updated the Light Saber Purple. The skin looks more purple now.
[*]Fixed / Updated the texture of the M4 Revall.
[*]M107 Red Death has been added to the premium skinbox.
[*]M4 Dragon King has been added to the premium skinbox.
[*]Added some new skins for testing purposes. We're considering releasing the new "Red Strike" skins soon, stay tuned for that!
[/list]

[h1]Loot Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Random appearing airdrops now drop overall better items and have a chance of dropping GC skinboxes now. (Epic Skinbox / Destruction Skinbox / Skully Pink Skinbox)
[*]Police / General loot tables have been updated. Missing items have been added. (This loot category is used almost everywhere on the map)
[*]QBZ (Assault Rifle) spawn rates have been increased. The gun is way more common now.
[*]Airdrop Callers now have a chance of dropping ANY karambit. Before they would only drop certain ones, now airdrops can drop all kinds of karambits!
[*]Air horns have been removed from the airdrop caller loot. The airdrops don't longer drop air horns.
[*]Bandage DX and Stanag C-Mags have been removed from the super zombie loot tables.
[*]The bullet compensator (attachment) is now confirmed to be spawning.
[/list]

[h1]Marketplace Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Decreased prices of clan slots (upgrades) with 90%. Clan slots shouldn't be expensive and from now on they won't be.
[/list]
We highly recommend players that want to keep updated with the latest marketplace and loot updates to follow us on twitter: https://twitter.com/infestationnewz
Any live updates and changes are announced through here.

[h1]Battle Royale Updates:[/h1]
Based on the developer blog we've published about a week ago we have now done the following changes to Battle Royale: (Original post can be read here: http://playnewz.com/getpost.php?id=60469)
We highly recommend you to read the "Main Menu Rework" notes first before going through these updates since they are related. 
[list]
[*]Battle Royale now has it's own unique character + menu. Battle Royale is not more an game mode on itself and more stats will count. (We are planning on adding unique Battle Royale leaderboards later)
[*]Battle Royale now has a ranking system implemented. Players are now able to play Battle Royale's on a more competitive level. 
[*]Battle Royale games are now logged. Players are able to see their last played Battle Royale's in the main menu including the place they finished that Battle Royale in.
[*]Added Extra Screen FX to being in a radiation Area for Battle Royale. The longer a player is in the radiation the more blurry the screen gets.
[*]Battle Royale Radiation damage increased as the safe zone gets smaller. (Against players that camp outside of the safe zone area for a ridiculous long time)
[*]The skill tree in Battle Royale is currently disabled. Every player automatically has a full skill tree (from open world) for now except for the 'epic' skills. We are planning on making a separate skill tree for Battle Royale but for now all players will have the full old open world skill tree.
[*]Removed Grouping in Battle Royale. Grouping will be added back when matchmaking is implemented, this way if you group you will play vs other groups, only. This is also done to give solo players a more fair chance of winning and make the overall Battle Royale games more interesting.
[/list]
We mentioned earlier that a new Battle Royale map is coming soon. The map is unfortunately at this moment not finished yet. We are very close to finishing it though. Wondering what the new map is going to be / look like? Check out this developer blog: http://playnewz.com/getpost.php?id=60513

[h1]Colorado V2 Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some flying objects at Camp Splinter.
[*]Fixed some collision walls in Norad. By improving collision walls this should also give better FPS / Performance generally.
[*]Fixed a texture problem in Boulder City.
[*]Fixed some misplaced objects in Death Valley.
[*]Fixed some objects at the small military place infront of Clearview. Some objects were flying and some were too far in the ground. This is now fixed.
[*]Fixed some loot spots in Death Valley. Some loot would spawn inside the ground or fly around. This is now fixed.
[*]Increased the loot in ParkerVille. Improved loot, optimised de-spawn timers and increased general loot.
[*]Added 2 more jumpup's to the firestation in Death Valley so that players can acces the area easier without having to walk all the way around all the time. This is also done to improve potential PVP experience.
[*]Removed some duplicated objects around Camp Splinter and Boulder City. 
[*]Removed 3-Story-Buildings from Clearview and placed there a church with some small changes around. (Based on community feedback) We will see how players react to this change and work from there on further changes and improvements.
[*]Removed some FPS / Performance - intensive objects from the map to improve FPS / Performance.
[/list]

[h1]Colorado V1 Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some flying objects at the Airport and West Boulder.
[*]Fixed / updated some player spawns at the Airport where players would spawn in the middle of zombies. This no longer happens.
[*]Improved the loot at Crystal Lake Resort. Added generally more loot and improved / fixed loot de-spawn timers.
[/list]

[h1]Caliwood Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked the entire loot system and increased the loot to 600-700%.
[*]Fixed the a major issue related green-yellow appartement building where if a player would look at the building get major FPS drops. This is now fixed.
[*]Fixed some buildings where players could too easily glitch inside in. This is not longer possible. If you see players abusing this, please report them immediately.
[/list]

[h1]Event Map Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Highered the sandbags models everywhere so that players can no longer jump on top of them. This was getting abused by players a lot.
[*]Added more collision walls at the warehouse so that players can't acces the roof anymore.
[*]Added some collision walls at the entries of team a&b area, player were able to jump out of the area before.
[*]Updated the double sandbag models to triple sandbag models.
[/list]

[h1]SpringValley Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Disabled some functions to increase the FPS. (Improved lighting / fog etc.)
[*]Fixed some problems related to the terrain.
[*]Added a second jumpup at the 3 & 4 story building.
[*]Removed a decent amount of objects due community reports. By doing this we've increased FPS and performance of the map with a lot. 
[*]Changed / Updated some global settings to improve the FPS / Performance overall.
[/list]

[h1]ClearSmall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Replaced certain buildings that accidentally got removed last patch. (Clearview)
[/list]

[h1]Rocky Ford Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed the 2 red houses (community feedback).
[*]Added some new closed / open buildings.
[*]Updated minimap.
[/list]

[h1]Smallville Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a car where players could no-clip through due missing physics. This is now fixed.
[/list]

Servers are shutting down as we speak. Maximum downtime will be around 30 minutes max. Please keep an eye out on our Twitter where we'll do live updates.

Best Regards & Enjoy the Patch!

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/03/16
notes.content:
Dear Players,

It's been a long time since we last performed a game update. We're very happy and excited to finally be able to show you all the new changes and work we've done in the past 2 weeks. We've received a lot of feedback from our community, streamers, moderators about things and we've tried to come up with the best changes and additions possible. We hope you like this patch!

ESTIMATED PATCH TIME: Thursday, March 16, 2017. 11:00 AM (UTC+2)
We estimate to be patching around this time. This all depends on how testing goes. We will keep you all updated through our Twitter if time / date changes but we're very certain to patch at this time.

Our Twitter: https://twitter.com/infestationnewz

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Day time has been increased and night time has been decreased in all maps that had a day / night cycle.
[*]Fixed a problem that where some buildings had windows from outside but on the inside those were not visible. This could be abused.
[*]Fixed a bug where buying discounted items would sometimes not allow you to buy them if you have less GC than the original price.
[*]Fixed a bug where the VOIP icon would stay "activated" if a player logged out while talking.
[*]Fixed the favorite icon for servers. This button would bug sometimes. Players can now add servers to their favorite list without any problems.
[*]Fixed a crash related to sounds / sound drivers.
[*]Fixed a bug that causes rank skins not to work when the player is not in a clan. (Rank skins are skins only availbe for a certain leaderboard rank for example: rank 1)
[*]Fixed a bug where the shields would "shield themselves" from grenade damage. This issue has been corrected. This makes grenades a effective way to destroy many shields that are close together.
[*]Rank skins now also work for the "Seasonal Leaderboards". Players that are rank 1 in the seasonal leaderboards are now able to use the rank 1 skins too. (For more information about "Seasonal Leaderboards" please read further patch notes)
[*]Crossbows are no longer being able to be brought / used in sniper only servers.
[*]Added easter content in preparation for easter. On easter we have some amazing events planned. Stay tuned for this!
[*]Added a new server feature that kicks players if they're AFK for too long in a server. (Also to prevent people from time-farming)
[*]Removed unused files from public game build to decrease the size of the game smaller.
[*]"Item Being Saved" is now entirely removed. This feature gave too many problems and wasn't working how it was suppose to be.
[*]When interacting with a locker or the global inventory ingame, things such as hiding the chat or showing your weapon will no longer get triggered when searching. 
[*]"Rejoin Last" Button will now work even after restarting the game, except for solo servers. (For more information about solo servers please read the "Solo Servers" part of these patch notes)
[*]Reworked Spawn Protection. Spawn protection starts counting when your game "renders", aka when you can move/walk/shoot/whatever. From now on, faster pcs won't get more spawnprotection, this way its fair for everybody.
[*]Hiding the chat will now save when logging out of a server. This means when you hide chat -> log out -> join a new server the chat will still be hidden.
[*]Highly Optimized Player AI Code.
[*]Improved the Server Shot Registring AI: Shooting through shields and to players through corners should work much better now.
[*]Sandbags, Woodshields, and Barbwire barricades now affect the global Barricade cooldown.
[/list]

[h1]UI Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a searh button to the marketplace. Players can now search for the item they want inside the actual marketplace just like how they can search in their inventory.
[*]Added "Streamer Mode" option to the options menu. Players can now enable / disable "Streamer Mode" without having to close the game.
[*]Added more information such as the region to "Recent" and "Favorites" tab of the server selection screen.
[*]Added a visual indicator to display barricade's health while aiming on it. 
[*]Fixed a bug related to the lockerUI not being able to show messsages.
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause FPS not to update when entering a vehicle.
[*]Improved the UI of the character inventory screen. Some buttons are updated / better aligned and quality is improved.
[/list]

[h1]Server Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented PVP Servers Map Rotation. Please read more at the "PVP Servers Map Rotation" part of these patch notes.
[*]Added Caliwood servers to the open world -> beginner servers part of the game. Beginning players are now able to get used to Caliwood aswell.
[*]Decreased amount of game servers to keep total server population more pact. This also had to be done because of the new South American servers coming.
[*]For official servers both NA and EU Colorado V2 servers have been decreased. Also Colorado V2 AR ONLY server amount has been decreased.
[*]For beginner servers both NA and EU Colorado V2 servers have been decreased. Caliwood servers have been added.
[/list]
For all the players wondering about the South American servers. At this moment our servers still haven't arrived yet. They're almost certain to arrive before this patch so the servers will most likely be enabled after this upcoming patch but at this point we are not 100% sure yet. If the servers arrive after this upcoming patch we will do a small announcement as soon as we enable them. We're doing everything we can to get them up ASAP.

[h1]Item Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the store icon of the ASVAL. Changed some colors on the icon to make it look more like how the weapon looks in game.
[*]Updated the crate textures of the Ballistic Shields. The crate now has the same color as the actual barricade.
[*]Lowered the damage of the VERESK (sub machine gun). This is based on the balance with the other sub machine guns.
[*]Lowered the damage of the FAMAS (assault rifle). Now that the gun takes stanag ammo it's generally more overpowered.
[*]Medium Armor Desert & Medium Armor Forest now have the same statistics as the normal Medium Armor.
[*]Fixed the Ballistic Shield 3D model problems. The shield is now ready to be released.
[*]Fixed the ASVAL-60 ammo item description. Updated it so now it says the right amount of ammo instead of a copy of the ASVAL-30 ammo.
[*]Fixed the sprint animation of the QBZ-95. It was using the wrong sprinting animations before.
[*]Fixed the QBZ-95 bugs where the iron sight / ammo in the gun did not show. The weapon is now ready to be released.
[*]Fixed the Military Ruck item description (+Skinned versions). It had the wrong amount of slots in the description.
[*]Fixed / Updated the texture of the personal locker. The "code lock" part on the locker should now be visible again.
[*]Added a new Riot Shield: Riot Shield Crunzaty. This Riot Shield is especially made for our moderator Crunzaty.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield FistyCuffs29. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer FistyCuffs29.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield ZombieEyedGnome. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer ZombieEyedGnome.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield TheSurvivalGuysTV. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer TheSurvivalGuysTV.
[*]Added a new Media Riot Shield: Riot Shield Cristyle91. This Riot Shield is especially made for the youtuber Cristyle91.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield Cricridusud. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer Cricridusud.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield jiznukem. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer jiznukem.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Faroe Islands.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Puerto Rico.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Georgia.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Indonesia.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Estonia.
[*]Added a new item: (This is also directly a new type of item) The Tactical Weapon Crate. The Tactical Weapon Crate is a new type of crate in Infestation: The New Z. 
This is the first crate that's released of it's kind. This crate can be opened in-game just like opening a skinbox. After opening the crate it will dissapear and give the player a weapon / item in return.
[*]Renamed "12 Gauge Ammo" to "Shotgun Shell 8x". See further notes for more details why.
[*]Updated the description of the Double Barrel shotgun. (Added that the double barrel shotgun can only use Shotgun Shell 2x ammo because it has 2 barrels and no clip.)
[*]Mossbergs and KT Deciders (shotguns) are now also able to use "Shotgun Shell 2x" next to "Shotgun Shell 8x". The Double Barrel is still only capable of using "Shotgun Shell 2x".
[*]When reloading a Mossberg or KT Decider there's now also a new animation that only loads 2 shotgun shells instead of 8. (Dynamic based on what ammo you load)
[*]The VSS Compact is no longer silenced. We are still looking into solutions to give this gun 'a better place in the scene'. We don't want to make the gun too OP but definatly worth to use.
[*]The VSS Compact no longer has a silencer attached to the front barrel of the gun since it's no longer silenced.
[*]Skinned personal lockers are now personal lockers instead of lockers that use a code. The skinned lockers will be available in the marketplace after this patch.
[/list]

[h1]Item Simplification:[/h1]
Based on feedback from our community about a "too much variaty of different items" leading to a confusion sometimes we've came up with a process we will follow in the upcoming patches. We also feel very limited when deciding to add new content since we don't want to "flood" the game.
With the process of simplification we want to rework certain items / ammo and try to group them up in a way they make more sense. While reading this we think that this can be quite complicated to understand so we recommend you to read the first notes as a start to get an idea of what exactly we mean:
[list]
[*](Already listed above but worth to mention again:) "12 Gauge ammo" is now renamed to "Shotgun Shell 8x". Shotgun Shell 2x can now also be used in a MOSSBERG or KT Decider. This to make the whole understanding of what ammo goes in what gun easier.
[*]Added a new type of armor: The MTV (This is a basic version of the MTV armors)
[*]All old MTV armors have been changed to MTV Basic. The old 'skinned' versions will be released later as actual skins.
[/list]
We ask our community to come up with ideas how we can proceed with this process. If theres any guns that should use different ammo or ammo we should remove / change we ask you to suggest it to us! In the end we just want to make the game easier to understand / play but also leave space to add new guns and items without a limit.

[h1]Marketplace Updates:[/h1]
We've received a lot of feedback from our community regarding skins. Some people were complaining there are too many skins in the game, some people were complaining there hasn't been any new skins since forever, and some said prices are too high etc.
We've discussed this and came up with a solution, a new system, that will be fit for everyone. Summed up there's basicly too many skins available to players. Some skins are too old, some new, it can be very confusing this way.
Based on this feedback we've came up with the following solution / system:
[list]
[*]There will from now on only be a limited amount of skin recipes available instead of everything being always available. We will rotate the skins daily meaning new / different skins will be available every day including discounts.
[*]Some skinboxes will be removed forever from the marketplace. (They might come back on certain events sometimes)
[*]Skinboxes will rotate in the marketplace instead of everything being available at once. We plan on making different boxes available for different/certain periods.
[*]This will leave us with more space to actually release new skinboxes instead of "flooding" the marketplace with skins.
[*]Skinboxes will increase in their value. Some skinboxes will become legacy.
[*]This will also leave space for us to release boxes that can be cheap or have prices more based on the actual quality of the skins.
[/list]

[h1]Skin Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Mauser SRG Blue skin. This skin will be released soon in an upcoming skinbox.
[*]Fixed the Mauser SRG Pink skin. This skin will be released soon in an upcoming skinbox. Scopes now also work on this weapon.
[*]Fixed the Custom Guerilla Red Strike skin textures. We are not sure yet how / when this skin will be released.
[*]Fixed the Light Sword Rainbow. Expect this skin to be released soon.
[*]Fixed the Blaser Neon Dragon glow. The skin wasn't glowing properly before.
[*]Fixed some texture issues of the "GOSU" clan skins. 
[*]Updated the textures of the "M107 Gold". The skin looks more gold now.
[*]Updated the textures of the "M107 Black".
[*]Updated the textures of the "Minicabra's". Also updated the icon.
[*]Added "Event Skins". We are not sure how these will be used but the actual skins are already added. These skins are simple red / blue colored skins for armors helmets and can be used to make teams in events.
[/list]

[h1]Solo Servers:[/h1]
As many of you already know is that "Solo Servers" are finally here! (If you have no idea what "Solo Servers" are please read this dev-blog: http://playnewz.com/getpost.php?id=60003)
"Solo Servers" have been a big demand of our entire community but also from a lot of streamers streaming our game. Until a week ago we didn't really had an idea how Solo Servers would work but we came up with a strong idea:
"Solo Servers" is an idea originally from a group of streamers where players can ONLY play solo. This aims to avoid bigger groups while playing the game and fighting against individual persons only. Here's some features summed up:
[list]
[*]There will be a new button added under the 'Open World' part of the game. This button will be called "Solo Servers".
[*]When clicking the "Solo Servers" button the player will NOT go to the server selection screen but will immediately join a random chosen server.
[*]No grouping + no group tags. Players playing in these type of servers will not have the ability to invite anyone to group.
[*]No clan tags / no clans. This is all disabled.
[*]Original Colorado V2 Servers only. You do not 'lose your spawn' when playing on official Colorado v2 servers and switch to Solo Servers.
[*]When joining a solo server it will not show anywhere what server you're on. (Basically players don't know what server they're on themselves)
[*]When dying / logging out of a solo server, it will not show up at the 'Recent Servers' tab what server you were on.
[*]Players will have the ability to join back into their server after dying by clicking the 'Rejoin Last' button. This way players still have the ability to join back the server after dying to pick up their loot.
[/list]
If you have further questions about this new open world game-mode we recommend to write all your questions in a comment on these notes or just try the new "Solo Servers" out yourself!

[h1]Seasonal Leaderboards:[/h1]
YES! Seasonal Leaderboards are finished! Many have asked for this and we thought it was time to bring the leaderboards and competitve level of the game to a next level. With this said we think these seasonal leaderboards will bring a lot of fun.
Seasonal Leaderboards will work as the following:
[list]
[*]Periods / time of a season + season name will be decided by us manually. We will create our own seasons and based on that combine them with events and prices.
[*]Seasons can take up to a month time or can be only for a few days. It's just what ever we decide depending on the event.
[*]Statistics in Seasonal Leaderboards only count statistics from Official Servers and Solo Servers.
[*]When no season is active the seasonal leaderboards tab in the menu will say "No seasons active".
[/list]
From here we will start working on special events related to seasons with cool rewards, maybe even seasons that are only for 1 day. We're planning on even adding rankings in future. We'll see what comes based on this!

[h1]New Reputation Ranks:[/h1]
Based on feedback from the community and our moderators we've decided to add new ranks to both the postive and the negative side of reputation. On the postive side we added:
[list]
[*]+300000 rep - "Genius"
[*]+400000 rep - "Devin"
[*]+500000 rep - "Sheriff"
[/list]
On the negative side we added:
[list]
[*]-1250000 rep - "Warrior"
[*]-1500000 rep - "Evil"
[*]-2000000 rep - "Cannibal"
[/list]

[h1]PVP Servers Map Rotation:[/h1]
Based on the feedback received from the community the past week we've decided to implement the PVP Servers Map Rotation. (Link to poll: http://forum.playnewz.com/index.php?/topic/60129-map-rotation-system/)
Everything about the rotation is explained in the post linked but just to make everything as clear as possible we'll gladly explain how the rotation will work again.
The basic idea behind the rotation is to have only 2 different maps at a time. One would be small and another one would be a big one.
We would also have 3 different types for each map, as we currently have for some. The slots in the server will depend on which map it is.
[list]
[*]Rotations will be ONLY done in the "PVP Servers" part of the open world part of the game.
[*]Rotations will be done every patch, for now, until we create a way to change the rotation live.
[*]There will always be 2 maps only active and every map 1 or more type. (Type is: AR ONLY, SNIPER ONLY & HYBRID) So in the end there will always be 6 servers or more.
[/list]
Rotating the PVP maps of the game gives players more excitement about "what map is coming next time", a more variated PVP environment, less confusion about "too many different maps in the game" but it also gives us the ability to add new PVP maps without overflooding the amount of PVP servers.
We hope to follow a certain pattern with a schedule where and when we switch maps in the future. For now it will work in the way explained.
We would like to make clear (also based on what we explained with the "Seasonal Leaderboards") that statistics still count for PVP servers but only for the ALL TIME statistics so not for the Seasonal Leaderboards.

[h1]Colorado V1 Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed flying objects at West Boulder Meteological Station. 
[*]Fixed misplaced objects at West Boulder Meteological Station. 
[*]Fixed some terrain issues at West Boulder Meteological Station. 
[*]Fixed physics of some rocks around Campos City where players could glitch inside them.
[*]Fixed some buildings in Campos City where players could get stuck in the windows.
[*]Fixed some buildings in Boulder City where players could get stuck in the windows.
{*}Fixed some misplaced objects in Boulder City.
[/list]

[h1]Colorado V2 Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more item spawns in places where there was no loot spawning in Death Valley.
[*]Players can no longer acces the roof of the Beach House in Clearview. Added collision walls on top of the house to prevent players from glitching up.
[*]Increased FPS / performance for players playing on low settings.
[*]Removed the old secret spot.
[*]Added a new secret spot.
[*]Fixed a problem in Boulder City where some buildings had windows where players could only look / shoot through from one side.
[*]Fixed fences in Boulder City where players were only shoot through from one side.
[/list]

[h1]Caliwood Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem in Caliwood where some buildings had windows where players could only look / shoot through from one side.
[*]Fixed some issues related to zombie spawns. Some spawns had wrong setting causing zombies to respawn too fast / too much.
[*]Fixed some player spawns where players would spawn outside of the map. Spawns are moved / improved.
[*]Fixed physics of some rocks at the beach areas where players could glitch inside them.
[*]Decreased the total amount of zombie spawns. At some places there was just too many and it was affecting the PVP in certain area's.
[*]Players can no longer acces certain parts of the roof of the convention centre in the center of the map. 
[*]Players can no longer acces balconies of "green-yellow" appartment buildings. Collision walls are updated.
[*]Added a new secret spot.
[*]Added a military tent on top of the convention center to give players better protection / cover while PVP-ing.
[*]Added a parking lot in front of the convention center to give players better protection / cover while PVP-ing.
[*]Removed the "Infestation" poster from the convention center building due collision / physics problems.
[*]Alien super zombies are now also spawning in Caliwood. We will not tell you where they spawn yet. Good luck finding them!
[/list]

[h1]Event Map Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked all 4 of the "Deathmatch" area's. Some are entirely reworked while some are just improved. This is all done based on feedback from the community.
[*]Added vault (Global Inventory Acces) NPC's and store NPC's to the lobby of the map so players don't have to log out to grab other items out of their global inventory.
[*]Added signs indicating the names of the fighting area's and teams to improve usablity of the map. Players participating in events now know better where to go.
{*}The lobby and "walk" area's are now safezone to improve general flow of the events done on this map.
[*]Fixed physics of the 'wooden walls' objects that are used on 2 area's of the map. Players can no longer walk / shoot through.
[*]Fixed flying objects throughout the entire map + removed misplaced objects.
[*]Optimized freeze time on the map. Time is now frozen at 11:00 AM for a better general look of the map.
[*]Optimized shadows / terrain / lighting on the entire map. Improved performance and FPS. Also decreased loading time needed to load the map.
[*]Updated terrain texture to a better looking one.
[*]Updated minimap.
[/list]

[h1]Rocky Ford Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more collision walls on top of the post office to prevent players from glitching on top of the roof.
[*]Added more details in and around the church.
[*]Added two new houses in front of the church to improve / fill up the area a bit more.
[*]Added sand bags in front of the church to give players more cover.
[*]Updated minimap.
[/list]

[h1]West Oaks Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more collision walls on top of the motel buildings to prevent players from glitching on top of the roof.
[/list]

[h1]Spring Valley Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some terrain issues.
[*]Added, moved and improved player spawns. (Some spawns were too much in the open / bad location)
[*]Optimized map / changed some settings to increase FPS and performance.
[/list]

[h1]Battle Royale Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased the spawn rates of medical items.
[*]Removed krugers / kruger ammo from the loot spawns. These items will no longer be in Battle Royale.
[*]Removed the Bizon / Honey Badger from the loot spawns. Also these items will no longer be in Battle Royale.
[*]Moved / fixed some spawns where players would spawn in the middle of a group of zombies.
[/list]
We are planning on reworking the loot in the current Battle Royale map as soon as the new Battle Royale map is released. We have removed certain items from spawning to make the flow and gameplay of a Battle Royale easier and faster.
Loot will be reworked / optimized on the new upcoming Battle Royale map.

Estimated time of patch is listed at the top of this announcement.

Best Regards,

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

We estimate to be patching around this time. This all depends on how testing goes. We will keep you all updated through our Twitter if time / date changes but we're very certain to patch at this time.

Our Twitter: https://twitter.com/infestationnewz

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Day time has been increased and night time has been decreased in all maps that had a day / night cycle.
[*]Fixed a problem that where some buildings had windows from outside but on the inside those were not visible. This could be abused.
[*]Fixed a bug where buying discounted items would sometimes not allow you to buy them if you have less GC than the original price.
[*]Fixed a bug where the VOIP icon would stay "activated" if a player logged out while talking.
[*]Fixed the favorite icon for servers. This button would bug sometimes. Players can now add servers to their favorite list without any problems.
[*]Fixed a crash related to sounds / sound drivers.
[*]Fixed a bug that causes rank skins not to work when the player is not in a clan. (Rank skins are skins only availbe for a certain leaderboard rank for example: rank 1)
[*]Fixed a bug where the shields would "shield themselves" from grenade damage. This issue has been corrected. This makes grenades a effective way to destroy many shields that are close together.
[*]Rank skins now also work for the "Seasonal Leaderboards". Players that are rank 1 in the seasonal leaderboards are now able to use the rank 1 skins too. (For more information about "Seasonal Leaderboards" please read further patch notes)
[*]Crossbows are no longer being able to be brought / used in sniper only servers.
[*]Added easter content in preparation for easter. On easter we have some amazing events planned. Stay tuned for this!
[*]Added a new server feature that kicks players if they're AFK for too long in a server. (Also to prevent people from time-farming)
[*]Removed unused files from public game build to decrease the size of the game smaller.
[*]"Item Being Saved" is now entirely removed. This feature gave too many problems and wasn't working how it was suppose to be.
[*]When interacting with a locker or the global inventory ingame, things such as hiding the chat or showing your weapon will no longer get triggered when searching. 
[*]"Rejoin Last" Button will now work even after restarting the game, except for solo servers. (For more information about solo servers please read the "Solo Servers" part of these patch notes)
[*]Reworked Spawn Protection. Spawn protection starts counting when your game "renders", aka when you can move/walk/shoot/whatever. From now on, faster pcs won't get more spawnprotection, this way its fair for everybody.
[*]Hiding the chat will now save when logging out of a server. This means when you hide chat -> log out -> join a new server the chat will still be hidden.
[*]Highly Optimized Player AI Code.
[*]Improved the Server Shot Registring AI: Shooting through shields and to players through corners should work much better now.
[*]Sandbags, Woodshields, and Barbwire barricades now affect the global Barricade cooldown.
[/list]

[h1]UI Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a searh button to the marketplace. Players can now search for the item they want inside the actual marketplace just like how they can search in their inventory.
[*]Added "Streamer Mode" option to the options menu. Players can now enable / disable "Streamer Mode" without having to close the game.
[*]Added more information such as the region to "Recent" and "Favorites" tab of the server selection screen.
[*]Added a visual indicator to display barricade's health while aiming on it. 
[*]Fixed a bug related to the lockerUI not being able to show messsages.
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause FPS not to update when entering a vehicle.
[*]Improved the UI of the character inventory screen. Some buttons are updated / better aligned and quality is improved.
[/list]

[h1]Server Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented PVP Servers Map Rotation. Please read more at the "PVP Servers Map Rotation" part of these patch notes.
[*]Added Caliwood servers to the open world -> beginner servers part of the game. Beginning players are now able to get used to Caliwood aswell.
[*]Decreased amount of game servers to keep total server population more pact. This also had to be done because of the new South American servers coming.
[*]For official servers both NA and EU Colorado V2 servers have been decreased. Also Colorado V2 AR ONLY server amount has been decreased.
[*]For beginner servers both NA and EU Colorado V2 servers have been decreased. Caliwood servers have been added.
[/list]
For all the players wondering about the South American servers. At this moment our servers still haven't arrived yet. They're almost certain to arrive before this patch so the servers will most likely be enabled after this upcoming patch but at this point we are not 100% sure yet. If the servers arrive after this upcoming patch we will do a small announcement as soon as we enable them. We're doing everything we can to get them up ASAP.

[h1]Item Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the store icon of the ASVAL. Changed some colors on the icon to make it look more like how the weapon looks in game.
[*]Updated the crate textures of the Ballistic Shields. The crate now has the same color as the actual barricade.
[*]Lowered the damage of the VERESK (sub machine gun). This is based on the balance with the other sub machine guns.
[*]Lowered the damage of the FAMAS (assault rifle). Now that the gun takes stanag ammo it's generally more overpowered.
[*]Medium Armor Desert & Medium Armor Forest now have the same statistics as the normal Medium Armor.
[*]Fixed the Ballistic Shield 3D model problems. The shield is now ready to be released.
[*]Fixed the ASVAL-60 ammo item description. Updated it so now it says the right amount of ammo instead of a copy of the ASVAL-30 ammo.
[*]Fixed the sprint animation of the QBZ-95. It was using the wrong sprinting animations before.
[*]Fixed the QBZ-95 bugs where the iron sight / ammo in the gun did not show. The weapon is now ready to be released.
[*]Fixed the Military Ruck item description (+Skinned versions). It had the wrong amount of slots in the description.
[*]Fixed / Updated the texture of the personal locker. The "code lock" part on the locker should now be visible again.
[*]Added a new Riot Shield: Riot Shield Crunzaty. This Riot Shield is especially made for our moderator Crunzaty.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield FistyCuffs29. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer FistyCuffs29.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield ZombieEyedGnome. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer ZombieEyedGnome.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield TheSurvivalGuysTV. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer TheSurvivalGuysTV.
[*]Added a new Media Riot Shield: Riot Shield Cristyle91. This Riot Shield is especially made for the youtuber Cristyle91.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield Cricridusud. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer Cricridusud.
[*]Added a new Streamer Riot Shield: Riot Shield jiznukem. This Riot Shield is especially made for the streamer jiznukem.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Faroe Islands.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Puerto Rico.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Georgia.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Indonesia.
[*]Added a new country Riot Shield: Riot Shield Estonia.
[*]Added a new item: (This is also directly a new type of item) The Tactical Weapon Crate. The Tactical Weapon Crate is a new type of crate in Infestation: The New Z. 
This is the first crate that's released of it's kind. This crate can be opened in-game just like opening a skinbox. After opening the crate it will dissapear and give the player a weapon / item in return.
[*]Renamed "12 Gauge Ammo" to "Shotgun Shell 8x". See further notes for more details why.
[*]Updated the description of the Double Barrel shotgun. (Added that the double barrel shotgun can only use Shotgun Shell 2x ammo because it has 2 barrels and no clip.)
[*]Mossbergs and KT Deciders (shotguns) are now also able to use "Shotgun Shell 2x" next to "Shotgun Shell 8x". The Double Barrel is still only capable of using "Shotgun Shell 2x".
[*]When reloading a Mossberg or KT Decider there's now also a new animation that only loads 2 shotgun shells instead of 8. (Dynamic based on what ammo you load)
[*]The VSS Compact is no longer silenced. We are still looking into solutions to give this gun 'a better place in the scene'. We don't want to make the gun too OP but definatly worth to use.
[*]The VSS Compact no longer has a silencer attached to the front barrel of the gun since it's no longer silenced.
[*]Skinned personal lockers are now personal lockers instead of lockers that use a code. The skinned lockers will be available in the marketplace after this patch.
[/list]

[h1]Item Simplification:[/h1]
Based on feedback from our community about a "too much variaty of different items" leading to a confusion sometimes we've came up with a process we will follow in the upcoming patches. We also feel very limited when deciding to add new content since we don't want to "flood" the game.
With the process of simplification we want to rework certain items / ammo and try to group them up in a way they make more sense. While reading this we think that this can be quite complicated to understand so we recommend you to read the first notes as a start to get an idea of what exactly we mean:
[list]
[*](Already listed above but worth to mention again:) "12 Gauge ammo" is now renamed to "Shotgun Shell 8x". Shotgun Shell 2x can now also be used in a MOSSBERG or KT Decider. This to make the whole understanding of what ammo goes in what gun easier.
[*]Added a new type of armor: The MTV (This is a basic version of the MTV armors)
[*]All old MTV armors have been changed to MTV Basic. The old 'skinned' versions will be released later as actual skins.
[/list]
We ask our community to come up with ideas how we can proceed with this process. If theres any guns that should use different ammo or ammo we should remove / change we ask you to suggest it to us! In the end we just want to make the game easier to understand / play but also leave space to add new guns and items without a limit.

[h1]Marketplace Updates:[/h1]
We've received a lot of feedback from our community regarding skins. Some people were complaining there are too many skins in the game, some people were complaining there hasn't been any new skins since forever, and some said prices are too high etc.
We've discussed this and came up with a solution, a new system, that will be fit for everyone. Summed up there's basicly too many skins available to players. Some skins are too old, some new, it can be very confusing this way.
Based on this feedback we've came up with the following solution / system:
[list]
[*]There will from now on only be a limited amount of skin recipes available instead of everything being always available. We will rotate the skins daily meaning new / different skins will be available every day including discounts.
[*]Some skinboxes will be removed forever from the marketplace. (They might come back on certain events sometimes)
[*]Skinboxes will rotate in the marketplace instead of everything being available at once. We plan on making different boxes available for different/certain periods.
[*]This will leave us with more space to actually release new skinboxes instead of "flooding" the marketplace with skins.
[*]Skinboxes will increase in their value. Some skinboxes will become legacy.
[*]This will also leave space for us to release boxes that can be cheap or have prices more based on the actual quality of the skins.
[/list]

[h1]Skin Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Mauser SRG Blue skin. This skin will be released soon in an upcoming skinbox.
[*]Fixed the Mauser SRG Pink skin. This skin will be released soon in an upcoming skinbox. Scopes now also work on this weapon.
[*]Fixed the Custom Guerilla Red Strike skin textures. We are not sure yet how / when this skin will be released.
[*]Fixed the Light Sword Rainbow. Expect this skin to be released soon.
[*]Fixed the Blaser Neon Dragon glow. The skin wasn't glowing properly before.
[*]Fixed some texture issues of the "GOSU" clan skins. 
[*]Updated the textures of the "M107 Gold". The skin looks more gold now.
[*]Updated the textures of the "M107 Black".
[*]Updated the textures of the "Minicabra's". Also updated the icon.
[*]Added "Event Skins". We are not sure how these will be used but the actual skins are already added. These skins are simple red / blue colored skins for armors helmets and can be used to make teams in events.
[/list]

[h1]Solo Servers:[/h1]
As many of you already know is that "Solo Servers" are finally here! (If you have no idea what "Solo Servers" are please read this dev-blog: http://playnewz.com/getpost.php?id=60003)
"Solo Servers" have been a big demand of our entire community but also from a lot of streamers streaming our game. Until a week ago we didn't really had an idea how Solo Servers would work but we came up with a strong idea:
"Solo Servers" is an idea originally from a group of streamers where players can ONLY play solo. This aims to avoid bigger groups while playing the game and fighting against individual persons only. Here's some features summed up:
[list]
[*]There will be a new button added under the 'Open World' part of the game. This button will be called "Solo Servers".
[*]When clicking the "Solo Servers" button the player will NOT go to the server selection screen but will immediately join a random chosen server.
[*]No grouping + no group tags. Players playing in these type of servers will not have the ability to invite anyone to group.
[*]No clan tags / no clans. This is all disabled.
[*]Original Colorado V2 Servers only. You do not 'lose your spawn' when playing on official Colorado v2 servers and switch to Solo Servers.
[*]When joining a solo server it will not show anywhere what server you're on. (Basically players don't know what server they're on themselves)
[*]When dying / logging out of a solo server, it will not show up at the 'Recent Servers' tab what server you were on.
[*]Players will have the ability to join back into their server after dying by clicking the 'Rejoin Last' button. This way players still have the ability to join back the server after dying to pick up their loot.
[/list]
If you have further questions about this new open world game-mode we recommend to write all your questions in a comment on these notes or just try the new "Solo Servers" out yourself!

[h1]Seasonal Leaderboards:[/h1]
YES! Seasonal Leaderboards are finished! Many have asked for this and we thought it was time to bring the leaderboards and competitve level of the game to a next level. With this said we think these seasonal leaderboards will bring a lot of fun.
Seasonal Leaderboards will work as the following:
[list]
[*]Periods / time of a season + season name will be decided by us manually. We will create our own seasons and based on that combine them with events and prices.
[*]Seasons can take up to a month time or can be only for a few days. It's just what ever we decide depending on the event.
[*]Statistics in Seasonal Leaderboards only count statistics from Official Servers and Solo Servers.
[*]When no season is active the seasonal leaderboards tab in the menu will say "No seasons active".
[/list]
From here we will start working on special events related to seasons with cool rewards, maybe even seasons that are only for 1 day. We're planning on even adding rankings in future. We'll see what comes based on this!

[h1]New Reputation Ranks:[/h1]
Based on feedback from the community and our moderators we've decided to add new ranks to both the postive and the negative side of reputation. On the postive side we added:
[list]
[*]+300000 rep - "Genius"
[*]+400000 rep - "Devin"
[*]+500000 rep - "Sheriff"
[/list]
On the negative side we added:
[list]
[*]-1250000 rep - "Warrior"
[*]-1500000 rep - "Evil"
[*]-2000000 rep - "Cannibal"
[/list]

[h1]PVP Servers Map Rotation:[/h1]
Based on the feedback received from the community the past week we've decided to implement the PVP Servers Map Rotation. (Link to poll: http://forum.playnewz.com/index.php?/topic/60129-map-rotation-system/)
Everything about the rotation is explained in the post linked but just to make everything as clear as possible we'll gladly explain how the rotation will work again.
The basic idea behind the rotation is to have only 2 different maps at a time. One would be small and another one would be a big one.
We would also have 3 different types for each map, as we currently have for some. The slots in the server will depend on which map it is.
[list]
[*]Rotations will be ONLY done in the "PVP Servers" part of the open world part of the game.
[*]Rotations will be done every patch, for now, until we create a way to change the rotation live.
[*]There will always be 2 maps only active and every map 1 or more type. (Type is: AR ONLY, SNIPER ONLY & HYBRID) So in the end there will always be 6 servers or more.
[/list]
Rotating the PVP maps of the game gives players more excitement about "what map is coming next time", a more variated PVP environment, less confusion about "too many different maps in the game" but it also gives us the ability to add new PVP maps without overflooding the amount of PVP servers.
We hope to follow a certain pattern with a schedule where and when we switch maps in the future. For now it will work in the way explained.
We would like to make clear (also based on what we explained with the "Seasonal Leaderboards") that statistics still count for PVP servers but only for the ALL TIME statistics so not for the Seasonal Leaderboards.

[h1]Colorado V1 Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed flying objects at West Boulder Meteological Station. 
[*]Fixed misplaced objects at West Boulder Meteological Station. 
[*]Fixed some terrain issues at West Boulder Meteological Station. 
[*]Fixed physics of some rocks around Campos City where players could glitch inside them.
[*]Fixed some buildings in Campos City where players could get stuck in the windows.
[*]Fixed some buildings in Boulder City where players could get stuck in the windows.
{*}Fixed some misplaced objects in Boulder City.
[/list]

[h1]Colorado V2 Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more item spawns in places where there was no loot spawning in Death Valley.
[*]Players can no longer acces the roof of the Beach House in Clearview. Added collision walls on top of the house to prevent players from glitching up.
[*]Increased FPS / performance for players playing on low settings.
[*]Removed the old secret spot.
[*]Added a new secret spot.
[*]Fixed a problem in Boulder City where some buildings had windows where players could only look / shoot through from one side.
[*]Fixed fences in Boulder City where players were only shoot through from one side.
[/list]

[h1]Caliwood Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem in Caliwood where some buildings had windows where players could only look / shoot through from one side.
[*]Fixed some issues related to zombie spawns. Some spawns had wrong setting causing zombies to respawn too fast / too much.
[*]Fixed some player spawns where players would spawn outside of the map. Spawns are moved / improved.
[*]Fixed physics of some rocks at the beach areas where players could glitch inside them.
[*]Decreased the total amount of zombie spawns. At some places there was just too many and it was affecting the PVP in certain area's.
[*]Players can no longer acces certain parts of the roof of the convention centre in the center of the map. 
[*]Players can no longer acces balconies of "green-yellow" appartment buildings. Collision walls are updated.
[*]Added a new secret spot.
[*]Added a military tent on top of the convention center to give players better protection / cover while PVP-ing.
[*]Added a parking lot in front of the convention center to give players better protection / cover while PVP-ing.
[*]Removed the "Infestation" poster from the convention center building due collision / physics problems.
[*]Alien super zombies are now also spawning in Caliwood. We will not tell you where they spawn yet. Good luck finding them!
[/list]

[h1]Event Map Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked all 4 of the "Deathmatch" area's. Some are entirely reworked while some are just improved. This is all done based on feedback from the community.
[*]Added vault (Global Inventory Acces) NPC's and store NPC's to the lobby of the map so players don't have to log out to grab other items out of their global inventory.
[*]Added signs indicating the names of the fighting area's and teams to improve usablity of the map. Players participating in events now know better where to go.
{*}The lobby and "walk" area's are now safezone to improve general flow of the events done on this map.
[*]Fixed physics of the 'wooden walls' objects that are used on 2 area's of the map. Players can no longer walk / shoot through.
[*]Fixed flying objects throughout the entire map + removed misplaced objects.
[*]Optimized freeze time on the map. Time is now frozen at 11:00 AM for a better general look of the map.
[*]Optimized shadows / terrain / lighting on the entire map. Improved performance and FPS. Also decreased loading time needed to load the map.
[*]Updated terrain texture to a better looking one.
[*]Updated minimap.
[/list]

[h1]Rocky Ford Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more collision walls on top of the post office to prevent players from glitching on top of the roof.
[*]Added more details in and around the church.
[*]Added two new houses in front of the church to improve / fill up the area a bit more.
[*]Added sand bags in front of the church to give players more cover.
[*]Updated minimap.
[/list]

[h1]West Oaks Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more collision walls on top of the motel buildings to prevent players from glitching on top of the roof.
[/list]

[h1]Spring Valley Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some terrain issues.
[*]Added, moved and improved player spawns. (Some spawns were too much in the open / bad location)
[*]Optimized map / changed some settings to increase FPS and performance.
[/list]

[h1]Battle Royale Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased the spawn rates of medical items.
[*]Removed krugers / kruger ammo from the loot spawns. These items will no longer be in Battle Royale.
[*]Removed the Bizon / Honey Badger from the loot spawns. Also these items will no longer be in Battle Royale.
[*]Moved / fixed some spawns where players would spawn in the middle of a group of zombies.
[/list]
We are planning on reworking the loot in the current Battle Royale map as soon as the new Battle Royale map is released. We have removed certain items from spawning to make the flow and gameplay of a Battle Royale easier and faster.
Loot will be reworked / optimized on the new upcoming Battle Royale map.

Estimated time of patch is listed at the top of this announcement.

Best Regards,

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Private Server Issues Fixed + Compensation!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

This announcement is especially written for server owners / players that rented servers in the past 2 weeks.

Many of you recently experienced that private servers we're having technical issues.

We have been on top of the situation since. Players that pay money to rent those servers and then can't use them properly was never supposed to happen and is definitely something we never wanted to happen either. We really understand the situation for those players and we will always do everything that's necessary to compensate in any way for what ever got lost.

Here's a small timeline to summarize the situation up and make it a bit more clear for everyone:

[h1]Sunday - February 12, 2017:[/h1]
Upgrade of our servers (hardware). After the upgrade we decided to increase the amount of rent able servers since our available space got increased.
-> Available server slots to rent increased.

[h1]Tuesday - February 14, 2017:[/h1]
Start of the GC sale. People started renting an insanely amount of servers. At THIS day the problem started happening.

[h1]Friday - February 17, 2017:[/h1]
First compensation. At this moment the issues were still not fixed so we decided to compensate everyone that had servers rented in between the time the problems started happening (February 14, 2017) until that moment (February 17, 2017).
Compensation was 1000 GC. (Server costs per day are around 300 GC)
We also announced that at this moment we still didn't fix the issue and that we would see from there how much / if we compensate again depending on how the situation proceeded.

[h1]Wednesday - February 22, 2017:[/h1]
Patch Day! This patch contained some possible fixes / improvements to the private servers. We hoped the problem would be resolved but it wasn't. We also updated you [img][/img]all in the actual patch notes about the situation again.

[h1]Thursday - February 23, 2017:[/h1]
Today. We have been working since the patch on this issue. Already done major improvements and it looks like everything is fixed now!

[b]We also found out that the problem was only happening to EU servers.[/b]

Obviously between this moment and the last time we compensated there's still been problems which made us decide to compensate again for that period of time.[img][/img]


Since the problem is fixed now, this will be the final compensation.

[h1]Between: February 17, 2017 (Last Compensation)[/h1]
And
[h1]Between: February 23, 2017 (Now)[/h1]
We compensate:
[h1]2000 GC to everyone that owned EU servers in this period of time[/h1]


We are truly sorry for the troubles you have experienced. We want to thank you for your patience during this period.

Best Regards,

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/02/22
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We're rolling out a quick, unexpected medium sized patch to fix some issues and update some things. The main reason this patch is rolling out is so that our AntiCheat name in the game is renamed. This had to be done and we took this opportunity to also patch a lot of other things. 

Before we jump in the patch notes we first want to inform / update you all regarding the 'private server issues'. If you're unaware of our most recent announcement that also contains information about the issue, please read this first: http://steamcommunity.com/games/555570/announcements/detail/680444679526708202
Servers are becoming more and more stable and look finally to be a bit 'calmed down' so the problem should slowly be resolved.

Now, let's get into the patch notes:

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]"MLG AntiCheat" is now officially renamed to "Fredaikis AntiCheat (FAC)".
[*]Based on community feedback the machete (melee) is now more common.
[*]Improved the alien super zombie textures. Fixed texture bugs and the eyes from the zombie are now glowing red.
[*]Fixed some city buildings that did not have double sided glass in the windows so players could only see through from one side.
[*]Fixed the city building (2 story thats also used in the Battle Royale map) where there was a window players could shoot through from one side.
[*]Increased the Private Server Cooldown for it to go back to "sleep" mode. The reason we've done this is to prevent players from losing their airdrops. It would happen sometimes that a player would call in an airdrop and crash.
The server would go too fast in "sleep" mode before and therefor caused the airdrop to despawn before the player joined back in and then lose the airdrop. This should no longer happen.
[*]Fixed a bug that would not let a player buy certain items when in discount. (For example: Player has 2100 GC, normally the item he wants to buy costs 2500 GC but in discount it would be 2000 GC. The player could still not buy the item. This is fixed now.)
[*]Fixed a visual bug when trying to drop items just after logging in to a server.
[*]Fixed a bug related to GC purchases with Steam. Players would sometimes get the error "You do not have enough playtime to buy over X amount".
[*]Zombies will no longer no-clip through airdrops landed in a map.
[/list]

[h1]UI Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the menu background to a new one.
[*]Improved the clan / group arrow in-game that would show on top of a player when he is in your clan or group. This arrow would sometimes 'bug' when the other player in yourm clan or group would be very far away.

[*]Fixed a UI bug that caused backpacks somtimes not to show the right amount of slots. (This was glitched before)
[*]Removed the pickup button for code lockers. Only devs can pick up code lockers now. The reason we've done this is because code lockers are only for events and not available for public because players could potentially
use code lockers for black market / glitch / dupe purposes. We want to avoid this. Code lockers will only be used in events.

Best Regards,

notes.content:

Have a nice weekend everyone!

Best Regards,

// Infestation: The New Z - Staff Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2017/02/13 (Valentine's Week)
notes.content:
Dear Players,

With Valentine's day coming soon and some major problems we have decided to release a smaller hotfix / patch. This patch includes a lot of fixes and all the content for the Valentine's Day events.
Before we jump into the patch notes we would like to let you all know what exactly is happening on and after Valentine's Day. Here's more information:

[h1]Valentine's Week:[/h1]
Instead of doing events only ON Valentine's Day we have decided to extend it with a few more days. Here are the exact dates:
[list]
[*]START: Tuesday, February 14, 2017 - 00:00 (UTC+2)
[*]START: Friday, February 17, 2017 - 23:59 (UTC+2)
[/list]
We have some amazing and cool things planned during these days. Stay tuned with an announcement that will follow tomorrow with more details about WHEN / WHAT is going to happen!
Wondering how the new Valentine skins are going to look like? Check out here: https://www.facebook.com/pg/Infestation.NewZ/photos/?tab=album&album_id=935642256570582

Patch is expected to roll out: Monday, February 13, 11:00 (UTC+2). Please keep in mind that this is an estimation. There is a chance the patch rolls out a few hours later if we stumble upon problems.

Now, let's jump into the details for this current patch:

[h1]Overall Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Colorado V1 is now available on official servers.
[*]Springvalley now has a clan limit (PVP Server).
[*]Updated the airdrop plane sound to a jet engine sound instead of the sound of a propellor plane.
[*]Updated the airdrop plane model. We've added a complete new model that's better quality, better optimized and looks better.
[*]Updated the old "Origin" crates used almost everywhere in the game now have a new texture containing the Fredaikis logo.
[*]Fixed the problem related to some language packs showing the wrong information on the information about premium benefits.
[*]Fixed the "Item Being Saved" bug that happens to players sometimes when trying to pick up items in a server.
"Item Being Saved" WILL still happen IF the servers have bad connections BUT we recoded the way it works and that prevents it now from being bugged most of the time.
[*]Fixed one of the NA server problems - we got rid of the server and now have a new one with better connections.
[*]Fixed the problem with impacts for military tents. When shooting a tent snow particles would play. This is now fixed.
[*]Optimized fast load, recoded certain parts to make fast load even smoother and more optimized.
We are still looking into the texture glitches caused by fast load. Stay tuned for this!
[*]Fixed a bug causing the color picker to be picking white for the item highlight colors.
[*]Fixed a bug where battle royales would crash, preventing people from joining them after some days and give the message that no free servers are available.
[*]Added new particles / sounds / impacts for glass objects.
[*]Added new particles / sounds / impacts for Rubbish (Trash) objects.
[/list]

[h1]Item Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new backpack: The Adventure Backpack. This backpack is especially made for the players that want to be able to carry A LOT of items. This backpack has 85 item slots and 400kg max weight. http://infestation.gamepedia.com/Adventure_Backpack
[*]Added a new item: Valentine Heart. This item is a consumable and ONLY going to by achievable on Valentine's day.
[*]Updated the AMR2 Chrome description. It was describing the wrong skinbox the skin is in.
[*]RAH 23 is now capable of having any stanag ammo attached instead of just C-mags.
[*]Flashbangs now have weight added, just like every other item.
[/list]

[h1]Skin Updates:[/h1]
In preparation for Valentine's Day and the events that are planned we've reworked and added new Valentine's skins:
[list]
[*]Reworked the Valentine Skinbox. Reworked textures and store icon.
[*]Reworked the Custom Guerilla Valentine. Reworked textures, store icon and skin recipe.
[*]Reworked the Famas Valentine. Reworked textures, store icon and skin recipe.
[*]Reworked the L85 Valentine. Reworked textures, store icon and skin recipe.
[*]Reworked the Moto Helmet Valentine. Reworked textures, store icon and skin recipe.
[*]Reworked the Karambit Valentine. Reworked textures, store icon and skin recipe.
[*]Reworked the Tactical Knife Valentine. Reworked textures, store icon and skin recipe.
[*]Reworked the AWM Valentine. Reworked textures, store icon and skin recipe.
[*]Reworked the Heavy Armor Chrome. Based on feedback from the community the skin looks a little bit less 'balloony' now.
[*]Added the AK47 Valentine. This skin will be inside the Valentine Skinbox.
[*]Added the AN94 Valentine. This skin will be inside the Valentine Skinbox.
[*]Added the M4A1 Valentine. This skin will be inside the Valentine Skinbox.
